subheader: If you're looking to launch a Masterclass, sell e-books, or offer coaching sessions, meet Forento!
highlights: One place to sell courses, coaching programs, and videos
Build and host your own branded platform for communities, products, and programs

faqs.q: What types of products can I sell on Forento?
faqs.a: Forento allows you to sell various information-based products, including courses, downloadables (e.g., e-books, worksheets), sessions (one-on-one coaching), events (online or in-person), and videos. Each product type is designed to cater to different content delivery methods.

faqs.q: How do I set up my Forento website?
faqs.a: To set up your Forento website, enable the website builder, select a template, and choose a subdomain. You can then customize your site by replacing content, adding or removing pages, and configuring elements like buttons to link to your products or sign-up pages.

faqs.q: How can I create a community within my Forento academy?
faqs.a: Forento's community feature allows members to connect, share insights, and ask questions. You can set up channels with specific permissions, create post categories, manage member profiles, and utilize gamification to encourage engagement.

faqs.q: What steps are involved in getting started with Forento?
faqs.a: To begin selling on Forento, you need to publish a product, connect to a payment gateway, and start selling. Additional customization, such as branding your platform and inviting team members, can enhance your academy's appeal.

faqs.q: How can I display my products on my Forento website?
faqs.a: You can showcase your products using the Course Element, which automatically displays all published courses, or manually by adding elements like images, text, and buttons that link directly to your products.

faqs.q: How do I set up automated emails in Forento?
faqs.a: Forento's Email Automation feature allows you to send automated emails triggered by user actions, such as welcome emails upon sign-up or introduction emails when a user accesses a course. This helps guide and engage your users effectively.

faqs.q: Can I customize the log-in and sign-up pages on my Forento platform?
faqs.a: Yes, you can customize the log-in and sign-up pages by adding your logo, thumbnail, and changing the brand color. You can also select between different platform themes to align with your brand identity.

faqs.q: What customization options are available for my Forento platform?
faqs.a: Forento offers various customization options, including adding a logo, changing brand colors, selecting platform themes, and customizing the design of your platform's pages to reflect your brand identity.

reviews_summary: Forento has received positive feedback from customers, who appreciate its user-friendly interface, comprehensive LMS features, and responsive customer support. While some users have mentioned limited payment integrations and additional fees for certain core functions, overall, Forento is a solid choice for individuals looking to launch courses, sell e-books, or offer coaching sessions. With a 60-day money-back guarantee, it's worth giving Forento a try.

faqs.q: What are the key features of OnlineCourseHost.com?
faqs.a: OnlineCourseHost.com offers a range of features including an AI Course Creator Assistant, AI Student Assistant, unlimited video hosting and bandwidth, secure e-commerce solutions with Stripe and PayPal integration, multi-language support, and a community feature that allows for free, paid, or invite-only access.

faqs.q: Can I use my own custom domain with OnlineCourseHost.com?
faqs.a: Yes, you can activate your own custom domain on OnlineCourseHost.com. The platform provides guidance on how to set up custom domains for different DNS providers, whether they support ALIAS records or not.

faqs.q: Does OnlineCourseHost.com integrate with other tools and services?
faqs.a: Yes, OnlineCourseHost.com integrates with various tools and services, including Pabbly, SendFox, Stripe, PayPal, and Zapier, allowing for seamless connections with over 1,000 other apps and services.

faqs.q: What types of lessons can I create on OnlineCourseHost.com?
faqs.a: You can create various types of lessons, including video lessons, digital downloads, text lessons, quizzes, assignments, and audio lessons.

faqs.q: Are there any platform fees on OnlineCourseHost.com?
faqs.a: No, there aren't any platform fees in any plan, including during the free trial. This means that 100% of the value of each sale goes directly into your Stripe or PayPal account, minus the small credit card processing fees charged by those payment processors.

faqs.q: Can I create a community for my students on OnlineCourseHost.com?
faqs.a: Yes, OnlineCourseHost.com includes a community feature that allows you to build an engaged community of students. You can create free, paid, or invite-only communities, and even have multi-level communities with different rooms that can also be free, paid, or invite-only.

faqs.q: Does OnlineCourseHost.com support email marketing?
faqs.a: Yes, OnlineCourseHost.com has built-in email marketing tools that allow you to send bulk emails to your students, helping you grow your audience and keep them engaged.

faqs.q: What is the AI Course Creation Assistant on OnlineCourseHost.com?
faqs.a: The AI Course Creation Assistant is a tool designed to help course creators optimize their course descriptions, suggest course features, and recommend course pricing. It analyzes your content and provides suggestions to enhance clarity and engagement.

faqs.q: What digital products can I sell using Skillplate?
faqs.a: Skillplate enables creators to sell various digital products, including online courses, membership communities, and digital downloads. The platform provides tools for course creation, CRM and email marketing, exams and quizzes, certifications, resource libraries, live sessions, and more.

faqs.q: How do I set up my digital products and branding on Skillplate?
faqs.a: To set up your digital products and branding on Skillplate, follow these steps: 1. Create an account and start your 14-day free trial. 2. Set up your digital products and branding to get an instant website. 3. Monetize by promoting your course or community to your fans.

faqs.q: What integrations does Skillplate support?
faqs.a: Skillplate supports integrations with over 180 apps, including Facebook, YouTube, Instagram, Mailchimp, Zoom, Shopify, Google, Hubspot, Calendly, Open AI, Asana, Twitter, Spotify, Slack, Zendesk, and SendGrid.

faqs.q: How does Skillplate handle user data and privacy?
faqs.a: Skillplate collects personal data such as names, email addresses, and country of origin for users and creators. The platform does not store or collect bank account data; all payment methods are handled by Stripe. Users have rights to access, correct, or delete their personal data.

reviews_summary: Customers appreciate Skillplate, praising its intuitive interface, seamless integration of course creation and website building, and exceptional support from the founder. There are no critical dependencies on third-party tools, which enhances its reliability. While some users have expressed a desire for more advanced email marketing tools, the platform's comprehensive features, including AI-driven product creation and full white-labeling options, significantly streamline the process for creators. Weighing the positive feedback against the occasional requests for enhancements, Skillplate is hitting the mark with a stellar 4.8 rating from 99 reviews. It's a solid buy for creators looking to launch and manage their offerings efficiently, especially with a 60-day money-back guarantee—so why not give it a try?

subheader: Make your online meetings more fun, engaging, and interactive
value_prop: Make virtual meetings more engaging
highlights: Enjoy a realistic and simple interface for online sessions that drives positive engagement among participants
Host multiple virtual rooms and sessions with comprehensive admin controls over cams, mics, and screens
body:
GoBrunch is a versatile webinar platform with a unique interface that provides more engagement and higher value for virtual attendees.




With Zoom fatigue running high, GoBrunch transforms the way you run virtual sessions.


The platform’s unique interface allows you to 
make virtual events more fun
 with interactivity and a user experience that mimics in-person events.


You’ll be able to 
host unlimited webinars inside of GoBrunch
—no installation required for you or your attendees!


It only takes a few minutes to set up your virtual classroom with the immediate ability to 
screen share with sound, enable your camera, and broadcast presenters
. 


 
 
 
 
 



Create your GoBrunch virtual classroom or training event in minutes!
You can 
choose the room layout
, giving participants the chance to pick their own seats and meet other attendees—just like in person!


Once the session is live, you’ll be able to 
play video content, present uploaded slides, record your sessions
, and download video files.


Guests will be able to interact with the ability to 
raise their hands, vote, and raise signs
.


Plus, at the end of the session, GoBrunch lets you download a detailed frequency report that displays how long each attendee participated in the live session.


 
 
 
 
 



Like in-person events, you can choose a seat and view other attendees' profiles in the virtual event space.
With GoBrunch, you never have to worry about someone accidentally leaving their mic on while the facilitator is presenting.


The facilitator can 
manage every mic and camera for every attendee
 to ensure that all the attention is on the person presenting.


You’ll also be able to 
control the screen and moderate the session chat
, making sure that everything runs smoothly during your session.


 
 
 
 
 



The facilitator can control cameras and mics, as well as the screen, chat, and moderation features.
GoBrunch makes it possible to 
create either public or private sessions
 for webinars, courses, meetings, and events.


Much like an in-person event, you can 
host multiple breakout rooms and sessions simultaneously
 with different facilitators assigned to each.


Share your custom event link
 with your attendees so they can browse through different sessions and join the ones that stick out to them.


 
 
 
 
 



Create multiple breakout rooms and simultaneous sessions with different organizers assigned to each.
Without interactive elements, webinars become another excuse for people to check out mentally and scroll through their inboxes. (
“15% off patio furniture at Target, nice!”
)


GoBrunch brings the in-person experience back to virtual sessions with features that allow attendees to interact with facilitators and other participants.
Connect in the digital age.


Get lifetime access to GoBrunch today!

faqs.q: What are the main benefits of using GoBrunch?
faqs.a: GoBrunch offers several advantages, including no installation or sign-up requirements, multiple use cases such as meetings, trainings, webinars, events, and co-working spaces, a single permanent link for meetings, an immersive interface that mimics real workspaces, and no time limits.

faqs.q: How do I join a meeting on GoBrunch?
faqs.a: To join a meeting on GoBrunch, click the meeting link provided by the organizer, enter your name or log in using your Gmail or LinkedIn account, choose an avatar picture, allow microphone and camera access when prompted, and you will enter the room automatically.

faqs.q: Is GoBrunch compatible with mobile devices?
faqs.a: Yes, GoBrunch is compatible with mobile devices. For iOS devices, Safari works best, while for Android devices, Chrome is recommended.

faqs.q: Can I record webinars and meetings in GoBrunch?
faqs.a: Yes, GoBrunch allows you to record webinars and meetings. The recordings are saved in the cloud and can be shared with a single click.

faqs.q: How many attendees can a GoBrunch room accommodate?
faqs.a: The maximum number of participants per room depends on your plan. The free version supports up to 25 participants per room, while higher plans can accommodate up to 600 participants per room.

faqs.q: Does GoBrunch require any installation?
faqs.a: No, GoBrunch does not require any installation. You can use it directly in your browser without any downloads.

faqs.q: Can I customize my virtual rooms in GoBrunch?
faqs.a: Yes, GoBrunch allows you to personalize virtual rooms with your logo, brand colors, domain, and embeddable elements.

faqs.q: What browsers work best with GoBrunch?
faqs.a: For desktops and laptops, Google Chrome and Firefox are recommended. Safari works well but has a few limitations. For mobile devices, Safari is recommended for iOS, and Chrome for Android.

faqs.q: How can I get support for GoBrunch?
faqs.a: You can get support by emailing [email redacted] or visiting https://blog.gobrunch.com/contact. Additionally, there is a chat feature on the website for support.

faqs.q: Can I use GoBrunch together with calendar tools?
faqs.a: Yes, GoBrunch rooms have permanent links that can be reused. You can copy the room link and paste it into your calendar tool as a custom link.

reviews_summary: Customers are all about GoBrunch, praising its immersive and engaging virtual environments, easy customization of virtual spaces, and seamless navigation. While there are occasional glitches and minor issues with audio reliability, the overall positive feedback outweighs these minor hiccups. GoBrunch is a solid buy for those in need of a more engaging and interactive online meeting platform, especially with the added benefit of a 60-day money-back guarantee.

faqs.q: What data fields can Reoon Lead Scraper extract from YellowPages?
faqs.a: Reoon Lead Scraper can extract various data fields from YellowPages, including Search Location, Search Rank, Profile/Company Name, Category, Profile URL, Full Address, Phone Number, Email Address, Website, Rating, Number of Reviews, Years in Business, Email from Website, Phone Number from Website, and Social Media Profiles such as Facebook, Twitter, and Instagram.

faqs.q: Which countries' YellowPages does Reoon Lead Scraper support?
faqs.a: Reoon Lead Scraper supports YellowPages from multiple countries, including the United States (yellowpages.com), United Kingdom (thomsonlocal.com), Canada (yellowpages.ca), Germany (gelbeseiten.de), Switzerland (local.ch), India (justdial.com), and Australia (yellowpages.com.au) with limited support. faqs.q: How can I scrape multiple keywords and locations simultaneously?
faqs.a: To scrape multiple keywords and locations simultaneously, enter all your desired keywords in the keywords field, separated by semicolons (;), and all your desired locations in the location field, also separated by semicolons (;). The software will process each combination accordingly.

faqs.q: Are there any daily or monthly usage limits for Reoon Lead Scraper?
faqs.a: For the Ultimate version, there are no daily or monthly usage limits imposed by Reoon. Users can extract as much data as needed within their subscription period. However, YellowPages may have their own limitations, which can sometimes be bypassed using proxies or VPNs.

faqs.q: Do I need to use proxies or VPNs with Reoon Lead Scraper?
faqs.a: Proxies or VPNs are not mandatory. Reoon Lead Scraper includes an anti-block algorithm that allows users to scrape thousands of pages without getting blocked. However, in some cases, using a VPN or proxies may be necessary to avoid restrictions imposed by YellowPages.

faqs.q: Can I try Reoon Lead Scraper before purchasing?
faqs.a: Yes, a free version of Reoon Lead Scraper is available for testing purposes. It allows users to check the software's functionality, though it comes with limitations on the number of leads that can be scraped. No payment information is required to download and use the free version.

faqs.q: What are the system requirements for running Reoon Lead Scraper?
faqs.a: Reoon Lead Scraper is compatible with both Windows and Mac operating systems. It requires an internet connection and can run on any hardware configuration.

faqs.q: How can I overcome YellowPages' scraping limits to extract more profiles?
faqs.a: To overcome YellowPages' scraping limits, you can split your search into smaller areas instead of larger ones. For example, instead of searching for a whole country, you can search by individual cities or towns. This approach allows you to extract more profiles by conducting multiple smaller searches.

faqs.q: What is Notte and what are its main features?
faqs.a: Notte is a unified platform designed to build, run, and deploy AI agents and web automation scripts. Its main features include browser sessions, web agents, serverless functions, and scraping APIs. Notte provides tools like Agent Builder, Demonstrate Mode, and Studio to streamline the development and deployment of automation workflows.

faqs.q: How can I create and configure a browser session in Notte?
faqs.a:
To create and configure a browser session in Notte, you can use the Notte SDK. Here's an example in Python:

```python
from notte_sdk import NotteClient

client = NotteClient()

with client.Session(
 headless=True,
 solve_captchas=True,
 proxies=True,
 viewport_width=1920,
 viewport_height=1080,
 timeout_minutes=10,
 browser_type='chromium'
) as session:
 page = session.page
 page.goto('https://example.com')
```

This code initializes a session with specified configurations such as running in headless mode, enabling CAPTCHA solving, using proxies, setting viewport dimensions, defining a timeout, and selecting the browser type.

faqs.q: Does Notte support CAPTCHA solving during automation?
faqs.a: Yes, Notte supports automatic CAPTCHA solving when the `solve_captchas=True` parameter is set during session creation. This feature is currently supported only when using `browser_type='firefox'`.

faqs.q: Can I use custom proxies with Notte?
faqs.a: Yes, Notte allows you to use custom HTTP or HTTPS proxies for greater control over network routing. You can configure custom proxies when creating a session through the API or SDK.

faqs.q: How can I deploy my automation scripts as API endpoints in Notte?
faqs.a: Notte offers a feature called Functions, which allows you to deploy your automation scripts as API endpoints. This enables serverless automations and agents that you can invoke and schedule anywhere.

faqs.q: What are some common use cases for Notte?
faqs.a: Common use cases for Notte include building production-ready AI agents for market and pricing monitoring, automating back-office operations like tax and finance portal interactions, and extracting structured web data at scale for product catalogs and pricing.

faqs.q: How does Notte handle session lifecycle management?
faqs.a: Notte manages session lifecycles by transitioning through states such as 'active', 'closed', 'error', and 'timed_out'. Sessions can be created using context managers for automatic cleanup, and you can reconnect to existing sessions using their session IDs.

faqs.q: Can I manage cookies across sessions in Notte?
faqs.a: Yes, Notte allows you to manage cookies across sessions. You can use the `cookie_file` parameter to automatically load and save cookies, enabling persistent authentication and session continuity.

faqs.q: Does Notte support integration with external browser providers?
faqs.a: Yes, Notte supports integration with external browser providers like Kernel.sh. This allows you to connect Notte to an external browser and utilize features such as AI agents, smart actions, and structured scraping.

faqs.q: How can I configure Notte to avoid detection during web automation?
faqs.a: To avoid detection during web automation, you can configure Notte with options like enabling CAPTCHA solving, using residential proxies, selecting appropriate browser types, setting custom user agents, and defining viewport dimensions. It's recommended to start with simple configurations and gradually add complexity while monitoring success rates.

reviews_summary: Customers appreciate Notte, praising its powerful automation capabilities, the flexibility of the Anything API, and the clean user interface that simplifies complex tasks. While some users mention a steep learning curve, these are minor bumps in an otherwise solid experience. Overall, Notte is making waves in the automation space, and with a 60-day money-back guarantee, it's a risk-free opportunity to enhance your browser workflows. faqs.q: What is Headroom and what does it do?
faqs.a: Headroom is a menu-bar desktop app (built on the open-source Headroom CLI) that runs as a local proxy to reversibly compress tool output, logs, and boilerplate before they reach Claude Code or ChatGPT. By trimming noisy items it typically reduces token use on the compressed items by ~50% and overall session token usage by up to ~50%, letting the same plan deliver more usage without changing model outputs. (All optimization runs locally.)

faqs.q: Does Headroom run locally or send my prompts to Headroom servers?
faqs.a: Headroom runs locally on your machine; the app routes prompts through a local proxy and the compression/optimization happens on-device. Prompts and code do not need to be sent to Headroom servers. (The desktop app downloads a local compression model on first launch.)

faqs.q: Which platforms does Headroom support?
faqs.a: Headroom provides desktop builds for macOS, Windows, and Linux.

faqs.q: Does Headroom work with Claude Code and with ChatGPT (Codex)?
faqs.a: Yes. Headroom connects to Claude Code as a first-class connector and also supports OpenAI Codex as available via the ChatGPT/Codex connector; you enable the Claude Code and/or ChatGPT connector in the app and Headroom routes the client through the same local optimization proxy.

faqs.q: How do I install Headroom and verify it is routing my agent through the local proxy?
faqs.a: Install the appropriate desktop build (drag into Applications on macOS, run the Windows installer, or install the .deb / AppImage on Linux). On first run the app downloads its isolated Python runtime and a local compression model. In the Headroom app enable the connector for Claude Code, ChatGPT, or both; Headroom configures your shell, and you should open a fresh terminal (terminals already open keep their old environment). Verify routing by running echo $ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL (or echo $OPENAI_BASE_URL for ChatGPT) in the terminal where your agent runs — it should point at 127.0.0.1:6767. The dashboard starts counting requests and savings from the first prompt once routing is active.

faqs.q: Is Headroom open-source and where can I find the code?
faqs.a: Yes. Headroom’s compression engine is the open-source Headroom CLI on GitHub. The desktop app is built on top of the CLI (headroom-desktop) and the project repositories are linked from the Headroom site.

faqs.q: Can I upgrade my tier later?
faqs.a: Yes. Upgrade from your AppSumo account under Products. The app switches to the new tier automatically.

faqs.q: What is MiroMiro and what does it do?
faqs.a: MiroMiro is a browser extension that allows users to extract and copy code, CSS, and assets from any website. It enables users to select any section of a webpage and export it as clean Tailwind or plain HTML + CSS, extract design tokens like colors and fonts, and download images, videos, and Lottie animations.

faqs.q: How can I install MiroMiro?
faqs.a: You can install MiroMiro by adding it to your Chrome browser from the Chrome Web Store. Simply visit the MiroMiro website and click on the 'Add to Chrome' button to initiate the installation.

faqs.q: Is MiroMiro compatible with browsers other than Chrome?
faqs.a: MiroMiro is compatible with Chrome, Brave, and Edge browsers. However, it is not recommended for use with Arc due to a known sidebar API conflict.

faqs.q: Can MiroMiro be used with AI tools like Cursor, Claude, and v0?
faqs.a: Yes, MiroMiro is designed to work seamlessly with AI tools such as Cursor, Claude, and v0. It exports components as clean, semantic Tailwind + HTML, allowing AI tools to work with real code instead of guessing from a screenshot.

faqs.q: How can I extract a website's design system using MiroMiro?
faqs.a: MiroMiro allows you to extract a website's entire design system by pulling every color, gradient, font, shadow, and spacing token from any site in one pass. These can be exported as CSS variables or a ready-to-paste Tailwind config.

faqs.q: Is it legal to use MiroMiro to copy code from other websites?
faqs.a: MiroMiro functions similarly to browser DevTools or 'View Source' by allowing users to inspect how a page is built. While inspecting and learning from a page's CSS and structure is common practice, users should respect copyright laws when using extracted content commercially.

faqs.q: Does MiroMiro work on websites built with frameworks like React or Vue?
faqs.a: Yes, MiroMiro reads the rendered DOM, not the source code, so it works on websites built with frameworks like React, Vue, and others.

faqs.q: Does MiroMiro send my browsing data to its servers?
faqs.a: No, MiroMiro's extraction runs entirely in your browser, and it does not track your browsing data. The only data stored are anonymous usage counts for plan limits.

faqs.q: How can I download Lottie animations from a website using MiroMiro?
faqs.a: To download Lottie animations, install MiroMiro, open the target website, and click the Lottie icon. MiroMiro will detect all Lottie animations on the page, allowing you to preview and download them as standard Lottie JSON or dotLottie files.

reviews_summary: Customers appreciate MiroMiro, praising its ability to effortlessly extract design systems, export clean HTML, and save significant time during web design processes. Users also highlight the intuitive interface and responsive support team as major benefits. There are minor drawbacks, such as compatibility issues with certain browsers, but MiroMiro now supports Arc, Comet, and Opera in addition to Chrome, Edge, Brave, and Firefox. Overall, MiroMiro is a standout choice for designers, and with a 60-day money-back guarantee, it's a no-brainer to give it a try for just $49!

faqs.q: What types of checks does Vibe App Scanner run on an app?
faqs.a: Vibe App Scanner runs a full check suite that includes security checks, SEO and AI-search readiness (AEO/GEO), performance, accessibility, compliance, and email checks (plus breach monitoring and other audits) as part of its scan offering.

faqs.q: How do I run a scan with Vibe App Scanner?
faqs.a: You run a scan by submitting your app's URL to the scanner on the Vibe App Scanner website; the site initiates a crawl of the application and returns the scan results.

faqs.q: Can AppSumo plans check pages behind login?
faqs.a: Yes. All three tiers include optional authenticated standard checks when you start a scan manually in the VAS dashboard. Add a dedicated test account with a supported email/password login, and VAS checks a sample of protected pages and API responses. This uses one scan from your monthly allowance. It is not an automated deep crawl or a complete access-control audit. Scheduled and API/MCP scans do not use saved login credentials.

faqs.q: Which platforms, frameworks, or no-code builders does Vibe App Scanner support or provide guides for?
faqs.a: Vibe App Scanner provides platform-specific security guides and scans for a wide range of platforms and builders (examples listed include Firebase, Supabase, Bubble, Webflow, Retool, Appwrite, Xano, FlutterFlow, Glide and many others), with targeted checks mapped to each platform's typical failure modes.

faqs.q: Does Vibe App Scanner check for exposed API keys, tokens, or other secrets in an app bundle or configuration?
faqs.a: Yes. The scanner looks for exposed API keys, tokens and other secrets in served bundles and common misconfigurations, and platform guides call out checks for exposed credentials and database/API exposures.

faqs.q: Does Vibe App Scanner include breach monitoring or external breach checks?
faqs.a: Yes. Vibe App Scanner includes breach monitoring as part of its suite (it references Breach Monitoring and integration with Have I Been Pwned (HIBP) as a monitored item).

faqs.q: What common vulnerabilities does Vibe App Scanner find in vibe-coded or similar apps?
faqs.a: The Vibe App Scanner Q&A and guides note recurring findings such as XSS via dangerouslySetInnerHTML, missing input validation, placeholder API calls, exposed bundles/secrets, and misconfigured Row Level Security or database permissions as common vulnerability classes.

faqs.q: What does a scan report include and does Vibe App Scanner provide remediation guidance?
faqs.a: Scan results include findings from the full crawl and audit suite and Vibe App Scanner provides personalized recommendations and guidance to address identified security and configuration issues.

reviews_summary: Customers appreciate Vibe App Scanner for its ability to identify security vulnerabilities, provide actionable fixes, and deliver comprehensive findings that enhance the development process. Users also commend the founders for their active engagement with feedback and willingness to improve the tool. Minor drawbacks include the variability in coverage depending on language and framework, and some findings may not be fully complete. Overall, Vibe App Scanner is a valuable tool for applications built with modern coding tools, making it a solid buy at $49, especially with a 60-day money-back guarantee. Give it a try!

faqs.q: How is Vitals different from Activity Monitor?
faqs.a: Activity Monitor lists processes, about a thousand on a working Mac, and leaves the adding up to you. Vitals lists apps, with every helper added to the app that launched it, and adds 30 days of history, notifications and a menu bar you arrange.

faqs.q: Will it tell me what is making my Mac slow?
faqs.a: Yes. The CPU, memory, energy, disk and network tabs each put the busiest app at the top, and Vitals points out an app that keeps the CPU busy, keeps growing in memory, or hammers the disk. Click the app and everything about it is in one place.

faqs.q: Is this really lifetime access?
faqs.a: Yes. You pay once and every update is included, with no paid upgrades and no renewal.

faqs.q: I bought more than one code. How do I use them?
faqs.a: Each code covers one Mac, and up to 5 codes go on one license key. Redeem them all at vitalsmac.com/appsumo: click "Add another code" under the first box to enter several at once, or come back later and enter the new code with the same email. It adds a Mac to the key you already have, and the key itself does not change.

faqs.q: Which Macs does it run on?
faqs.a: macOS 15 Sequoia or later, on Apple silicon and Intel. Power and temperature figures are most detailed on Apple silicon.

faqs.q: Does it slow my Mac down?
faqs.a: With no window open it samples every five seconds and uses about a tenth of a percent of one core. It samples faster only while you are looking at it.

faqs.q: Does it send anything about my Mac anywhere?
faqs.a: Nothing about what you run. Vitals goes online only to check for updates and to check your license.

faqs.q: Is Vitals in my language?
faqs.a: Vitals is in English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Dutch, Swedish, Brazilian Portuguese, Japanese, Korean and Simplified Chinese. It follows your Mac's language.

faqs.q: When can my coding assistant use it?
faqs.a: The connection for Claude, Codex, Cursor and other assistants (an MCP server) is the next thing being built and will arrive as a free update. It lets an assistant ask the running Vitals about apps, ports and projects, and whether a process is safe to quit.

faqs.q: What is GitDoc and how does it work?
faqs.a: GitDoc is an auto-sync documentation platform that generates documentation directly from your GitHub repository. It hosts the documentation at your custom domain and keeps it synchronized with every commit, ensuring your documentation is always up-to-date.

faqs.q: How can I set up GitDoc with my GitHub repository?
faqs.a: To set up GitDoc with your GitHub repository, open the GitDoc dashboard and choose the GitHub connection flow. You'll be directed through the standard GitHub App authorization screen. After installation, return to the dashboard to confirm the repository appears as connected.

faqs.q: Can GitDoc generate API documentation from OpenAPI specifications?
faqs.a: Yes, GitDoc can generate API documentation from OpenAPI or Swagger specifications. You can import your OpenAPI spec, and GitDoc will generate and host a branded documentation site based on it.

faqs.q: How does GitDoc handle documentation versioning?
faqs.a: GitDoc provides a practical system for versioning documentation alongside your product. It allows you to maintain multiple versions of your documentation, ensuring that users can access the correct information corresponding to different product versions.

faqs.q: What are the best practices for writing effective API documentation with GitDoc?
faqs.a: Effective API documentation should cater to three audiences: evaluators, integrators, and maintainers. It should include a quick start guide, detailed integration instructions, and maintenance guidelines. Additionally, keeping the documentation synchronized with code changes is crucial to prevent it from becoming outdated.

faqs.q: How can I prevent my documentation from becoming outdated?
faqs.a: To prevent documentation from becoming outdated, it's essential to implement an auto-sync system where documentation updates itself when code changes. This structural approach ensures that documentation remains accurate and up-to-date without relying solely on manual updates.

faqs.q: What are the common issues when setting up GitDoc and how can I troubleshoot them?
faqs.a: Common issues include the GitHub repository not appearing after installation, OpenAPI imports looking incorrect, and manual edits being overwritten by automation. To troubleshoot, ensure the GitHub App was installed in the correct organization, validate the OpenAPI specification, and separate generated content from editorial content to prevent overwrites.

faqs.q: Can I use my own domain with GitDoc?
faqs.a: Yes, GitDoc allows you to use your own custom domain for hosting your documentation. This feature enables you to maintain brand consistency and provide a seamless experience for your users.

faqs.q: Is my content private and secure with GitDoc?
faqs.a: GitDoc ensures that your content is private and secure. Data is encrypted in transit with TLS 1.3 and at rest with AES-256. Drafts are private by default, visible only to your team until you publish. Additionally, GitDoc provides audit logs for every change and data residency options for teams that need them.

faqs.q: Is there a way to organize and manage my screenshots in PeekShot?

faqs.q: What output formats does PeekShot support for screenshots?

faqs.q: Can I customize Fuzen's applications to fit my business needs?
faqs.a: Yes, Fuzen allows you to customize its applications using AI. You can adjust fields, workflows, and user roles to match your specific business operations. This customization is facilitated by AI, making it accessible without the need for extensive technical knowledge.

faqs.q: What types of applications does Fuzen offer?
faqs.a: Fuzen offers a variety of applications, including CRM, HR, ERP, and industry-specific tools such as School Management, Construction Management, and Legal Firm Management. These applications are designed to be ready-made and can be tailored to your business workflows.

faqs.q: Do I need technical knowledge to use Fuzen's applications?
faqs.a: No, Fuzen's applications are designed to be user-friendly and do not require technical knowledge. The platform uses AI to assist in setting up and customizing applications, making it accessible for non-technical users.

faqs.q: Can multiple team members collaborate using Fuzen's applications?
faqs.a: Yes, Fuzen's applications support multi-user access, allowing multiple team members to collaborate and update data simultaneously. This feature is beneficial for teams working together on various business processes.

faqs.q: What support is available after purchasing a Fuzen application?
faqs.a: After purchasing a Fuzen application, you have access to Fuzen's support, documentation, and guidance for setup and customization. This ensures you can effectively implement and use the application within your business.

faqs.q: How can I create a new form in Kiwiform?
faqs.a: To create a new form in Kiwiform, go to your workspace dashboard and select the option to create a new form. You can start with a blank form for full control or choose a template for a ready-made structure. Once in the form builder, you can add fields, adjust the layout, and prepare the form for sharing. All changes are saved automatically.

faqs.q: What general settings can I configure in Kiwiform?
faqs.a: In Kiwiform, you can configure general settings such as displaying a progress bar, showing form field numbers, enabling answer labels, using navigation arrows, displaying 'Built on Kiwiform' branding, allowing respondents to move freely through the form, preventing duplicate submissions, enabling autosave responses, adding enhanced spam protection, and displaying a cookie consent notice.

faqs.q: How do I control the availability of my form in Kiwiform?
faqs.a: To control your form's availability in Kiwiform, open your form in the builder, click the Settings icon in the top toolbar, and select the Access & Availability tab. Here, you can enable or disable form submissions, set a submission limit, schedule start and end dates for submissions, and display custom opening or closing messages to respondents.

faqs.q: What accessibility features does Kiwiform offer?
faqs.a: Kiwiform includes a built-in Accessibility Checker that scans your form for common issues such as color contrast, missing alt text, and unclear content. This tool helps ensure your form is usable for all respondents, including those using assistive technologies like screen readers or keyboard navigation.

faqs.q: Can I customize system default messages in Kiwiform?
faqs.a: Yes, Kiwiform allows you to customize default system messages, labels, hints, and error texts to align with your brand voice and tone. This includes submit button labels, keyboard hints, validation errors, upload messages, and completion confirmations.

faqs.q: Can I build a Chrome extension with PlugThis if I don't know how to code?
faqs.a: Yes. Describe the extension in plain English and PlugThis returns a working Manifest V3 bundle (manifest, content scripts, popup, background service worker, icons); no JavaScript or Chrome-API knowledge is required and most users have a working extension within minutes.

faqs.q: Is the generated output a real, installable Manifest V3 extension ready for the Chrome Web Store?
faqs.a: Yes. PlugThis returns a complete Manifest V3 folder (manifest.json, scripts, popup, icons) that you can download as a ZIP, load as an unpacked extension in chrome://extensions, or publish to the Chrome Web Store.

faqs.q: How are AI features powered inside extensions — do I need to supply an API key?
faqs.a: AI features are optional and are powered by keys you provide. For AI behavior (summaries, writing, etc.) you supply your own OpenAI, Anthropic, or Gemini API key; the key lives in the extension's storage and is not sent to PlugThis servers.

faqs.q: How does PlugThis handle backend needs (authentication, database, server logic)?
faqs.a: PlugThis can auto-generate a full backend by connecting your Supabase account: it wires up auth, a Postgres database, and edge code so extensions that need persistent storage or login get a working backend without writing server code.

faqs.q: How do I download and install an extension created with PlugThis?
faqs.a: Use the Build/Download button to get a ZIP, unzip it, open Chrome at chrome://extensions, enable Developer mode, click “Load unpacked,” and select the unzipped folder; the extension will then be installed.

faqs.q: Which large language model does PlugThis use to generate the extension code and packaging?
faqs.a: PlugThis uses more than one model and picks the right one for each build. We operate those models ourselves, so you do not supply a key for the build itself, and we may change them over time as better options become available.

faqs.q: Which protocols does GOOSE VPN support and what are their differences?
faqs.a: GOOSE VPN supports IKEv2, L2TP/IPSec, PPTP, and OpenVPN protocols. IKEv2 offers high speed and works best on newer devices but can be easily blocked. L2TP/IPSec provides average security and normal speed, compatible with many devices. PPTP, similar to L2TP, is suitable for older devices. OpenVPN is hard to block as it resembles standard HTTPS connections but is slightly slower.

faqs.q: How do I use the GOOSE VPN app?
faqs.a: To use the GOOSE VPN app: 1) Download the appropriate app for your device from the App/Play Store or the GOOSE VPN portal. 2) Log in with your GOOSE VPN account or create one directly via the app. 3) Choose your preferred server location or use the Smart Server option. 4) Slide the switch to connect to GOOSE VPN. Additional features include Autopilot for trusted networks and Cyber Alarm for enhanced security.

faqs.q: What should I do if GOOSE VPN does not connect?

faqs.q: How do I download and install GOOSE VPN on my Windows desktop?
faqs.a: To download and install GOOSE VPN on Windows: 1) Visit https://portal.goosevpn.com/download.php. 2) Choose your preferred language and select 'Download Software'. 3) Allow the download and accept the license agreement. 4) Follow the installation prompts, and upon completion, select 'Finish' to open the GOOSE VPN application.

faqs.q: How do I change the protocol GOOSE VPN uses?
faqs.a: To change the protocol in GOOSE VPN: 1) Open the GOOSE VPN client. 2) Click on the settings button (cogwheel icon). 3) Navigate to the 'Protocol' tab. 4) Select your desired protocol from the list. Note: This feature requires GOOSE version 3.1.6 or higher.

faqs.q: How do I know if GOOSE VPN is set up properly?
faqs.a: To verify GOOSE VPN setup: 1) Open the application and ensure the button below the GOOSE logo indicates 'Your connection is secured' with a green status. 2) Use GOOSE VPN's free online privacy check to confirm your connection is secure.

faqs.q: On what devices can I use GOOSE VPN?
faqs.a: GOOSE VPN is available on all devices. After creating an account, you can navigate to the download page to install the application on your preferred device.

faqs.q: How do I install GOOSE VPN with OpenVPN Connect on Windows?
faqs.a: To install GOOSE VPN with OpenVPN Connect on Windows: 1) Download the OpenVPN Connect app from https://openvpn.net/client-connect-vpn-for-windows/. 2) Install the app and download the .ovpn files from your GOOSE VPN account portal. 3) Import the .ovpn file into OpenVPN Connect, enter your GOOSE VPN credentials, and connect.

faqs.q: What is IvyForms?
faqs.a: IvyForms is a WordPress form builder plugin that provides a drag-and-drop visual builder, pre-built templates, entry management inside WordPress, spam protection, integrations (REST API, webhooks, Google Sheets, page-builder blocks), and other features to create contact forms, surveys, registrations and workflows without coding.

faqs.q: What core features does IvyForms offer?
faqs.a: IvyForms includes an AI-assisted builder, drag-and-drop form building, ready-to-use templates, 10+ field types, conditional logic, multi-step and conversational forms, form customization and styling, live preview, entry management, REST API, and built-in spam protection (reCAPTCHA, hCaptcha, Turnstile).

faqs.q: How do I create and publish a form with IvyForms?
faqs.a: After installing and activating the plugin in WordPress, open IvyForms in the dashboard, use the builder to add fields and configure Settings (name, description, store entries in database on/off). When ready, copy the shortcode (e.g. [ivyforms id=2]) from the builder and paste it into a page/post or use a page‑builder block to publish the form.

faqs.q: How can I embed IvyForms forms and which page builders are supported?
faqs.a: You can embed IvyForms forms via a simple shortcode or with dedicated integrations/blocks for page builders. IvyForms provides a Gutenberg block and explicit integrations for Elementor and Divi, allowing you to add forms directly inside those editors without shortcodes.

faqs.q: What spam protection options does IvyForms support and any important limitations?
faqs.a: IvyForms supports Google reCAPTCHA (v2, Invisible, v3), Cloudflare Turnstile, and hCaptcha as built-in spam-protection fields. Only one security field may be used per form (adding one disables the other security field options for that form).

faqs.q: Does IvyForms save form submissions in my WordPress database and can I disable that?
faqs.a: Yes — 'Store entries in database' is enabled by default for each form and can be disabled per form in General Settings. If database storage is disabled, submissions will not appear in the Entries table and must be received via email notifications (which require a working mail setup such as WP Mail SMTP or similar).

faqs.q: What integrations and developer options does IvyForms provide?
faqs.a: IvyForms supports integrations including Google Sheets, Slack, Square, webhooks, and page-builder integrations (Gutenberg/Elementor/Divi). For developer access and automation, IvyForms provides a REST API and webhooks to send entry data to external endpoints.

faqs.q: Can IvyForms work with AI assistants or external MCP (Machine Control Plane) clients?
faqs.a: Yes — IvyForms includes MCP support for AI assistants and explicitly integrates with Elementor’s AI assistant (Angie). The plugin can register an MCP server endpoint so AI assistants (including supported external MCP clients) can interact with IvyForms tools inside the WordPress admin.

faqs.q: How do I import or export forms between sites in IvyForms?
faqs.a: From the WordPress dashboard go to IvyForms → All Forms and click the Import forms button (icon beside + Form) to bring a form in from a file; the imported form will include entries and styles if they were included in the export file.

faqs.q: Are there special requirements or limits when submitting entries via IvyForms REST API?
faqs.a: Yes — API requests require the X-IvyForms-Api-Key header. Layout-only fields (e.g., html, section) and CAPTCHA fields are skipped when building submission payloads; CAPTCHA fields still require a solved token in the payload (e.g., turnstile_{fieldIndex}) and cannot be bypassed through the API.

faqs.q: What is Dashform?
faqs.a: Dashform is an AI-native quiz funnel builder and lead qualification platform that automatically generates intelligent lead qualification quizzes. It uses artificial intelligence to create relevant questions, scoring logic, and routing rules in under 60 seconds, helping businesses qualify leads efficiently.

faqs.q: How does Dashform's AI lead scoring work?
faqs.a: Dashform's AI lead scoring evaluates each quiz response on a 0–100 scale, classifying leads into three tiers: qualified (high-intent leads ready for sales), nurture (potential leads needing more engagement), and rejected (poor-fit leads). This automated scoring eliminates the need for manual rule configuration.

faqs.q: What integrations does Dashform support?
faqs.a: Dashform offers native integrations with Google Sheets, Notion, and Airtable for direct data synchronization. Additionally, it connects to over 5,000 apps via Zapier, including HubSpot, Salesforce, Mailchimp, Slack, and GoHighLevel. Webhook API support is also available for custom integrations.

faqs.q: How can I create a quiz with Dashform?
faqs.a: To create a quiz with Dashform, describe your product, service, or target audience in plain language. Dashform's AI will generate a complete quiz funnel with questions, scoring logic, and routing rules in under 60 seconds. You can then customize the questions, adjust scoring weights, add branding, and connect integrations before launching the quiz.

faqs.q: Can Dashform be used for client projects?
faqs.a: Yes, Dashform is suitable for client projects. Digital marketing agencies, coaches, consultants, and course creators use Dashform to build quiz funnels for lead generation campaigns, qualify discovery call leads, and recommend courses based on learner goals. White-label embedding allows agencies to deploy quizzes on client domains without Dashform branding.

faqs.q: How does Dashform compare to Typeform?
faqs.a: Unlike Typeform, which requires manual question creation and scoring configuration, Dashform uses artificial intelligence to generate complete quiz funnels automatically. This includes relevant questions, scoring logic, and routing rules, streamlining the lead qualification process.

faqs.q: Does Dashform offer custom branding options?
faqs.a: Yes, Dashform provides custom branding options, including the ability to remove Dashform branding, use custom domains, and embed quizzes as white-label solutions on client websites. These features are available in the Pro and Business plans.

faqs.q: What are the core capabilities of Dashform?
faqs.a: Dashform's core capabilities include AI quiz generation, AI lead scoring, smart routing, native integrations with tools like Google Sheets, Notion, and Airtable, connections to over 5,000 apps via Zapier, webhook API support, A/B testing, custom branding, and team collaboration features.

faqs.q: How fast can I create a quiz with Dashform?
faqs.a: With Dashform, you can generate a complete quiz funnel in under 60 seconds. By describing your product, service, or target audience, Dashform's AI creates relevant questions, scoring logic, and routing rules automatically, allowing for rapid deployment of lead qualification quizzes.

faqs.q: How many sites can I activate with a WP Captcha license purchased via AppSumo?
faqs.a: License site limits are set in the WP Captcha Dashboard when you create a license: you choose a Maximum Active Sites value for the key. For unlimited coverage the documentation notes you can create batches of 100 sites per license. You can also set the license validity (e.g., Forever or until a specific date) when creating the key.

faqs.q: Which captcha providers and types does WP Captcha support?
faqs.a: WP Captcha supports a built‑in captcha (no API key required) and additional providers including Google reCAPTCHA v2 and v3, hCaptcha (GDPR compatible), icon captcha, and Cloudflare Turnstile.

faqs.q: Can I show WP Captcha on forms other than the default WordPress login (for example WooCommerce, comments, or registration)?
faqs.a: Yes. The plugin’s settings let you choose where to show Captcha: default login forms, registration, lost password, comment forms, WooCommerce (login/registration/checkout), Easy Digital Downloads, and BuddyPress forms.

faqs.q: How do I configure which forms or pages display the Captcha?
faqs.a: In the plugin settings go to the “Where to Show” section and select the specific forms you want protected (Login Form, Registration Form, Lost Password Form, Comment Form, WooCommerce Registration/Checkout, EDD Registration, BuddyPress Registration, etc.), then save changes to apply the configuration.

faqs.q: What should I do if WP Captcha causes errors or my site breaks after installing it?
faqs.a: Common causes of WordPress breakages include plugin conflicts, theme compatibility issues, exhausted PHP memory, corrupted core files, or database problems. A safe troubleshooting checklist includes: create a full backup, check recent updates/changes, enable WP debugging to surface PHP errors, review server logs, deactivate plugins and re‑enable them one‑by‑one, switch to a default theme to test for theme conflicts, and restore core files or the database if needed. If unable to resolve, seek professional support.

faqs.q: DO I still have to create API keys for Google reCAPTCHA?
faqs.a: Yes, there's no way around that; it's Google's rules. You need per-site API keys. However, we have other built-in CAPTCHAs that don't require any configuration and simply need the plugin enabled. No cumbersome setup ;)

tldr: One bad plugin or experimental tweak can leave your WordPress site broken, and fixing it by hand takes hours. Luckily, WP Reset lets you reset, delete, or restore sections of your site, even after a hack.
highlights: Save favorite themes and plugins as Collections for new sites, and manage all sites, licenses, and Snapshots in one dashboard

**delete select portions of your site** to debug or streamline in record time, including removing all those unused widgets slowing you down

body:
WP Reset is a WordPress plugin that collectively installs themes and plugins, resets defaults, and takes snapshots of your website.




WP Reset lets you 
restore everything to default values
 without reinstalling WordPress or doing it all manually.


You can even reset or 
delete select portions of your site
 to debug or streamline in record time, including removing all those unused widgets slowing you down.


Get rid of all those pesky theme options and old content for a super fast rebrand.


You’ll also be able to 
completely rebrand the plugin and impress your clients
—logo, colors, name, and all—without touching a line of code.


 
 
 
 
 


Do a complete reset of your site in seconds, not hours!


Now that your site is all squeaky clean, it’s time to dress it up how you’ve always imagined.


Set up a development environment with Collections, a feature that lets you create a set of plugins and themes to 
bulk-install and activate from the cloud
.


WP developers will love how easy it is to get the design right, every time. 
And if you already use MainWP to manage your sites, 
enable the WP Reset MainWP Extension to get even faster results
.


 
 
 
 
 


Use Collections to make a set of your favorite plugins and themes for easy installation from the cloud!


WP Reset is also prepared for life’s little whoopsie-daisies (or big whoopsie-daisies, depending on who you ask).


Take a Snapshot of the site to store a copy
 of the current version to easily return to if need be.


You can also automate the process by letting WP Reset 
automatically take Snapshots depending on certain actions and events
.


These Snapshots are stored in WP Reset Cloud, Dropbox, Google Drive, or pCloud, so you’ll always have a copy waiting for you.


 
 
 
 
 


Create a Snapshot to easily return to a previous version of your site, then store copies in the cloud for guaranteed access.


Okay, so your site has been hacked or plagued by the dreaded white screen of death. No need to panic.


Even if you can’t access your site admin, you can 
use WP Reset’s Emergency Recovery Script to reclaim your website
.


This powerful feature comes with over 12 tools, including support for Snapshots to get your site out of any sticky situation.


Plus, you can recover a client site if you haven’t already installed the plugin. (
Not all heroes wear capes.
)


 
 
 
 
 


Use the Emergency Recovery Script to completely restore your site, even from the white screen of death!


The Dashboard is the central hub for 
controlling client licenses, sites, Collections, Snapshots, and Brands
.


Add a new site, block sites from using the WP Reset plugin, or enable white-labeling for one client but not another.


From the Dashboard, you can also 
access remote site actions
, including remote Snapshot stats, access to the Emergency Recovery Script, and license sync.


Plus, the license key is always hidden in the plugin—even without white-label turned on, so you don’t have to worry about prying eyes.


 
 
 
 
 

Control your Snapshots, Collections, client licenses, and more right from the Dashboard!


Sometimes instead of fixing something, you just need a do-over (case in point: tattoos of your high school sweetheart’s name and the last season of 
Game of Thrones
).


Whether excess plugins are slowing down your WordPress or you just want to repair your website, you need a tool you can depend on.


WP Reset makes it easy to rebuild your site from the ground up, and stores copies in the cloud so you’re prepared for the worst.


Get lifetime access to WP Reset today!

faqs.q: How do I activate WP Reset Pro with a license key?
faqs.a: To activate WP Reset Pro with a license key, navigate to Tools > WP Reset PRO in your WordPress dashboard, open the 'License' tab, enter your license key, and click the 'Save & Activate License' button.

faqs.q: What is the difference between WP Reset Free and Pro versions?
faqs.a: The Pro version of WP Reset offers three times more features than the free version, including Nuclear Site Reset, automatic snapshots, cloud storage options, collections, emergency recovery script, WP Reset Dashboard, license manager, and white-label options.

faqs.q: How can I manage my WP Reset Pro licenses?
faqs.a: You can manage your WP Reset Pro licenses through the WP Reset Dashboard, which allows you to control purchases, sites, licenses, snapshots, and collections from a centralized location.

faqs.q: Does WP Reset Pro replace traditional backup plugins?
faqs.a: No, WP Reset Pro does not replace conventional backup plugins. It works alongside them to provide better protection for your site.

faqs.q: What is the Emergency Recovery Script in WP Reset Pro?
faqs.a: The Emergency Recovery Script is a feature in WP Reset Pro that allows you to recover your WordPress site even if you can't access the admin area. It includes over 12 tools to help restore your site.

faqs.q: Can I move my WP Reset Pro license between sites?
faqs.a: Yes, you can move your WP Reset Pro license between sites. Once you deactivate the plugin on a site, the license goes back into your license pool, and you can activate it on another site.

faqs.q: How do I create and use Collections in WP Reset Pro?
faqs.a: To create and use Collections in WP Reset Pro, go to Tools > WP Reset Pro in your WordPress dashboard, navigate to the Collections tab, and create a new collection by adding your preferred plugins and themes. This allows you to install and activate them all with a single click.

faqs.q: What cloud storage options are available for storing snapshots in WP Reset Pro?
faqs.a: WP Reset Pro supports storing snapshots in WP Reset Cloud, Dropbox, Google Drive, and pCloud.

faqs.q: How can I prevent WP Reset Pro from consuming too much server space with snapshots?
faqs.a: You can control how and when WP Reset Pro takes snapshots from the settings. For example, you can automatically upload them to the Cloud and then delete them locally to prevent excessive server space usage.

faqs.q: Is WP Reset Pro compatible with WP-CLI?
faqs.a: Yes, WP Reset Pro supports WP-CLI. You can type 'wp reset' in your shell to see the list of available commands and options.

reviews_summary: Customers appreciate WP Reset Pro Plan, praising its ability to quickly reset, recover, and repair WordPress sites, the user-friendly interface that simplifies complex tasks, and the invaluable snapshot feature that provides peace of mind during updates. Recent updates have addressed concerns about excessive database snapshots, allowing users to set limits on space usage and the number of snapshots saved. The integration with MainWP has also enhanced its functionality. While there are still minor drawbacks, such as the need for individual logins for cloud uploads, these are manageable. Weighing the raves against the occasional grumbles, WP Reset Pro Plan is hitting the mark and is a solid buy for anyone looking to streamline their WordPress management. With a 60-day money-back guarantee, it's worth giving it a try!

faqs.a: Yes. ShopLentor supports both Elementor and Gutenberg, so you can choose the editor that best fits your WooCommerce workflow.

faqs.q: What happens if I purchased an earlier ShopLentor AppSumo deal?
faqs.a: Your existing plan limits and entitlements will remain unchanged. This new AppSumo launch will not reduce or replace the benefits included in your previous deal.

faqs.q: Will ShopLentor continue to receive updates and new features?
faqs.a: Yes. ShopLentor is actively developed, and our team continues to work on new features, modules, templates, compatibility improvements, and workflow enhancements. You can also follow our public roadmap and submit feature requests.

faqs.q: How many websites can I use ShopLentor on with my AppSumo plan?
faqs.a: Your website limit depends on the AppSumo tier you purchase. Tier 1 includes activation for up to 10 websites, while Tier 2 includes activation for up to 100 websites.

faqs.q: Do I need Elementor Pro to use ShopLentor?
faqs.a: No. Elementor Pro is not required to use ShopLentor. You can use ShopLentor with Elementor, and ShopLentor also supports Gutenberg for supported store-building workflows.

faqs.q: What WooCommerce templates can I build with ShopLentor?
faqs.a: ShopLentor supports custom templates for key WooCommerce areas, including Shop, Product, Cart, Checkout, My Account, Thank You, Quick View, Side Mini Cart, Popup, Email, and other store experiences.

faqs.q: Can ShopLentor replace multiple WooCommerce plugins?

Depending on your workflow, features such as Variation Swatches, Quick View, Wishlist, Partial Payment, Checkout Field Manager, Abandoned Cart, Currency Switcher, Email Automation, Free Shipping Bar, and more can reduce the need for separate plugins.

faqs.q: Where can I get support or submit feature requests?
faqs.a: For support, contact our team at [email redacted]. You can also follow planned improvements and submit feature requests through our public roadmap: https://woolentor.com/roadmaps/.

reviews_summary: Customers appreciate ShopLentor, praising its all-in-one functionality for building and customizing WooCommerce stores without the need for extensive coding knowledge. Users highlight the ability to create custom templates for various pages, including Shop, Product, Cart, and Checkout, as well as the inclusion of useful features like Variation Swatches and Sticky Add to Cart. While some users noted minor drawbacks such as the need for more pre-made templates and specific design controls, these are considered manageable. Overall, ShopLentor is an excellent choice for anyone looking to streamline their eCommerce setup. With a 60-day money-back guarantee, there's no reason not to give it a try!

body:
WP Scheduled Posts plugin is an editorial calendar tool that helps to streamline your content strategy and optimize productivity for your WordPress website
.
 



As your one-stop-shop for planning, creating, and scheduling blog posts on your WordPress site, WP Scheduled Posts makes it easy to stay on top of your content strategy and your content team.
 

Easily manage your scheduled and draft posts
 right from the stunning calendar (thanks to the tool’s widget) and get a full view of your content in the editorial calendar.
 

Schedule your WordPress posts in advance and manage all authors in one place.
 

 
 
 
 
 


Manage everything—and everyone—in one place
.


Ditch the spreadsheets and manage your posts with a convenient month-to-month look at your content.


Create, edit, and move posts easily with the 
intuitive drag-and-drop feature
.


Forgot to add a photo to a post? Easy. Need to reschedule a blog for another day? Done!


Keeping track of what and when you’re posting is already complicated enough. But throw in a co-author or content team and watch things really get crazy.


Whether you’re flying solo or collaborating on content, WP Scheduled Posts lets you 
manage multiple authors all in one place
.
 

 
 
 
 
 


Reschedule content easily with the calendar’s drag and drop feature
.
 

Plan your content and schedule hundreds of posts ahead of time by specifying the time and date you want the post to go live.
 

Then just set it and forget it—WP Scheduled Posts automatically publishes it for you! Yes, you can turn off those “Post Blog #274” reminders.
 

Also, WP Scheduled Posts 
easily integrates with Twitter and Facebook
.


So, once the post is live, WP Scheduled Posts will 
automatically share it on social media
. No need for third-party websites or another tool to do the auto-sharing on Twitter or Facebook.


 
 
 
 
 


Plan content ahead of time by specifying when you want it to go live
.


In a perfect world, scheduling a post on WordPress means that your content goes live at a designated time, every time.
 

In WordPress world, it means that sometimes this happens, and sometimes you’re hit with the Missed Schedule Error. Low blow, WordPress.
 

But now, you don’t have to worry; because this plugin comes equipped with a 
Missed Schedule Handler
 that comes through in the clutch to—you guessed it—handle any Missed Schedule Errors.
 

Leaving you to focus on the important things, like actually running your business. Or going on an off-the-grid getaway.
 

 
 
 
 
 


Automate your WordPress content and never worry about missing a post again
.


Your days of slaving over spreadsheets (MarchEdCal-FINALv5.xls) and setting endless iPhone reminders are over.
 

Now, you can finally take that vacation you’ve been dreaming about. And leave the laptop at home.
 

Get access to WP Scheduled Posts today
!


P.S.
 Learn how to use WP Scheduled Posts like a pro by catching our training webinar replay here: 
Webinar Replay
!

faqs.q: What are the key features of WP Scheduled Posts?
faqs.a: WP Scheduled Posts offers features such as a setup wizard for easy configuration, support for multiple post types, auto and manual scheduling options, a calendar view for managing content, and social media auto-posting to platforms like Facebook and Twitter.

faqs.q: How do I set up WP Scheduled Posts after installation?
faqs.a: After activating WP Scheduled Posts, a setup wizard will guide you through configuring display options, selecting supported post types, choosing scheduling methods (auto or manual), and setting up social media integrations.

faqs.q: Can WP Scheduled Posts handle custom post types?
faqs.a: Yes, WP Scheduled Posts supports custom post types, allowing you to schedule content for various types such as products, events, or videos.

faqs.q: How can I troubleshoot missed scheduled posts in WordPress?
faqs.a: To troubleshoot missed scheduled posts, ensure your WordPress timezone settings are correct, check for plugin conflicts by deactivating them one by one, and consider increasing your site's PHP memory limit if it's below 256M.

faqs.q: What should I do if my scheduled posts are not publishing?
faqs.a: If scheduled posts are not publishing, verify your timezone settings, check for plugin or theme conflicts, and ensure your server's cron jobs are functioning correctly.

faqs.q: How can I increase the PHP memory limit in WordPress?
faqs.a: To increase the PHP memory limit, edit your wp-config.php file and add the line define('WP_MEMORY_LIMIT', '256M'); just before the line that says, 'That's all, stop editing! Happy publishing.'

faqs.q: What role does WP-Cron play in scheduling posts?
faqs.a: WP-Cron is WordPress's internal scheduling system that handles tasks like publishing scheduled posts. It relies on site visits to trigger scheduled tasks, which can lead to missed schedules on low-traffic sites.

faqs.q: How can I set up a real cron job to replace WP-Cron?
faqs.a: To set up a real cron job, disable WP-Cron by adding define('DISABLE_WP_CRON', true); to your wp-config.php file, then create a server-side cron job to run wp-cron.php at regular intervals.

faqs.q: Are there plugins to help with missed scheduled posts?
faqs.a: Yes, plugins like 'Scheduled Post Trigger' and 'WP Missed Schedule' can help by checking for missed scheduled posts and publishing them automatically.

faqs.q: How do I check if my WordPress cron jobs are working?
faqs.a: You can use the 'WP Crontrol' plugin to view and manage your WordPress cron jobs, ensuring that scheduled tasks are running as expected.

faqs.q: What features does WP Social offer?
faqs.a: WP Social provides social login, social counter, and social share functionalities. It supports integration with major social platforms like Facebook, Google, Twitter, LinkedIn, and more. Users can customize login redirect URLs, display share buttons in various styles, and showcase social media follower counts.

faqs.q: How do I install and activate WP Social from the WordPress dashboard?
faqs.a:
To install and activate WP Social from the WordPress dashboard:
1. Navigate to Plugins → Add New.
2. Search for 'WP Social' in the search box.
3. Click 'Install Now' and wait for the installation to complete.
4. Click 'Activate' to activate the plugin.
After activation, WP Social controls will be available in your dashboard.

faqs.q: How can I configure WP Social for the first time?
faqs.a:
To configure WP Social for the first time:
1. Obtain an App ID and Secret Key from Facebook.
2. In your WordPress dashboard, navigate to WP Social's settings panel.
3. Enter the App ID and Secret Key under Basic Configuration.
4. Add your Facebook Page ID to the Synced Feeds section.
5. Save the changes to complete the configuration.

faqs.q: What should I do if the social login widget doesn't display?
faqs.a:
If the social login widget doesn't display:
1. Ensure you are logged out, as the widget is visible only to non-connected users.
2. If using a caching plugin, clear the cache to apply changes.
3. Check if any browser extensions, like Adblock Plus with 'antisocial filter' enabled, are blocking the widget.

faqs.q: How can I customize the appearance of social share buttons in WP Social?
faqs.a:
WP Social allows customization of social share buttons by offering:
- 54+ pre-built layouts.
- Options to display buttons horizontally or vertically.
- Ability to show or hide share counts.
- Selection from various icon styles and hover effects.
These settings can be configured through the plugin's admin panel.

faqs.q: Is WP Social GDPR compliant?
faqs.a: Yes, WP Social is GDPR compliant. It enables GDPR compliance before collecting users' social data and explains how the data is used and kept safe for their browsing experience.

faqs.q: Does WP Social support shortcode integration?
faqs.a: Yes, WP Social supports shortcode integration, allowing users to place social login, share, and counter features anywhere on their WordPress site without needing technical knowledge.

faqs.q: What should I do if my Facebook feed images are not displaying?
faqs.a:
If your Facebook feed images are not displaying:
1. Check the Display Options in WP Social settings.
2. Ensure that the 'Hide Feed Images' option is not checked.
3. Save the changes to apply the settings.

faqs.q: How can I ensure my Facebook page is publicly accessible for WP Social?
faqs.a:
To ensure your Facebook page is publicly accessible:
1. Log out of Facebook.
2. Visit your Facebook page URL.
3. If prompted to log in, your page is not public. Adjust your page's privacy settings to make it publicly accessible.

faqs.q: What should I do if my API key and email are not registering the plugin?
faqs.a:
If your API key and email are not registering the plugin:
1. Ensure the API key is entered correctly, including any prefixes.
2. Verify that the email address matches exactly, including case sensitivity, with the one used during purchase.
3. Confirm that the email used during purchase is the same as the one entered during registration.

faqs.q: Does Kalium support Elementor and the WordPress Block (Gutenberg) editor?
faqs.a: Yes. Kalium 4 provides full support for both Elementor and the Block Editor (Gutenberg), and includes starter sites prepared for both editors.

faqs.q: Is Kalium compatible with WooCommerce and what e‑commerce features are included?
faqs.a: Kalium is compatible with WooCommerce and Kalium 4 adds multiple store-focused features such as a Free Shipping Bar, Cart Drawer, List Layout, multiple gallery types, cards and card builder, filter drawer, checkout steps and a layout switcher to enhance WooCommerce stores.

faqs.q: What server requirements and PHP configuration limits does Kalium recommend?
faqs.a: Kalium’s documentation recommends using the latest WordPress, PHP 7.4 or greater (Kalium is compatible with PHP 8.5), MySQL 8.0 or MariaDB 10.5 or greater, HTTPS support, and WordPress minimum requirements. Recommended PHP settings include increasing limits such as max_execution_time (example: 120–180), memory_limit (128M), post_max_size (32–64M), upload_max_filesize (32–64M), max_input_time (60) and max_input_vars (3000) to avoid import/save issues.

faqs.q: How do I import Kalium starter sites / demo content?
faqs.a: After installing Kalium you import starter sites from the Kalium dashboard’s Starter Sites section (preview then import). Laborator’s documentation notes that demo content import requires the theme to be registered and that demo content can be imported into both parent and child themes.

faqs.q: Where are Kalium’s theme options managed (how do I customize the theme)?
faqs.a: Kalium’s theme options are managed through the WordPress Customizer (live customizer) where you can edit and preview theme settings such as colors, layouts and widgets in real time.

faqs.q: If I encounter blank pages or import failures, what troubleshooting steps does Kalium recommend?
faqs.a: Kalium documentation advises checking server/PHP limits (memory, execution time, upload limits) via Kalium > Status and increasing them if low; raising limits (examples provided) or asking the host to increase them typically resolves issues like white screens, failed demo imports, blank pages or save failures. If needed, open a support ticket through Kalium’s support resources.

faqs.q: How can I set up a custom domain for my Tiny Talk chatbot?
faqs.a:
To set up a custom domain for your Tiny Talk chatbot, follow these steps:

1. **Enter Your Subdomain in Tiny Talk**:
 - Log into the Tiny Talk Dashboard.
 - Select the chatbot you want to configure.
 - Navigate to the 'Domains' tab under the 'Settings' page.
 - Enter your desired subdomain (e.g., `chat.example.com`).
 - Copy the provided CNAME and TXT records.

2. **Add DNS Records at Your Domain Provider**:
 - Log in to your domain provider's DNS management section.
 - Add a CNAME record pointing your subdomain to `proxy.tinytalk.ai`.
 - Add a TXT record for verification as specified by Tiny Talk.

3. **Verify in Tiny Talk**:
 - Return to the Tiny Talk Dashboard.
 - Click the 'Verify' button to confirm the DNS records are correctly set up.

For detailed instructions, refer to the [Chatbot Custom Domain Setup Guide](https://tinytalk.ai/docs/chatbot-custom-domain-setup-g

Replace `{BOT_ID}` with your specific bot's ID. For more details, visit the [Embed & Integrate](https://tinytalk.ai/docs/embed-and-integrate) page.

faqs.q: Does Tiny Talk support multilingual conversations?
faqs.a: Yes, Tiny Talk supports cross-language conversations, allowing chatbots to engage with users in multiple languages. This feature enables businesses to provide support and assistance to users regardless of their preferred language.

faqs.q: How can I integrate Tiny Talk with my existing systems?
faqs.a: Tiny Talk provides an API that allows you to interact with your chatbots programmatically. The Chat Completions API enables you to create a natural back-and-forth conversation experience by sending a series of messages as input and receiving model-generated messages as output. This API is available to users on paid plans. For more information, refer to the [API Reference](https://tinytalk.ai/docs/api-reference).

faqs.q: What is the Human Takeover feature in Tiny Talk?
faqs.a: The Human Takeover feature in Tiny Talk allows for a seamless transition between AI-driven chatbot interactions and human support. When a complex issue arises that the AI might not fully grasp, human support can take over to provide specialized attention. This ensures that all customer inquiries are addressed precisely, enhancing customer satisfaction. For a detailed guide on setting up this feature, see [Introducing Human Takeover: A Guide from Setup to Success](https://tinytalk.ai/blog/introducing-human-takeover-a-guide-from-setup-to-success).

faqs.q: How can I customize lead generation forms in Tiny Talk?
faqs.a:
Tiny Talk's lead generation feature allows you to capture and qualify leads with custom form fields. To set up custom lead forms:

1. **Enable Lead Generation**:
 - Go to the 'Qualify Leads' section in your dashboard and enable Lead Qualification.

2. **Define Qualification Form Messages**:
 - Customize the messages shown before and after the form to engage users.

3. **Create Custom Attributes**:
 - In the 'Attributes' section, create attributes such as name, key, and data type.

4. **Build Your Lead Form**:
 - Add, remove, or reorder attributes to tailor the lead form to your needs.

For a comprehensive guide, refer to [Tiny Talk’s Latest Feature Upgrade: Custom Form Fields](https://tinytalk.ai/blog/custom-form-fields-lead-generation).

faqs.q: What is GPT-4o, and how does it enhance Tiny Talk chatbots?
faqs.a: GPT-4o is an optimized variant of OpenAI’s GPT-4, designed for greater efficiency and performance. It offers faster response times, improved accuracy, and cost-effective scalability. Tiny Talk's integration with GPT-4o enhances chatbot interactions by providing more accurate and personalized responses, thereby improving customer service and user engagement. Learn more at [OpenAI GPT-4o is Now Available on Tiny Talk!](https://tinytalk.ai/blog/open-ai-gpt-4o-is-now-available-on-tiny-talk).

faqs.q: How can I get started with Tiny Talk's dashboard?
faqs.a:
To get started with Tiny Talk's dashboard:

1. **Create a Chatbot**:
 - Log in to the Tiny Talk Dashboard.
 - Click on 'Create Bot' and follow the prompts to set up your chatbot.

2. **Upload Documents**:
 - Add documents, PDFs, or technical content to train your chatbot.

3. **Embed the Chatbot**:
 - Use the provided embedding options to integrate the chatbot into your website.

For a detailed walkthrough, visit [Getting Started in the Dashboard](https://tinytalk.ai/docs/getting-started-in-the-dashboard).

faqs.q: What are the key features of Tiny Talk chatbots?
faqs.a:
Tiny Talk chatbots offer several key features:

- **Seamless Conversations**: Enabled by powerful language processing.
- **Train Contextual Chatbots**: Leverage existing documents and technical content.
- **Embeddable Widgets**: Easily integrate chatbots into your website.
- **Semantic Search**: Utilize advanced search algorithms for precise answers.
- **Customizable and Scalable**: Tailor chatbots to fit brand requirements and scale operations.
- **Cross-Language Conversation**: Engage with users in multiple languages.
- **No-Code Platform**: Build and customize chatbots without coding knowledge.

For more information, visit [Tiny Talk AI – Custom AI Chatbots for Business](https://tinytalk.ai/).
