faqs.a: AI Emaily lists support for Gmail (One Click Login), Outlook (One Click Login), iCloud, Fastmail, Proton and any IMAP provider, and it provides clients for web, macOS and Windows, iOS App (Android listed as coming soon).

faqs.q: Do lifetime/ltd listings for AI Emaily include team seats or multi-seat plans?
faqs.a: Third-party lifetime-deal listings for AI Emaily describe multiple lifetime plan shapes that include team-oriented lifetime tiers with team seats (for example, LTD listings note team/agency lifetime tiers that include multiple team seats and shared inbox features); specific seat counts and credits are listed on the lifetime-deal listing for each tier.

faqs.q: Is Autopilot included?
faqs.a: Autopilot is the mode where it acts on its own inside rules you set. It's on Tier 3 and up, available from day one, and every action it takes is logged. Tiers 1 and 2 run Copilot: it drafts on demand, you approve & send.

faqs.q: Do I have to switch email providers?
faqs.a: No. Keep your address, your provider and your existing folders. AI Emaily works on top of them.

faqs.q: What does one AI credit actually buy?
faqs.a:
At current rates:
→ Sorting one new email: 0.1 credit (so 1,000 emails ≈ 100 credits)
→ Thread summary, rewrite or translate: 0.5
→ AI reply draft: 1
→ Ask AI a question across your inbox: 1
→ Autopilot reply that sends: 2
→ Living Brief delivered to Slack, Discord or Telegram: 3

More details https://aiemaily.com/docs/ai-credits

faqs.q: What happens if I run out of credits?
faqs.a: The AI features pause until your monthly refill. The email client keeps working normally, including reading, sending, sync, search, and spam and phishing protection. You can wait for the refill, [buy a top-up pack,] or on Tier 3 and up plug in your own API key, which isn't capped by credits. One thing worth knowing: to keep costs sane, automatic AI sorting pauses on a mailbox you haven't opened in about a week, and resumes when you come back.

faqs.q: Do unused credits roll over?
faqs.a: Monthly credits don't. They refresh on the 1st of every month (UTC) and get used first. Your one-time credits never expire and carry over month to month until you use them.

faqs.q: Can I upgrade my tier later?
faqs.a: Yes. Upgrade on AppSumo and your account moves to the new tier automatically. You keep everything, and you get the difference in one-time credits added (for example, Tier 1 to Tier 3 adds 1,500).

faqs.q: Where is my data stored, and can I delete it?
faqs.a: Message bodies are encrypted and kept in object storage on servers we run in the EU. Your mailbox passwords, sign-in tokens and API keys are encrypted too. Disconnect a mailbox will delete all of your data for that mailbox and Deleting an account will delete all the account data.

faqs.q: Will it send emails on my behalf without asking?
faqs.a: Not unless you turn that on. Copilot is the default: AI Emaily drafts, and nothing goes out until you press send. Every send you make also gets a 10-second undo. Tiers 1 and 2 are Copilot only. On Tier 3 and up you can switch on Autopilot for the senders and topics you choose (next question).

faqs.q: How does Autopilot work, and how do I keep control?
faqs.a: Autopilot only sends to senders that match a rule you wrote. It stays out of anything containing an escalation word you've flagged, and it can be limited to your working hours. Every Autopilot reply waits in a queue (5 minutes by default, adjustable) with a visible countdown and a cancel button. Pausing Autopilot stops anything already queued. Every action goes into an audit log. We suggest starting in Copilot and turning on Autopilot for one kind of email once you trust the drafts.

faqs.q: How does it write in my voice?
faqs.a: You set it up. The Context brain holds your tone, your standing facts and your guardrails. Client profiles hold what matters for a specific client, like contracts, project status and reference files. Variables fill in names, links and numbers. It also uses your own sent replies to match your style, and you can turn that off. With style matching on, your style profile refreshes weekly from your recent sent replies, including drafts you edited before sending.

faqs.q: How accurate is the sorting, and what if it gets something wrong?
faqs.a: Every call it makes shows its reason, so you can see why something was filed. When it gets one wrong, move it back. Marking a message "Not cold" adds that sender and their domain to your allowlist, so they aren't flagged again. You can also write your own rules for anything you always want handled a certain way. We don't publish an accuracy percentage we can't back up. Try it on your real inbox during the refund window.

faqs.q: Can I bring my own API key?
faqs.a: Yes, on Tier 3 and up. You can use OpenRouter, OpenAI, Anthropic or Google. AI Emaily checks the key when you add it and stores it encrypted. With your own key, AI use isn't limited by credits. You pay your provider directly.

faqs.q: How do team seats work?
faqs.a: Tiers 1 and 2 are single-user. Tier 3 includes 6 seats and Tier 4 includes 15, counting you. Teammates get a shared inbox, can assign threads to each other (with an AI handoff note), and can comment with @mentions. Roles run from viewer to owner. Each teammate gets their own monthly AI credits and can connect their own mailboxes (2 each on Tier 3, 3 on Tier 4).

faqs.q: Which apps and languages are available?
faqs.a:
AI Emaily runs on the web, macOS (Apple silicon), Windows, iPhone and Android. Everything syncs, so you can start a reply at your desk and approve it from your phone.

The app is available in 21 languages: English, Spanish, Portuguese (Brazil), French, German, Italian, Dutch, Danish, Polish, Turkish, Indonesian, Vietnamese, Russian, Japanese, Korean, Chinese (Simplified), Chinese (Traditional), Hebrew, Arabic, Hindi and Thai. Arabic and Hebrew get a full right-to-left layout.

faqs.q: What does it integrate with?
faqs.a:
→ Google Calendar: create and manage events from email (Outlook calendar isn't supported yet)
→ Slack, Discord and Telegram: your Living Brief delivered where you already look
→ Public API: on every tier. Outbound webhooks: 2 on Tier 3, 5 on Tier 4

There's no Zapier or CRM integration yet. Tell us which one you need in the comments. That's how we decide what's next.

faqs.q: What's your refund policy, and how do I get help?
faqs.a: You have AppSumo's full refund window [60 days]. If you refund, your account drops to the free plan, and your mailboxes and data stay put in case you come back. For help, email [email redacted], use live chat in the app, or check the docs at aiemaily.com/docs. I'm also in these comments every day of the launch.

reviews_summary: Customers appreciate AI Emaily, praising its ability to consolidate multiple inboxes into one, the impressive AI drafting that captures their voice, and the effective cold email protection that declutters their inbox. While some users noted minor issues with syncing, these are just small bumps on the road. Overall, AI Emaily is making waves and is a solid buy for anyone looking to streamline their email management. With a 60-day money-back guarantee, it's worth giving it a try!

faqs.q: What languages does WordHero support?

faqs.q: Does WordHero have a built-in plagiarism checker?
faqs.a: Currently, WordHero does not have a built-in plagiarism checker. However, the AI technology used by WordHero is based on a generative language model and does not lift content from online sources, reducing the risk of plagiarism.

faqs.q: Does WordHero completely replace the need for writers?
faqs.a: While WordHero’s AI technology is advanced, it does not completely replace the need for writers. A human touch is still required to edit and refine the output generated by WordHero.

faqs.q: What technology does WordHero use?
faqs.a: WordHero is powered by state-of-the-art language models GPT-4o and GPT-4o mini, which have been trained with 175 billion parameters to understand prompts and generate human-like text.

faqs.q: How can I access my saved documents in WordHero?
faqs.a: In the Editor toolbar, click the 'Open a document' button to access your previously saved documents. WordHero has an automatic saving feature that saves any changes made to your document.

faqs.q: Can multiple users access the same WordHero account at the same time?
faqs.a: WordHero only permits one active session at a time. If you sign in on a different device using the same account, it will automatically log out the first session.

faqs.q: Does WordHero offer API access?
faqs.a: Currently, WordHero does not provide API access. While this limits integration with other tools, the comprehensive features offered within the platform make up for it.

faqs.q: How many templates does WordHero provide?
faqs.a: WordHero provides access to over 80 templates, catering to various content creation needs, from blog posts to email marketing.

reviews_summary: Customers appreciate WordHero - AI Content Writer, praising its ability to generate original content quickly, its user-friendly interface, and the unlimited output feature that enhances writing efficiency. faqs.q: How does Foyer integrate with my website?
faqs.a: Foyer integrates with your website by embedding a script tag. After creating an agent in the Foyer app, you copy the install snippet and paste it onto your site. This method works with various platforms, including Webflow, WordPress, Shopify, Framer, React, and plain HTML.

faqs.q: What content does Foyer use to answer visitor questions?
faqs.a: Foyer crawls your entire site, including features, pricing, FAQs, and case studies, to build a private knowledge base. The voice agent answers visitor questions using only your content, ensuring accurate and relevant responses.

faqs.q: Can Foyer support multiple languages?
faqs.a: Yes, Pro and Custom agents automatically detect the language a visitor is speaking and switch in real time. The agent can carry the conversation in any supported language for the selected voice. Free agents can speak any supported language, with one language per agent and no automatic switching.

faqs.q: How does Foyer capture leads?
faqs.a: Foyer reads buying intent in real time. When a visitor is ready, it asks for their name and email naturally within the conversation. The conversion happens through voice, and every lead and transcript lands in your dashboard with context attached.

faqs.q: What happens if I run out of minutes on my Foyer plan?
faqs.a: If you run out of minutes, the widget hides itself from your site to prevent a broken button. Your pages continue to function normally, and all previously captured leads and conversations remain in your dashboard. To reactivate the agent, you can upgrade your plan or top up minutes from the dashboard.

faqs.q: Does Foyer recognize returning visitors?
faqs.a: Yes, when a visitor returns to your site, the agent recognizes them and brings their past conversations and details into the new one. This ensures they don't have to repeat their name or previous inquiries, as the agent picks up where the last conversation ended.

faqs.q: What analytics does Foyer provide?
faqs.a: Paid plans unlock a full analytics dashboard for each agent, including visitor counts (unique vs. returning vs. engaged), country, device, browser, OS, time spent on your site versus time spent in conversation with the agent, click and keypress activity, and a daily breakdown of every metric.

reviews_summary: Customers appreciate Foyer, praising its quick setup and the valuable lead capture insights it provides. Users find the voice agent helpful in guiding visitors and answering questions effectively. There are minor drawbacks, such as limited customization options, but these are being addressed. Overall, Foyer is making waves with its functionality and support. With a 60-day money-back guarantee, it’s a risk-free opportunity to enhance your website—definitely worth a try!

faqs.q: What is ProductBridge?
faqs.a: ProductBridge is an AI-powered product management platform that helps you collect user feedback, analyze it with AI, plan roadmaps, and publish changelogs—all in one place.

faqs.q: How does ProductBridge handle duplicate feature requests?
faqs.a: ProductBridge's AI detects overlapping feedback before duplicates are created, prompting users to vote on existing posts instead of creating new ones. This real-time semantic similarity check helps maintain accurate vote counts and priorities.

faqs.q: Does ProductBridge have a changelog feature?
faqs.a: Yes, ProductBridge includes a built-in changelog that allows you to announce new features, improvements, and fixes, keeping your users informed about what's new.

faqs.q: Is ProductBridge suitable for startups?
faqs.a: Yes, ProductBridge is designed to cater to both startups and enterprises, providing a single source of truth for product decisions, whether you're shipping fast or managing thousands of feature requests.

faqs.q: How do customers get notified when a feature they requested ships?

faqs.q: How do I prioritize which features to build?
faqs.a: ProductBridge allows you to prioritize features based on real user demand by linking feedback directly to roadmap items and using AI to analyze sentiment and detect trends.

faqs.q: Can I manage feedback for multiple organizations in one account?
faqs.a: Yes, ProductBridge supports managing feedback for multiple organizations within a single account, providing a centralized platform for all your product management needs.

faqs.q: Can I create private or internal-only feedback boards?
faqs.a: Yes, ProductBridge allows you to control visibility with public boards, internal boards, and segment-based boards for specific user groups, ensuring structured and organized feedback management.

highlights: Turn your PDFs into online Flipbooks with FlipLink
Customize, analyze, and share how they perform

faqs.q: What is FlipLink.me?
faqs.a: FlipLink.me is an online platform that transforms static PDF files into interactive 3D flipbooks or scrollable documents. Users can upload a PDF, customize the experience with branding, lead capture, analytics, and sharing options, and then share a single link for a rich, engaging viewing experience on any device.

faqs.q: What are the differences between Flipbooks and Documents in FlipLink.me?
faqs.a: Flipbooks utilize a 3D page-turning effect powered by WebGL, providing an immersive book-like experience with sound effects and background music. Documents, on the other hand, use a PDF.js-based scrollable viewer with native text selection, in-document search, and slide mode. The choice between the two is permanent at creation time and cannot be changed later.

faqs.q: How do I create my first flipbook on FlipLink.me?
faqs.a: To create your first flipbook, sign up for free on FlipLink.me, click 'Create New' on the dashboard, choose either Flipbook or Document type, upload your PDF, customize settings such as branding, lead capture, and privacy, and then click 'Publish'. You'll receive a shareable link, QR code, and embed code instantly.

faqs.q: Is there a free trial available for FlipLink.me?
faqs.a: Yes, FlipLink.me offers a free trial that provides access to every feature, including lead capture, analytics, branding, password protection, voice assistant, and all sharing options. No credit card is required, allowing users to create their first flipbook in minutes and explore the full platform before making a purchase.

faqs.q: What file formats does FlipLink.me support?
faqs.a: FlipLink.me accepts PDF files. Users can upload their PDFs, which are automatically converted into interactive flipbooks or scrollable documents. The maximum file size is 40 MB on the free plan and 150 MB on all paid plans.

faqs.q: Is FlipLink.me compatible with mobile devices?
faqs.a: Yes, all flipbooks and documents created with FlipLink.me are fully responsive. Flipbooks automatically switch to single-page mode on mobile portrait orientation for optimal reading experience, while documents use a responsive scroll layout. Both formats work seamlessly on iOS, Android, and tablets.

faqs.q: Can I use my own domain with FlipLink.me?
faqs.a: Yes, FlipLink.me allows users to add unlimited custom domains via CNAME, enabling flipbooks to be served from your own branded domain instead of go.fliplink.me. This feature includes auto-provisioned SSL certificates and DNS verification, ensuring a seamless and professional experience for your audience.

faqs.q: Does FlipLink.me offer analytics for my flipbooks?
faqs.a: Yes, FlipLink.me provides comprehensive analytics and insights, allowing users to track every interaction with their content. Metrics include views, unique visitors, average time spent, device breakdown, geographic data, referral sources, and per-page engagement heatmaps. Analytics can also be shared via a password-protected public link.

faqs.q: Can I monetize my PDFs using FlipLink.me?
faqs.a: Yes, FlipLink.me enables users to monetize their PDFs directly with Stripe-powered paywalls. Users can set prices in over 130 currencies, offer preview PDFs before the paywall, customize purchase buttons, and receive payments directly to their own Stripe account, with no marketplace fees.

faqs.q: Does FlipLink.me offer an affiliate or referral program?
faqs.a: As of May 2025, FlipLink.me does not have an affiliate program available due to its ongoing AppSumo deal. However, the team is actively working on implementing an affiliate program once they transition to a subscription model, allowing affiliates to earn regular income through the program.

reviews_summary: 'Customers are all about FlipLink.me, praising its highly customizable features, seamless document sharing, and robust tracking capabilities. The platform's ease of use, responsive support, and lead capture feature are also highly praised. There are a few hiccups like slow upload speeds and the inability to embed YouTube videos directly, just small bumps on the road. Weighing the raves against the occasional grumbles, FlipLink.me is hitting the mark and is a solid buy for those in need of a versatile flipbook creator. Given the 60-day money-back guarantee, it's worth giving it a try.'

faqs.q: How do credits work?
faqs.a: Every action in the app costs a set number of credits, except creating characters and a book description, which is free. Writing costs vary by model: chapter outlines are 3 credits, and writing a full chapter runs 15 credits with Gemini, 20 with Grok, or 30 with Claude. AI chat edits cost 5 credits. Images cost 15–30 credits, covering illustrations (15), image edits (15), visual book pages (20), and book covers (30). Audiobook chapters cost 1 credit per 25 characters, and book translation costs 15 + 30 credits, uncapped. Reference files cost 10 credits each, author tools run 10–15 credits, and text-analysis tools cost per 1,000 words: 10 credits for the AI content detector and 25 credits for the AI text humanizer.

faqs.q: What is AIWriteBook?
faqs.a: AIWriteBook is an all-in-one AI writing assistant designed to help authors and creators transform their ideas into polished books efficiently. It streamlines the entire process from initial concept to a fully formatted manuscript ready for publishing.

faqs.q: What types of content can I create with AIWriteBook?
faqs.a: With AIWriteBook, you can create various types of content, including books, stories, articles, and guides. The platform handles everything from outlining to final drafts, enabling faster publication.

faqs.q: How does AIWriteBook assist in writing novels?
faqs.a: AIWriteBook assists in novel writing by generating a cast of characters, a chapter-by-chapter plot, and full prose based on your initial premise. It ensures consistency in characters and plot throughout the novel.

faqs.q: Can I import existing manuscripts into AIWriteBook?
faqs.a: Yes, AIWriteBook allows you to upload existing manuscripts, notes, or partial drafts in formats such as .doc, .docx, .pdf, .epub, .rtf, .txt, or .md. The AI continues from where you left off, eliminating the need to start over.

faqs.q: Does AIWriteBook support multiple languages?
faqs.a: Yes, AIWriteBook supports over 30 languages, including Japanese, enabling authors to write and publish in their preferred language.

faqs.q: What export formats are available in AIWriteBook?
faqs.a: AIWriteBook allows you to export your finished content in multiple formats, including EPUB, PDF, and DOCX, making it ready for publishing, printing, or sharing.

faqs.q: How does AIWriteBook ensure the generated content matches my writing style?

faqs.q: What's included in each license tier?

faqs.q: What's a workspace, and how many do I need?
faqs.a: A workspace is a separate environment for a brand, company, region, or client, with its own content, brand voice, channels, and team members. One workspace is enough for most single-brand teams. Agencies managing multiple clients can choose a higher tier with more workspaces.

faqs.q: How do AI credits work?
faqs.a: Each workspace receives a recurring monthly allowance of AI credits for text generation and AI agent usage. Your allowance depends on your license tier and refreshes monthly. Image and video generation are not included in these recurring credits.

faqs.q: Which channels can I publish to?

faqs.q: Can I purchase additional AI credits?

faqs.q: Are there limits on articles and social posts?

faqs.q: Is this really lifetime access? What about future updates?
faqs.a: Yes. Your purchase provides lifetime access to the StoryChief features and limits included in your selected tier, subject to the deal terms. Updates to those included features are covered. Future premium features, new AI capabilities, and usage-based services may be offered separately.

faqs.q: Can I upgrade my license tier later?

faqs.a: No. This AppSumo offer is exclusively for new StoryChief Appsumo customers. Existing paying customers cannot switch or migrate their subscriptions to an AppSumo license. StoryChief automatically detects existing accounts and blocks access to the AppSumo deal.

faqs.q: What is Vocable.ai?
faqs.a: Vocable.ai is an AI-powered content operations platform designed to streamline the entire content marketing lifecycle. It enables users to ideate, plan, draft, collaborate, and optimize multi-channel content within a centralized workflow.

faqs.q: Who can benefit from using Vocable.ai?
faqs.a: Vocable.ai is ideal for coaches, consultants, small business owners, content teams, and process-driven creators seeking to automate and scale their content marketing efforts efficiently.

faqs.q: What features does Vocable.ai offer?
faqs.a: Key features include automated content planning, brand voice management, automated AI drafting, AI-powered entry editor, content distribution, and team collaboration tools.

faqs.q: How does Vocable.ai differ from other AI content tools?
faqs.a: Unlike other AI tools that provide isolated content generation, Vocable.ai offers a complete system that integrates all stages of content marketing into one cohesive, automated workflow, eliminating the need for repetitive tasks and constant manual prompting.

faqs.q: What types of content can I create with Vocable.ai?
faqs.a: Vocable.ai specializes in generating high-quality, long-form written content, focusing on formats such as blog posts, YouTube scripts, email newsletters, LinkedIn articles and posts, Twitter threads, quizzes, and guides. The platform does not produce graphics, images, or videos.

faqs.q: How do I contact customer support for more information or questions?
faqs.a: Please reach out to [email redacted] for any further questions or customer support requests.

faqs.q: Can Vocable.ai be used to create individual content plans for each social media account?
faqs.a: Yes, you can create content campaigns for individual channels by selecting a specific channel when creating your campaign. For example, you can create a 30-day plan for LinkedIn posts tailored to your profile and core ideas.

faqs.q: Does Vocable.ai post to social media channels and WordPress blogs?
faqs.a: Currently, Vocable.ai allows publishing blogs directly to Webflow, Wix, and WordPress. For LinkedIn, you can publish posts (not articles, as LinkedIn's API only allows for posts publishing) directly from Vocable. For LinkedIn articles, you will need to copy and paste the content into LinkedIn's article editor.

faqs.q: Does Vocable.ai differentiate articles produced for Medium, LinkedIn, and blog posts?
faqs.a: Yes, Vocable.ai differentiates content for various platforms. Medium is categorized under the blog channel, and when you select LinkedIn as a channel, it generates both LinkedIn posts and LinkedIn articles distinctively.

faqs.q: What AI models does Vocable.ai utilize, and will they be updated over time?
faqs.a: Vocable.ai utilizes models such as GPT-4, GPT-4o, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Claude 3.7 Sonnet, Claude Opus, Gemini 2.0 Flash, 1.5 Flash, and 1.5 Pro. The platform plans to add more models in the near future, including DeepSeek and Grok.

reviews_summary: 'Customers are all about Vocable AI, praising its efficient content creation process, high-quality output, and user-friendly interface. The cherry on top is its ability to generate high-quality content across multiple channels with a personalized brand voice. There are a few hiccups like the lack of image generation and occasional language issues, just small bumps on the road. Weighing the raves against the occasional grumbles, Vocable AI is hitting the mark and is a solid buy for those in need of AI-powered content management. Given the 60-day money-back guarantee, it's worth giving it a try.'

faqs.q: What does Internal Linking of Related Contents do?
faqs.a: Internal Linking Related Contents automatically displays relevant posts within your WordPress content. Related posts can appear individually throughout an article or together in a grouped section, helping visitors discover more content on your website.

faqs.q: How does the plugin find related content?
faqs.a: You can select related content using categories, tags, post titles, custom keywords or the AI Engine. Each search method offers a different level of control over how related posts are selected.

faqs.q: What is the difference between the AI Engine and standard search methods?
faqs.a: Standard search methods match content using WordPress data such as categories, tags, titles and custom keywords. The AI Engine analyses the meaning and context of each article to identify semantically related posts.

faqs.q: Which AI providers are supported?
faqs.a: The AI Engine supports OpenAI and locally hosted Ollama models, allowing you to choose between a cloud-based service and a local AI solution.

faqs.q: Does the AI Engine support custom post types?
faqs.a: The AI Engine is currently available for standard WordPress posts. Custom post types, including WooCommerce products, can use the plugin's standard search methods.

faqs.q: Can i display related content on WordPress pages?
faqs.a: Yes. Related content can be enabled for WordPress pages and custom post types. Pages can be connected through parent-child relationships or custom keywords.

faqs.q: Can i control where related posts appear?
faqs.a: Yes, you can automatically insert related posts at configurable paragraph intervals, group them in a specific location or manually place them using a shortcode or Gutenberg block.

faqs.q: Can i exclude specific posts, categories or tags?
faqs.a: Yes, you can exclude individual posts or prevent content from selected categories and tags from appearing in the related-post results.

faqs.q: Can i choose which devices display related content?
faqs.a: Yes, related content can be displayed on all devices or limited to desktop, tablet or mobile devices.

faqs.q: Can i manually select or insert related posts?
faqs.a: Yes, the shortcode generator and Gutenberg block allow you to insert related content in a specific location. The documentation also includes advanced and archive shortcode options for more specialized layouts.

faqs.q: Is the plugin compatible with AMP pages?
faqs.a: Yes, the plugin supports AMP and is designed to display related content consistently on both standard and AMP-enabled pages.

reviews_summary: Customers appreciate Internal Linking Related Contents for its seamless automated internal linking, customizable templates, and stellar customer support. Some users wish for more advanced features and a more user-friendly dashboard. With an overall rating of 4.8 and positive feedback, it's a solid buy for those in need of an efficient internal linking solution. Plus, with a 60-day money-back guarantee, it's worth giving it a try.

faqs.q: What is KeyShift AI and how does it work?
faqs.a: KeyShift AI is a desktop productivity tool that integrates AI-powered text transformations directly into any application you use. By typing 'keyshift+' followed by an instruction (e.g., 'keyshift+translate to French'), you can rewrite, translate, or modify text in place without switching tabs or copying and pasting.

faqs.q: How do I install KeyShift AI?
faqs.a: To install KeyShift AI, visit the official website and download the application compatible with your operating system (Windows or macOS). Follow the on-screen instructions to complete the installation process.

faqs.q: What keyboard shortcuts are available in KeyShift AI?
faqs.a: KeyShift AI offers several keyboard shortcuts to enhance your workflow: Quick Actions (Ctrl+Shift+A), Command Palette (Ctrl+K), Voice Input (Ctrl+Shift+M), Clipboard AI (Ctrl+Shift+V), and Workflows for multi-step processes.

faqs.q: Can I create custom AI modes in KeyShift AI?
faqs.a: Yes, KeyShift AI allows you to build reusable AI prompts tailored to your workflow, such as legal tone, TLDR summaries, technical writing, or brand voice.

faqs.q: Does KeyShift AI work with all applications?
faqs.a: KeyShift AI is designed to work in every application on your system, including Discord, Slack, WhatsApp, X, and more.

faqs.q: What should I do if the keyboard shortcuts aren't working?
faqs.a: If the keyboard shortcuts aren't functioning as expected, ensure that KeyShift AI is running and that no other applications are using the same shortcuts. You can also customize the hotkeys within the app's settings.

faqs.q: How does KeyShift AI handle user data and privacy?
faqs.a: KeyShift AI ensures that your prompts, selections, and clipboard content are never used to train models. Your clipboard history remains on your device and only leaves when you choose to run an AI action on a specific item. Additionally, you can connect your own OpenAI, Anthropic, or Google API key, ensuring your text goes directly to the provider without being seen by KeyShift AI.

reviews_summary: Customers appreciate Keyshift AI, praising its seamless integration for rewriting, translating, and summarizing across any app, the convenience of custom shortcuts, and the flexibility of workflows that enhance productivity. Users have highlighted new features like Smart AI Trigger and live translation, which significantly improve the writing experience. While some users noted minor issues like occasional bugs, these are considered small bumps on the road. With an impressive rating of 4.8 and a 60-day money-back guarantee, Keyshift AI is a solid buy for anyone looking to elevate their writing experience. Give it a try for just $19!

faqs.q: How do I submit my product to sell on AppSumo?
faqs.a: To submit your product, log into your AppSumo account and visit the Partner Portal. Click 'Start selling' and follow the prompts to upload your deal information, set pricing, and define deal features. After submission, monitor your email for status updates from the AppSumo team.

faqs.q: What types of digital products can I sell on AppSumo?
faqs.a: You can sell various digital products on AppSumo, including software, PDFs, online courses, WordPress plugins, ebooks, template libraries, and Chrome extensions.

faqs.q: Is there a fee to list my product on AppSumo?
faqs.a: There are no listing fees or limits on AppSumo. You can list as many products as you'd like at no cost, and AppSumo only takes commissions on sales you make.

faqs.q: How do I add categories to my product listing?
faqs.a: To add categories to your product listing, go to the 'Listings' tab in your Partner Portal, select the listing you want to edit, and create a new version. Under the 'Categories' tab, pick a category and tag your product accordingly. Fill out the remaining fields and submit for review.

faqs.q: What should I do after my deal goes live on AppSumo?
faqs.a: After your deal goes live, promote your offer through email sequences, social media, and affiliate partnerships. Engage with customers by responding to reviews and questions on your product page to build trust and encourage more sales.

faqs.q: What is the revenue share model for selling on AppSumo?
faqs.a: For returning AppSumo customers, AppSumo works to agree on a tailored revenue share for your product listing based on expected campaign performance, application quality, and product category.

faqs.q: What is the process for AppSumo to review my product application?
faqs.a: AppSumo requires access to functioning test accounts to demo your product during the application process. This access allows the team to evaluate your product's functionality and market fit. Ensure that test account credentials are active and accessible until a decision is made on your application.

faqs.q: What are the requirements for redemption codes when listing a product on AppSumo?
faqs.a: AppSumo requires between 500-10,000 unique, one-time-use redemption codes for each product submitted. This approach prevents unauthorized access and ensures that each code is used only once by a paying customer.

faqs.q: How can I optimize my product listing to attract more buyers on AppSumo?
faqs.a: To optimize your product listing, create high-resolution images that showcase your product, craft feature-packed content that converts, and set a competitive price. Additionally, engage with customers by responding to reviews and questions to build trust and encourage more sales.

faqs.q: What support does AppSumo provide to partners after their product goes live?
faqs.a: AppSumo offers tools for partner success, including a Partner Success Guide with marketing strategies, friendly support from the self-listing team, and access to the Partner Portal to track sales and edit listing elements.

reviews_summary: Customers are all about "How to Sell Your Product on AppSumo," praising its thoroughness, helpfulness, and engaging tone. There are a few hiccups like minor drawbacks, just small bumps on the road. Weighing the raves against the occasional grumbles, "How to Sell Your Product on AppSumo" is hitting the mark and is a solid resource for those planning an AppSumo launch.

value_prop: Nail your marketing and brand strategy

tldr: You know your business can make it big if only you knew how to describe your brand. Branding5 uses AI to pinpoint your brand positioning and generate a full marketing strategy in minutes.
highlights: Define your brand positioning in minutes using Carl Jung’s brand archetype system
Audit your marketing assets with Brand Check—scored across seven brand dimensions so you know exactly what's off

faqs.q: What is Branding5?
faqs.a: Branding5 is an AI-powered brand positioning and strategy toolkit designed to help businesses define their unique market position, develop comprehensive brand strategies, and increase revenue through actionable insights.

faqs.q: How does the brand positioning tool work?
faqs.a: The tool guides users through a structured process: inputting company details, gathering inspiration, defining the ideal customer profile, analyzing competitors, articulating brand values, selecting a brand archetype, generating a comprehensive brand strategy, and receiving a detailed report.

faqs.q: What is included in the final brand strategy report?
faqs.a: The report provides a 360° view of your brand, including brand identity, archetype, narrative, visual identity, SWOT analysis, competitive analysis, landing page effectiveness, SEO performance, marketing strategy, ideal customer profile, marketing texts, content strategy, and campaign ideas.

faqs.q: What is a brand archetype?
faqs.a: A brand archetype embodies human-like traits that resonate on a profound, often subconscious level with consumers. These archetypes are rooted in the psychological work of C.G. Jung and help create deep emotional connections with the audience.

faqs.q: Is my data safe when using Branding5?
faqs.a: Branding5 provides access to third-party tools 'as is' and 'as available' without any warranties, representations, or conditions of any kind and without any endorsement. Users should ensure they are familiar with and approve of the terms on which tools are provided by the relevant third-party provider(s).

faqs.q: Can I use Branding5 for rebranding my existing business?
faqs.a: Yes, Branding5 is suitable for both new brand development and rebranding existing businesses. The tool helps redefine brand positioning, analyze current market standing, and develop updated marketing strategies.

faqs.q: Is Branding5 fully white-label?
faqs.a: Branding5 is planning to introduce agency-specific features, including white-label capabilities, custom domain support, and client survey management with configurable reports.

faqs.q: Can I export reports to PDF, DOC, or PPT?
faqs.a: Branding5 has released a PDF export feature and is developing custom export options, including Markdown and Microsoft Word (DOCX) formats, for easy sharing and integration with existing workflows.

faqs.q: Is multilingual support available?
faqs.a: Branding5 is planning to introduce full support for multiple languages across the platform to reach a global audience.

reviews_summary: Customers appreciate Branding5 for its structured wizard, faithful input carry-forward, and impressive website analyzer. However, some users found issues with archetype suggestions and fake precision in the ICP generator. Despite this, with an overall product rating of 4.9 and a 60-day money-back guarantee, Branding5 is hitting the mark and is a solid buy for those in need of a reliable AI marketing solution.

subheader: Peek behind-the-scenes into how James Clear grew his email list to 1 million subs

Gain promotional tactics ranging from the beginning of Clear’s career, all the way to the present
Get step-by-step breakdowns of how Clear structures articles and grew a newsletter to over 1 million subs
body:
The 
1 Million Email Subscriber Playbook
 is a deep-dive guide into how blogger and best-selling author, James Clear, grew his email list to over 1 million subs.
 

 
 
 
 
 


How did James Clear grow his newsletter following from 0 subs all the way to over 1 million? That’s the big question we wanted to answer with this guide.
 

So we 
analyzed how Clear writes and promotes his content
, along with how quickly his newsletter grew during different time periods.


You’ll 
learn how many hours Clear puts into writing a single article
. (Hint: it’s usually longer than the entire 
Lord of the Rings
 trilogy.)


We’ll 
show you the distribution tactics Clear used
 all the way back in 2012—as well as the distribution he’s using today, and many years in between.


 
 
 
 
 


JamesClear.com wasn’t Clear’s first blogging website. (For all you 2000’s kids, neither was Xanga or LiveJournal.)


In this guide, we also 
break down the steps Clear used to grow his first blog
, Passive Panda, into a full-time entrepreneurial venture.


You can 
find out Clear’s tactics for getting guest posts accepted at major blogs
 and media outlets.


Get writing tactics that help editors fall in love with your work and 
learn the exact writing schedule that Clear used to get his initial traction
.


 
 
 
 
 


We also 
pulled back the curtain on Clear’s traditional publishing experience
.


Ever wondered how Clear got syndication agreements with publications like 
Time
 and 
LifeHacker
? We’ve got the answers inside.


You’ll also be able to 
explore how Clear leverages his newsletter following
 to grow it even more through his book deal, speaking engagements, and more.


 
 
 
 
 


Your newsletter could use a lot more subscribers than your coworkers, your friends, and your dog. (
“If he can have his own Instagram, he can have his own email address, OK?!”
)


It’s time to take your content to the next level with a guide based on an acclaimed content master.


Ready to multiply your subscribers, write higher-quality articles than ever, and get major media attention for your work?


Download 
1 Million Email Subscriber Playbook: How James Clear Went from Obscure Blogger to Best-Selling Author
 today!

faqs.q: What is Aivolut Books?
faqs.a:
Aivolut Books is a guided AI workspace for turning an idea, outline, or source material into a structured book. It brings planning, outlining, writing, editing, cover creation, and publishing preparation into one connected workflow.

You can ask Aivolut Books to create a first draft or guide the project yourself through the brief, outline, writing style, research, and chapter editor.

faqs.q: Who is it for?
faqs.a:
Aivolut Books is for first-time authors, experienced writers, coaches, consultants, educators, creators, KDP publishers, and business owners who want to turn their knowledge or imagination into a book.

You do not need to know prompt engineering. The guided workflow helps you make the important creative decisions in plain language.

faqs.q: How is this different from using ChatGPT?
faqs.a:
ChatGPT is a flexible conversation tool, but a long book usually requires you to manage prompts, context, structure, and chapter files yourself.

Aivolut Books keeps your brief, outline, writing style, source material, and chapters together. Each stage is designed around creating and refining a complete book, not simply producing the next response in a chat.

faqs.q: Will it create a finished, publishable book automatically?
faqs.a:
It can create a complete, connected first draft and help prepare your cover, metadata, and export files. It does not replace your judgment as the author.

Please review, edit, fact-check, and proofread every manuscript before publishing. We would rather help you reach a strong draft faster than pretend any AI can replace a thoughtful final review.

faqs.q: How much control do I have over the book?
faqs.a: You remain in control. You can shape the premise, audience, themes, characters, plot, writing style, research, outline, and individual chapters. You can also edit the manuscript directly at any time.

faqs.q: Can I control the number and length of chapters?
faqs.a:
You choose the overall book length, and Books proposes a chapter structure that fits the project. You can review and edit the outline before generating the manuscript, then adjust chapter content in the editor.

Word and page counts are targets rather than guarantees. The final page count depends on your formatting, trim size, images, and front and back matter.

faqs.q: Can Aivolut Books write in my style?
faqs.a:
Yes. Custom writing styles are included on every plan. You can provide instructions or upload a PDF, DOC, DOCX, or TXT writing sample to help Books follow your preferred voice, tone, pacing, and structure.

AI can learn useful characteristics from a sample, but it may not reproduce your voice perfectly. A final read in your own voice is always worthwhile.

faqs.q: How long does it take to create a book?
faqs.a:
There is no honest one-size-fits-all answer. A short first draft may be ready much sooner than a long, research-heavy book, while your own outlining and editing choices also affect the timeline.

Books removes much of the blank-page work, but quality still benefits from the time you spend reviewing and refining the result.

faqs.q: What can I create?
faqs.a:
Every plan supports nonfiction. Starter and above add digital products, Plus and above add fiction, and Pro adds kids' picture books, audiobooks, translation, book series, manuscript import, Deep Research, and book analysis.

Digital products include structured assets such as guides, workbooks, checklists, and lead magnets.

faqs.q: Can I write fiction?
faqs.a: Yes, on Plus and Pro. You can guide the premise, genre, characters, story direction, outline, and chapter content before and after generation.

faqs.q: Can I create a series of connected books?
faqs.a: Yes. Pro includes Book Series, which helps you plan related books and carry shared series context into each project. You still review each outline and manuscript before generation or publication.

faqs.q: Can I create a kids' picture book?
faqs.a: Yes. Pro includes a dedicated illustrated picture-book workflow for 12-, 16-, or 24-page books. You can choose the age group, story direction, and visual style, then review the text and artwork before export.

faqs.q: Can I create an audiobook?
faqs.a:
Yes. Pro can turn an eligible completed book into an English-language audiobook. You can review the prepared narration, regenerate selected passages when needed, and download individual chapters or the complete audiobook as MP3 files.

Audiobook creation uses credits based on the manuscript's prepared word count. The exact cost is shown before you begin.

faqs.q: Can I translate an existing book?
faqs.a:
Yes. Pro includes whole-book translation for eligible manuscripts up to 100,000 words. The translated edition is created as a separate book, so your original stays intact.

AI translation deserves a native-speaker review before publication, especially for literary, specialist, or culturally sensitive material.

faqs.q: Which languages are supported?
faqs.a:
Aivolut Books supports 32 language options:
English (US), English (UK), Arabic, Chinese (Simplified), Chinese (Traditional), Croatian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, Finnish, French, German, Greek, Hebrew, Hindi, Hungarian, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Malay, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese, Romanian, Russian, Spanish, Swedish, Thai, Turkish, Ukrainian, and Vietnamese.

And we're looking to add more. Email [email redacted] if your language is not currently in the list and we will see how we can support it.

Output quality can vary by language, genre, and subject. We recommend reviewing a short sample before generating a long manuscript.

faqs.q: Can I use my notes, interviews, or research?
faqs.a:
Yes. Starter includes 10 custom knowledge bases, Plus includes 50, and Pro includes 100. You can attach up to five knowledge bases to one book to keep your notes, interviews, research, and source documents close to the writing process.

Knowledge-base storage is 100 MB on Starter, 250 MB on Plus, and 500 MB on Pro.

faqs.q: Will Books use only facts from my sources?
faqs.a:
Your sources help ground the manuscript, but no generative AI can promise perfect source fidelity. It may misunderstand a passage, omit context, or introduce a statement that was not in your material.

Please verify facts, statistics, quotations, citations, and any legal, medical, financial, or technical claims before publishing.

faqs.q: What does Deep Research do?
faqs.a:
Pro includes Deep Research for research-led books. It creates a book-ready report with cited web sources that you can review before carrying the evidence into an idea, brief, or manuscript.

See Aivolut Books Credit costs (https://books.aivolut.com/credits) for the current cost. Deep Research is supporting research, not a substitute for checking the original sources yourself.

faqs.q: Can I import a manuscript I have already written?
faqs.a:
Yes. Pro can import a DOCX or UTF-8 TXT manuscript of up to 100,000 words and 20 MB, turning it into an editable Books draft.

The import keeps your manuscript prose unchanged and detects chapter breaks from headings and chapter labels. You can correct the structure in the editor. Images, charts, equations, and editor comments are not imported.

faqs.q: Can Books continue or complete an imported manuscript?
faqs.a:
Yes. After importing, you can edit the manuscript, prepare a completion brief, and use the supported writing tools to finish it. Books asks what the finished book should become and what must remain unchanged before planning the remaining work.

Your original upload remains your source file, so it is still wise to keep your own backup.

faqs.q: Can I edit the manuscript myself?
faqs.a: Yes. Manual editing is included on every plan. You are never required to accept generated text as written.

faqs.q: Can I change one passage without rewriting the whole chapter?
faqs.a: Yes. Plus and Pro include AI editing commands for selected text, including rewriting, expanding, shortening, clarifying, correcting grammar, and changing tone. Basic and Starter users can edit the same content manually.

faqs.q: What do the book analysis tools check?
faqs.a: Pro includes manuscript analysis tools that help surface writing corrections, repetition, tense or point-of-view shifts, inconsistencies, and broader book-level issues. Treat the report as an editorial second opinion, not as proof that a manuscript is error-free.

faqs.q: How consistent will the chapters be?
faqs.a:
Aivolut Books uses the project brief, structured outline, writing style, available sources, and preceding context to improve continuity across chapters.

Long fiction, technical nonfiction, and books with many characters or factual claims still deserve a complete human review. No AI system can guarantee perfect continuity.

faqs.q: Does Aivolut Books save every previous draft?
faqs.a: Persistent version history is not currently included. Export or save a backup before a major rewrite you may want to reverse.

faqs.q: Can Aivolut Books create a cover?
faqs.a:
Yes. Every plan includes the first generated cover for each book. See Aivolut Books Credit costs for the current cost of additional cover generations.

You can also upload your own PNG, JPEG, or WebP cover.

faqs.q: Can it illustrate chapters?
faqs.a: Yes. Chapter illustrations are included on Plus and Pro.

faqs.q: How are chapter illustrations different from kids' picture books?
faqs.a: Chapter Illustrations add images to a standard fiction or nonfiction manuscript. Kids' Picture Books use a dedicated Pro workflow that plans the story and artwork page by page for younger readers.

faqs.q: Which plan should I choose?
faqs.a:
Basic suits shorter nonfiction books up to 10,000 words.
Starter adds digital products, books up to 20,000 words, and 10 knowledge bases.
Plus adds fiction, AI editing, chapter illustrations, BYOK, books up to 30,000 words, and 50 knowledge bases.
Pro supports books up to 100,000 words and includes every listed workflow, with 100 knowledge bases.
If you want fiction, start with Plus. If you want the complete creation and publishing toolkit, choose Pro.

faqs.q: How do monthly credits work?
faqs.a: Your plan credits refresh each month on your activation anniversary, and unused monthly plan credits do not roll over. The exact cost is always shown before you confirm a paid action.

faqs.q: How many credits does it cost to create a book or use other features?
faqs.a: Credit costs vary by book length and action. See Aivolut Books Credit costs (https://books.aivolut.com/credits) for the latest cost of creating a book, translating it, generating an audiobook, running Deep Research, and more.

faqs.q: How many books can I create each month?
faqs.a:
That depends on your available credit balance, the length of each book, and any other credit-based tools you use. See Aivolut Books Credit costs (https://books.aivolut.com/credits) for current action costs.

Ideas, briefs, manual editing, AI editing when included on your plan, and exports do not use credits.

faqs.q: Are books or projects unlimited?
faqs.a:
There is no separate limit on the number of book projects. Your practical generation limit is your available credit balance and the maximum book length included with your plan.

“Unlimited ideas and content briefs” does not mean unlimited manuscript generation; full manuscripts and some other AI actions use credits.

faqs.q: How long can each book be?
faqs.a:
Basic: up to 10,000 words
Starter: up to 20,000 words
Plus: up to 30,000 words
Pro: up to 100,000 words
The limit applies to each book, not to the total number of words in your account.

faqs.q: Which plans include BYOK?
faqs.a:
Plus and Pro include Bring Your Own Key for supported writing, AI editing, and translation workflows. You pay the AI provider directly for its model usage while Aivolut Books continues to handle planning, covers, metadata, and the rest of the book workflow.

Using your own key reduces the Books credit cost for supported generation. Knowledge-base surcharges may still apply. See Aivolut Books Credit costs (https://books.aivolut.com/credits) and the in-app quote for the current cost. Supported providers and models are shown in the app.

faqs.q: Do I need my own AI account or API key?
faqs.a:
No. Every plan works with Aivolut Books credits, so a separate OpenAI or other AI-provider account is not required.

BYOK is an optional Plus and Pro feature for authors who prefer to connect a supported provider and pay that provider's API usage directly. A ChatGPT subscription is not the same as an API key or API balance.

faqs.q: Why does BYOK still use some Books credits?
faqs.a: Your key pays for supported text generation. Books still provides the surrounding workflow, including planning, project context, covers, metadata, storage, exports, and supporting AI work. The reduced credit charge covers that part of the service.

faqs.q: Do AppSumo codes stack?
faqs.a: The deal uses four license tiers rather than stacked allowances. Choose the tier that fits your needs, and use AppSumo's upgrade option while the deal is live if you want to move higher. The final AppSumo deal terms control upgrade and downgrade availability.

faqs.q: Which export formats are included?
faqs.a: Every plan can export DOCX, EPUB, and PDF. Exports do not use credits, so you can continue editing, format for your preferred platform, or keep an offline backup.

faqs.q: Does Aivolut Books help with Amazon KDP?
faqs.a:
Yes. Every plan includes Amazon metadata tools for preparing a description, keywords, and categories, along with book covers and manuscript exports.

You remain responsible for reviewing the files, following Amazon's current requirements, and uploading the book through your own KDP account.

faqs.q: Does Aivolut Books publish directly to Amazon?
faqs.a: No. Books prepares your manuscript and publishing assets, while you complete publication through Amazon KDP or another platform. Your publishing account, listing, and royalties stay under your control.

faqs.q: Does using Aivolut Books guarantee marketplace approval or sales?
faqs.a: No. Amazon and other marketplaces set their own content, quality, disclosure, and formatting rules. Aivolut Books can help you prepare, but it cannot guarantee approval, rankings, reviews, traffic, or sales.

faqs.q: What rights do I have to my work?
faqs.a:
Aivolut Books does not claim ownership of the material you upload. Under the current Terms, you may use generated content for lawful business purposes, including commercial projects.

You remain responsible for making sure your manuscript does not infringe another person's copyright, trademark, privacy, or other rights.

faqs.q: How is my content used?
faqs.a: Your content is processed to operate and provide the service, as described in the Aivolut Books Terms and Privacy Policy. Please review both documents for the complete data-handling terms.

faqs.q: Is AI-generated content always accurate or original?
faqs.a: No. AI can make factual mistakes, invent details, repeat familiar phrasing, or produce material similar to existing work. Research and knowledge bases improve the available context but do not remove the need for fact-checking and originality review.

faqs.q: Can I publish without editing?
faqs.a: You decide how much editing to do, but we strongly recommend reviewing and proofreading every manuscript. Books involving factual, legal, medical, financial, or technical information need especially careful expert review.

faqs.q: Are there content restrictions?
faqs.a: Yes. Aivolut Books cannot be used for unlawful, infringing, fraudulent, obscene, or harmful content, or to misuse the service. The current Terms and acceptable-use rules apply to everything created on the platform.

faqs.q: Can existing Aivolut Books customers purchase or upgrade through the AppSumo deal?
faqs.a:
Unfortunately, the AppSumo deal is only available to brand-new Aivolut Books customers and cannot be applied to an existing account.

If you already have an account, you can view your upgrade options by opening Billing in your dashboard. You can also email [email redacted], and we’ll be happy to help you choose the most appropriate option.

faqs.q: Where can I buy Aivolut Books on AppSumo?
faqs.a: You can buy Aivolut Books on the Aivolut Books AppSumo product page (https://appsumo.com/products/aivolut-books/). Please refer to that page for the latest features, pricing, deal terms, and availability.

faqs.q: Does the deal include team members or client accounts?
faqs.a: No. Each AppSumo license is for one individual account. Team seats, shared workspaces, client portals, and agency accounts are not included.

faqs.q: Does Aivolut Books support MCP or connections to AI agents?
faqs.a: We don’t currently offer a public API or MCP integration, but we’re exploring it and gathering requirements from users.

faqs.q: What support is included?
faqs.a: In-app chat and email support is available on weekdays, with most tickets resolving in 24 hours. As we're in the Asia timezone, please allow some time for us to get back to you. Email is available at [email redacted]. Please include the email address on your account and a clear description of what happened so the team can help you as quickly as possible.

faqs.q: Who is behind Aivolut Books?
faqs.a: Aivolut Books is operated by J1 Holdings Pte. Ltd., the team behind the Aivolut portfolio. Our products have served more than 30,000 users, and we are building Aivolut Books for authors who want helpful AI without losing ownership of the creative process.

faqs.q: What happens if I refund or deactivate my AppSumo license?
faqs.a: Your access follows the license status provided by AppSumo. If the license is refunded, deactivated, or otherwise becomes inactive, you would no longer have access to Aivolut Books.

faqs.q: Which AI models does Aivolut Books use?

faqs.q: How can I use keyword research to enhance my local SEO content marketing strategy?
faqs.a: Performing thorough keyword research targeting your niche and locality is crucial. Identify local keywords relevant to your business and incorporate them strategically into your content to improve local search performance and meet the needs of your local audience.

faqs.q: What role do local influencers play in a local SEO content marketing strategy?
faqs.a: Collaborating with local influencers can expand your reach and enhance brand credibility. Their endorsement introduces your brand to a broader audience, and their use of target keywords can further boost your SEO performance.

faqs.q: Why is having a detailed contact page important for local SEO?
faqs.a: A comprehensive 'Contact Us' page with essential information like business name, address, phone numbers, and email helps systematize customer inquiries and strengthens local SEO by providing reliable, location-specific information about your business.

faqs.q: How can guest posting benefit my local SEO content marketing efforts?
faqs.a: Submitting guest posts to local publishers and businesses allows you to link back to your resources, introducing your business to new audiences and establishing authority within your community. Using location-specific keywords in these posts further boosts local SEO.

faqs.q: What is the importance of understanding user intent in content marketing?
faqs.a: Aligning your content with user intent improves engagement, reduces bounce rates, and increases conversions. Identifying whether a query is informational, transactional, or navigational helps tailor your content to meet user needs effectively.

faqs.q: How can I build Topic Authority to improve my SEO content strategy?
faqs.a: Consistently creating high-quality, informative content around specific topics establishes your website's expertise and trustworthiness, boosting search rankings and attracting more organic traffic.

faqs.q: What are content clusters, and how do they benefit SEO?
faqs.a: Organizing content into clusters based on related topics helps search engines understand the relationships between your pages, improving overall SEO. It also provides a better visitor experience by offering organized and informative resources.

faqs.q: How can I use social and forum data to inform my SEO strategies?
faqs.a: Analyzing data from platforms like TikTok, YouTube, and Reddit provides real-time audience insights and market intelligence, helping develop differentiated and effective SEO content strategies.

faqs.q: What is the 80/20 rule in keyword strategy for content marketing?
faqs.a: Focus 80% of your strategy on evergreen keywords that provide long-term value and 20% on trending keywords to capture current interests, ensuring a balanced approach to content creation.

faqs.q: Why is building high-quality backlinks important for content marketing?
faqs.a: High-quality backlinks act as endorsements from other websites, signaling to search engines that your content is trustworthy and valuable, thereby improving search rankings and driving referral traffic.

faqs.q: What is Jem Social?
faqs.a: Jem Social is an creator marketing platform that enables brands and marketers to find, vet, and book user-generated content (UGC) creators and influencers efficiently. It offers a streamlined process to match brands with vetted creators, allowing for quick collaboration without the need for agencies or prolonged communication.

faqs.q: How does Jem Social work?
faqs.a: Jem Social operates in three main steps: 1) Brands provide details about their campaign, including product, niche, and budget. 2) The platform generates a ranked shortlist of vetted creators that fit the criteria. 3) Brands can view real work and rates of these creators, message them directly, and book them for content creation.

faqs.q: How does payment to creators work on Jem Social?
faqs.a: Payments to creators are handled through an escrow system. Brands fund a campaign, and Jem Social holds the funds until the creator delivers the content. Once the brand approves the work, the funds are released to the creator. This process ensures protection for both parties, eliminating the need for external payment methods like PayPal or Venmo.

faqs.q: What types of creators can I find on Jem Social?
faqs.a: Jem Social provides access to a diverse range of creators, including those specializing in beauty and skincare, food and local lifestyle, fashion and try-on hauls, and more. The platform allows you to filter creators by niche, follower count, engagement rate, and price band to find the best fit for your brand.

faqs.q: How quickly can I book a creator through Jem Social?
faqs.a: Jem Social is designed to expedite the booking process. By providing your campaign details, the platform generates a ranked shortlist of vetted creators within minutes, allowing you to book the right creator the same day, significantly reducing the time compared to traditional methods.

faqs.q: Does Jem Social handle contracts and payments with creators?
faqs.a: Yes, Jem Social manages contracts and payments with creators. The platform provides full contract templates and handles payments through an escrow system, ensuring that funds are held securely until the work is approved by the brand.

faqs.q: What kind of support does Jem Social offer for campaign tracking?
faqs.a: Jem Social offers comprehensive tracking features, including real-time revenue tracking, discount code attribution, link click tracking, and Shopify integration. These tools help brands monitor campaign performance and measure return on investment effectively.

faqs.q: Which advertising and publishing platforms does Orchestra integrate with?
faqs.a: Orchestra integrates with Meta (Facebook & Instagram) and Google Ads for advertising, and also connects social channels for publishing including LinkedIn, X (Twitter) and TikTok; it can also connect Google Search Console and Mailgun. (Orchestra lists Google Ads, Meta, Google Search Console, LinkedIn, X, TikTok and Mailgun among supported connections.)

faqs.q: Does Orchestra create or publish ad campaigns automatically in my ad accounts?
faqs.a: No. Orchestra generates campaign structure and assets and then creates the campaign paused in your own ad account so you can review everything before it spends; Orchestra does not enable or run campaigns without your explicit approval.

faqs.q: How do I launch my first ad campaign with Orchestra?
faqs.a: Per the docs: connect the ad platform you want to use (Meta or Google Ads), create a plan in Ads by providing objective, daily budget, landing page URL and locations; Orchestra generates the campaign structure, ad copy and (for Google) keywords; review and edit headlines, descriptions, keywords, locations and images as needed; then choose Launch — Orchestra will create the campaign paused in your ad account for you to review and enable.

faqs.q: How do I connect my Google Ads account to Orchestra and what does Orchestra create in Google Ads?
faqs.a: Open Settings → Connections in the Orchestra dashboard, choose Google Ads, sign in with Google and approve the requested permissions, then select the Google Ads account to use. When you launch a Google campaign Orchestra generates a complete best-practice structure (campaign, ad groups, keywords and a responsive search ad) and creates it paused in your Google Ads account; budgets and bids remain under your control.

faqs.q: How do I connect Meta (Facebook & Instagram) and what permissions are required?
faqs.a: From Settings → Connections choose Meta and log in to Facebook, then grant the permissions Orchestra requests (permissions cover managing your Page, publishing content and, optionally, running ads) and select the Facebook Page (and linked Instagram Business/Creator account) you want Orchestra to use. The docs warn that if you decline required permissions publishing or ads may fail and recommend reconnecting while accepting all permissions.

faqs.q: What data does Orchestra collect from my connected ad and search accounts and how is it used?
faqs.a: Orchestra's privacy policy states it collects account details and advertising data (e.g., account IDs, campaign/ad configurations, performance metrics, keywords, targeting settings) and Search Console search-performance rows when you connect those services. This data is used to create and manage campaigns, display metrics in the platform, generate AI-powered copy and recommendations, and provide SEO/AI-visibility features; Orchestra says it stores access tokens encrypted, uses TLS in transit, and does not collect personal data about ad viewers.

faqs.q: How does Orchestra support ChatGPT / OpenAI ad workflows?
faqs.a: Orchestra generates ChatGPT Ads campaigns as OpenAI Ads Manager–ready workbooks for you to upload; Orchestra has no direct publishing integration with OpenAI and instead exports the campaign workbook for use in OpenAI Ads Manager.

faqs.q: Why do I need a code to sign up? I'm not receiving it.
faqs.a:
The code confirms the email address is really yours. It protects your lifetime licence: if an address were mistyped or used by someone else, you could lose access to your account and your plan.

The quickest way in skips the code entirely: choose "Continue with Google" when you sign up.

If you prefer to use your email and the code doesn't arrive within a minute:

Check spam or junk, and any "quarantine" area if your company uses Outlook, Zoho or similar.
Ask your IT to allow emails from orchestra-ads.ai.
Avoid requesting many new codes in a row: always use the most recent one, and too many requests can be briefly blocked.
Still stuck? Email [email redacted] with your AppSumo order number and we'll set up your account manually.

faqs.q: How do I set up my email sender in SalesBlink?

faqs.q: Can SendFox GDPR/DPA‑compliant and suitable for European B2B/B2C?
faqs.a:
Yes—SendFox is fully GDPR‑ and DPA‑compliant and works for both B2B and B2C businesses worldwide.
- Data Processing Addendum (DPA): Data Processing Agreement - SendFox
- Privacy Policy: Privacy Policy - SendFox
- Terms of Service: Terms of Service - SendFox

faqs.q: Does SendFox provide SMTP access?
faqs.a: No. Instead of exposing raw SMTP credentials, we use domain validation: once you validate your own sending domain in SendFox, you can send from any email address on that domain without needing separate SMTP settings.

faqs.q: Can I customize the appearance of RSS‑generated Smart Campaign emails?
faqs.a:
The default Smart Campaign layout is fixed, but you can always edit the generated email in our HTML editor before sending.
Lifetime plan: Basic HTML editor
Empire Add‑On: Advanced HTML editor for full design control

faqs.q: Can I add contacts via the API without double opt‑in confirmation?
faqs.a: All Lifetime accounts require double opt‑in by default. To skip confirmation for API‑added or form‑submitted contacts, you must upgrade to the Empire Add‑On monthly plan, which lets you disable double opt‑in.

faqs.q: Is there a native Divi (WordPress) integration for capturing subscribers?
faqs.a:
No official module, but you can use the community‑built "SendFox for Divi" plugin:
LikeablePress Integration of SendFox for Divi

faqs.q: Is there a Shopify integration to sync customers and purchases into SendFox?
faqs.a: Not yet. You can build a custom integration via our API or use Zapier/Pabbly Webhooks. We've logged Shopify integration as a future feature request.

faqs.q: Can I use a custom domain for SendFox Smart Pages?
faqs.a: Not currently. All Smart Pages live on SendFox | Free Marketing Tools for Content Creators URLs. We've added custom‑domain support to our feature roadmap for future consideration.

faqs.q: What is DKIM and how do I set it up?
faqs.a:
DKIM (DomainKeys Identified Mail) is a digital authentication method that helps email receivers verify that an email was sent by an authorized sender and hasn't been tampered with during transit. It works by adding a digital signature to outgoing emails, which is verified by the recipient's email server using a public key published in the sender's DNS records. To set up DKIM:

1. **Generate a DKIM Key Pair**:
 - Create a private and public key pair. The private key is kept secure on your email server, while the public key is added to your DNS records.

2. **Add the Public Key to Your DNS Records**:
 - Publish the public key in your domain's DNS settings as a TXT record.

3. **Configure Your Email Server**:
 - Set up your email server to sign outgoing emails with the private key.

faqs.q: How can I troubleshoot the 'SMTP could not authenticate' error?
faqs.a:
The 'SMTP could not authenticate' error typically indicates issues with email credentials or SMTP settings. To resolve this:

1. **Verify Email Credentials**:
 - Ensure that your email address and username match; they are often identical.
 - Use the same password you use to log into your email inbox. Note that some providers, like Gmail and Yahoo, require an 'App Password' instead of your regular login password.

2. **Check SMTP Settings**:
 - Confirm the accuracy of your SMTP server address and TLS/SSL port number. Contact your email service provider for the correct SMTP settings if needed.

faqs.q: What is inTouch?
faqs.a: inTouch is a digital messaging platform by rdcom that enables businesses to manage SMS, Email, and RCS communications in a centralized environment.

faqs.q: Who is inTouch designed for?
faqs.a: inTouch is designed for businesses, digital platforms, and organizations managing marketing or transactional communications.

faqs.q: Does inTouch support API integrations?
faqs.a: Yes, inTouch provides APIs and webhooks to integrate messaging into existing systems.

faqs.q: What channels can I manage with inTouch?
faqs.a: With inTouch, you can manage SMS, Email, and RCS communications.

faqs.q: What are some use cases for inTouch?
faqs.a: inTouch supports various use cases including e-commerce transactional notifications, marketing campaigns, SaaS platform communications, and operational messages for businesses and services.

faqs.q: How does inTouch ensure data security and compliance?
faqs.a: inTouch is developed in compliance with applicable regulations, including GDPR, and includes tools to manage consent, preferences, and contact data responsibly.

faqs.q: What advanced features does inTouch offer?
faqs.a: inTouch integrates advanced tools such as One-Time Password (OTP) services for secure logins and payment confirmations, and SMS ADV for reaching a large audience through a direct and effective channel.

faqs.q: How can I start using inTouch?
faqs.a: You can activate a free trial of inTouch for 60 days, which includes 250 emails per day and 20 SMS or RCS messages.

faqs.q: Are Multi-Account and Multi-User included in the AppSumo Lifetime Deal?
faqs.a:
No. Multi-Account and Multi-User are additional inTouch features and are not included in the AppSumo Lifetime Deal.
Multi-Account allows you to create sub-accounts for different brands or customers, while Multi-User allows you to add users with different roles and permissions.
If you need either option, contact us at [email redacted] and we'll help you find the right setup.

faqs.q: How many email domains can I connect?
faqs.a:
As a rule, each account/tier is intended for one brand. You can connect more than one email domain as long as all the domains belong to the same company or brand.
Different brands or customers require separate accounts or an additional Multi-Account setup.

faqs.q: Does inTouch include pop-up forms, landing pages and thank-you pages?
faqs.a: Yes. inTouch includes pop-up forms, landing pages and thank-you pages, all included in the AppSumo Lifetime Deal. You can use them to collect leads and grow your contact database.

faqs.q: What is the difference between RCS Basic and RCS Rich, and what is included in my AppSumo plan?
faqs.a:
RCS Basic provides the standard RCS messaging service, with pricing based on the destination country.
RCS Rich supports richer message formats such as images, videos, carousels and files. RCS Rich is available in inTouch but is not included in the AppSumo Lifetime Deal. RCS Rich traffic can be purchased separately from rdcom.

faqs.q: What is an SMS Sender ID and how does it work?
faqs.a:
A Sender ID is the name or number displayed to recipients as the sender of an SMS message.
Depending on the destination country, it can be alphanumeric or numeric. Registration requirements and any associated costs may vary according to local regulations.
You can start the Sender ID registration process directly in inTouch. Our team will review the request according to the requirements of the destination country.

faqs.q: Can I buy additional Mobile credits after the AppSumo deal ends?
faqs.a: Yes. You can continue purchasing Mobile credits even after the AppSumo deal has ended. After the deal ends, purchases will be arranged directly with rdcom.

faqs.q: What is Switchy?
faqs.a: Switchy is a tool that allows users to customize, manage, and track retargeting links to boost conversions. It enables the modification of link appearances, integration of retargeting pixels, and provides real-time analytics to monitor link performance.

faqs.q: How do I install Switchy?
faqs.a: Installing Switchy is straightforward and typically takes about 5 minutes for a trained electrician. Free installation is available in Bangalore City. For other locations, users can refer to the included wiring diagram. Incorrect connections may lead to electrical hazards and void the warranty.

faqs.q: Can I operate my existing switch after installing Switchy?
faqs.a: Yes, Switchy is designed as a retrofit solution, allowing both the physical switch and the app to control the device. You can turn on the light using the app and switch it off using the physical switch, or vice versa.

faqs.q: Is WiFi mandatory for Switchy?
faqs.a: Yes, Switchy requires an active WiFi network to function properly. Each module independently connects to the WiFi router, eliminating the need for a centralized hub or controller.

faqs.q: How do I create an account in the Switchy mobile app?
faqs.a: Download the Switchy app from the Play Store or App Store. Open the app and select 'Create Account.' Enter the required details and proceed with email verification. Check your inbox (or spam folder) for the verification email, click the link, and then log in using your registered email and password.

faqs.q: How do I add a device in the Switchy app?
faqs.a: Open the Switchy app. Tap the menu icon in the top-right corner and select 'Add New Device.' Choose the room where you want to add the device and click 'Next.' Select the device name, scan the QR code provided with the device box, and the device will be added to the room.

faqs.q: How do I add timers to a device?
faqs.a: Open the Switchy app on your device. Go to the automation page and click on the '+' icon. Select the time, choose the device details, and click 'Save' to set the timer.

faqs.q: What should I do if my devices are not working with the mobile app?
faqs.a: Ensure your mobile device is connected to WiFi or mobile data. Open the Switchy app, go to the profile page, and check if the device is online (indicated by green or orange color). If the device shows red, indicating it's not connected to WiFi, restart your WiFi router. If your WiFi credentials have changed, reconnect the device to the existing WiFi network.

faqs.q: How do I reset my Switchy app password?
faqs.a: Open the Switchy app. Enter your username or email and click on 'Forgot Password.' Type and confirm your new password, then enter the verification code sent to your registered email address. If you don't find the email in your inbox, check the spam folder.

faqs.q: How do I give access to my Switchy account to another person?
faqs.a: Create a Switchy account for the user you want to grant access to. During setup, select 'Link to existing house' and enter the HouseID and password of the existing account. You can find the HouseID in the profile page of the Switchy app. You can also provide access to specific rooms by configuring settings in the profile page.
