faqs.q: What does Soku actually do?
faqs.a: Soku connects to the ad accounts you authorize, finds what is costing you money, and then makes the change in the platform: pausing an ad, moving budget, adding negative keywords, launching a new ad. Every change carries the numbers that justified it, and you decide which ones it can make on its own.

faqs.q: Which channels does Soku cover?
faqs.a: Ads first. Google Ads, Meta, and TikTok are the core. GA4, Shopify, and Search Console connect for context, so conversions and revenue line up with what you spent to get them.

faqs.q: Can it spend or change my accounts without asking?

Write-capable workflows are enabled separately, and each action carries a risk tier, so routine changes can run on their own while anything that raises spend waits for a one-tap approval. Every action appears in the activity log with the reason behind it.

faqs.q: What happens on day one?

faqs.a: Meta Ads, Google Ads, TikTok Ads, GA4, Shopify, and Search Console. Budget changes, pausing, and new ads work across Google, Meta, and TikTok; negative keywords and bid adjustments are Google, and ad set edits are Meta.

faqs.a: Credits are how Soku meters AI work: generating creatives, running analyses, and executing agent turns. Each plan includes a monthly credit grant that refreshes every billing cycle.

faqs.q: What happens when I run out of credits?
faqs.a: Your included credits reset at the start of each billing cycle. Unused monthly credits do not roll over. AppSumo Customers can purchase the AI Credit pack add-on for additional one-time, non-expiring credits.

subheader: Improve SEO and customer experience by finding broken links, site redirects, and 404 errors
value_prop: Set up automatic redirects
highlights: Optimize outgoing links, scan for broken or dangerous links, and automatically redirect mistyped URLs to avoid 404 errors
Alternative to: Redirection and Broken Link Checker
Manage links, track all your sites, and monitor click stats from one centralized dashboard
body:
WP 301 Redirects lets you scan your site for broken or dangerous links and set up automatic redirects, manage affiliate links, and control all your sites from a centralized dashboard.
 



Even visitors that misspell your URL deserve to find your awesome content instead of a dreaded 404 page.


With the WP 301 Redirects Link Scanner tool, you'll be able to 
catch broken URLs and disreputable outlinks before you lose visitors to competitor pages.


The link-scanning tool is SaaS-integrated, so you can 
automatically scan links for every page 
in case of broken ones that need replacing, or bad ones that need removing.


Plus, the Google Safe Browsing and Alexa Rank API integrations let you 
sort through content for links to sites with a poor reputation or malware.


 

 
 
 
 
 



Redirect incorrect links to the right place automatically with the WP 301 Redirects plugin.
For broken internal links, simply install the WP 301 Redirects plugin and 
all those mistyped URLs will be automatically redirected to the page with a similar URL
.
 

You can also 
decide how sensitive the plugin is to typos
, setting specifics to ensure site browsers land on the right page.


And you’ll even be able to
 create manual redirects for more complex cases
—the power is in your hands.


Just find the pages you want to redirect, add the unique destination URL, and the robust plugin will take care of the rest!


 
 
 
 
 


Set up automatic and manual redirect rules to control affiliate links and drive traffic to your site!
Rebuilding a site and changing URLs sounds like a nightmare, but WP 301 Redirects lets you 
set up redirects instead of rebuilding all your URLs.


Your site visitors won’t ever get lost in the shuffle, whether you need to 
update URLs or adjust site links as your company grows and matures
.


Use the Link Scanner tool to find unnecessary affiliate links and then 
add in redirects to hide extra-long links for a site that actually drives traffic.


You can say goodbye to scary, messy affiliate links and time-consuming site redirects for good and
 say hello to optimized SEO and improved user experience
.

 
 
 
 
 




Scan your site to detect links that are hurting your SEO and make improvements based on gathered Link Scanner results.
Whether you’re working on one site or managing dozens for clients, it’s good to keep an eye on your site performance.


The WP 301 Redirects dashboard 
shows you where your users are coming from, how many redirects happen each day, which browser visitors are using
, and more!


You can even
 export branded PDF reports to send to clients
 and show off all your hard work on fixing errors for their site.
 

The dashboard 
displays the logs and stats for all the sites you manage
 under one roof in an easily accessible format.
 

 
 
 
 
 


See all your site stats in one place with an easy-to-use dashboard.
WP 301 Redirects lets you
 remotely monitor sites, sites’ redirects, and 404 logs, plus perform remote actions
 without having to log in to individual sites.
 

Alternatively, you can also
 create a keyless site license and install the plugin without entering a license key
 to get the power of WP 301 Redirects on all your sites.


You’ll even be able to 
fully customize and rebrand the plugin without any coding 
through brand-specific logos, plugin names, company names, URLs, and contact info that match your business.


 
 
 
 
 



Rebrand the plugin’s interface any way you like without touching any code to impress clients!
A 404 error, broken link, or misleading outbound click can ruin your site’s SEO rankings and your day. (
“An afternoon of fixing links? Oh, boy! Sign me up!”
)


Thanks to WP 301 Redirects, broken links, dangerous outlinks, and URL typos don’t have to cost you potential customers.


Ready to take better care of your site traffic?


Get lifetime access to WP 301 Redirects today!

faqs.q: How do I download the latest version of WP 301 Redirects PRO?
faqs.a: You can access the latest version of WP 301 Redirects PRO through the Dashboard. Click on the menu item from the left to immediately download the latest version of the plugin. Once installed, the plugin updates via the standard WordPress admin updates mechanism.

faqs.q: Can I hide the license key so my customers don’t see it?
faqs.a: Yes, you can hide the license key by activating the white label option in the license tab after activating the license key on a site.

faqs.q: How can I contact support for WP 301 Redirects?
faqs.a: For PRO version users, contact support via email using the address associated with your purchase or include your license key in the email. Free version users can seek assistance through the community forums.

faqs.q: Does WP 301 Redirects support wildcard characters in redirect rules?
faqs.a: Yes, WP 301 Redirects supports the use of '*' as a wildcard character in source URLs, allowing you to create redirect rules that match multiple URLs.

faqs.q: How can I import and export redirect rules in WP 301 Redirects?
faqs.a: To export redirect rules, go to Settings -> 301 Redirects -> Settings -> Tools and click on 'Download Export File'. To import, click on 'Browse' to select your file, choose how to handle duplicates, and click 'Upload'.

faqs.q: How do I enable email reports for 404 errors and redirects?
faqs.a: Navigate to Settings -> 301 Redirects PRO -> Settings -> General Settings. Under '404 Email Reports' or 'Redirects Email Reports', select the desired frequency and specify the email address for reports.

faqs.q: Is WP 301 Redirects compatible with translation plugins?
faqs.a: Yes, WP 301 Redirects is fully compatible with translation plugins such as Weglot, TranslatePress, Gtranslate, and Loco Translate that use language prefixes in URLs.

faqs.q: How can I disable all redirect rules in WP 301 Redirects?
faqs.a: To disable all redirect rules, navigate to Settings -> 301 Redirects -> Settings -> Advanced, and select the 'Disable all redirect rules' option.

faqs.q: What happens to my redirect rules if I deactivate or delete the plugin?
faqs.a: Deactivating the plugin stops redirects but does not delete them from your database. Deleting the plugin permanently removes all redirects and associated data from your database.

faqs.q: How can I report a bug in WP 301 Redirects?
faqs.a: If you find a bug, please contact support to report the problem. The team will check it out and fix it as soon as possible.

reviews_summary: Customers appreciate WP 301 Redirects for its efficient link management, user-friendly interface, and robust redirection capabilities. While there are some minor issues with speed and unexpected redirects, overall, the plugin is a solid buy for those in need of a reliable SEO improvement tool. Additionally, with a 60-day money-back guarantee, it's worth giving it a try.

faqs.q: How can I resolve a server error in ElkQR?
faqs.a: If you encounter a server error in ElkQR, it may be due to cached data in your browser. To resolve this, clear your browser's cache and cookies. Detailed instructions for clearing cache and cookies in Chrome, Firefox, and Safari are available in the ElkQR knowledge base.

faqs.q: How do I sign up for an ElkQR account?
faqs.a: To sign up for an ElkQR account, visit elkqr.com and click the 'Get Started' button. Fill in the registration form with your email, full name, and a password that meets the specified requirements. After submitting the form, verify your email address through the link sent to your inbox. Once verified, create your first workspace to start using ElkQR.

faqs.q: How can I delete a QR code in ElkQR?
faqs.a: To delete a QR code in ElkQR, click the three-dot menu on the QR code card and select 'Delete.' Confirm the deletion in the popup. Deleted QR codes are moved to the Trash Bin, where they remain for 7 days before permanent deletion. You can restore or permanently delete them from the Trash Bin during this period.

body:
Hey Oliver is marketing automation software that works seamlessly with your website so you can build customized campaigns, track engagement, and convert more leads
.
 



Having a great website is the first step to creating a thriving customer base. The next? The ability to drive conversions.


Hey Oliver helps you 
turn website visitors into customers with targeted marketing campaigns
.
 

With the capability to create campaigns based on visitor actions and custom parameters, you can 
create a fully personalized experience for your leads
 based on how engaged they are.


 
 
 
 
 


If there’s one thing marketers love, it’s tracking metrics.


Hey Oliver makes it easy to 
measure specific actions
, 
events
, 
and user interactions
 so you can track KPIs and customize targeted campaigns with your most engaged visitors.


Each time someone visits your website, their activity is logged and can be seen in your marketing dashboard. (I Know What You Did Last Session.)


See an overview of the website activity, how many campaigns are running, the number of leads generated, and the most popular pages.


You can also 
track your website metrics
 and see the visitors who are currently live on your site in real-time with Hey Oliver.


 
 
 
 
 


Effective sales means hitting the right leads at the right point in the funnel, and Hey Oliver’s automation helps you do that with ease.


Hey Oliver 
automatically stores visitors’ referrals
, 
clicks
, 
downloads
, 
page views
, 
and more
.


It analyzes each visitor and provides you with data that you can use to 
segment your visitors based on predetermined or custom criteria
 and set up targeted campaigns to engage them.


Hey Oliver’s powerful, campaign creator lets you 
easily build customized campaigns
 that help your business meet its goals.
 

Using visitors’ data, you can 
reach customers at the right time and right place
 and create custom calls to action to prompt visitors to download a resource, sign up for a program, or buy a product.
 

With Hey Oliver doing the work, you’ll have enough free time to binge-watch all your favorites on Disney+ (
Oliver and Company, anyone
?).
 

 
 
 
 
 


Your outreach to website visitors all flows through 
Bubbly
 as part of Hey Oliver.


Bubbly does it all—you can use it to chat, push shoutout campaigns, provide customer service, and more.


Bubbly by Hey Oliver is 
fully customizable
 and can be edited to align with your brand colors and style.


Feature your social media profiles
, 
FAQs
, 
and other articles
 you want your customers to see and provide a personalized experience for leads based on their lead scores and actions.


Showcase text or rich media like photos and videos and 
customize the chat experience to move site visitors through the funnel
 and drive conversions.


 
 
 
 
 


That site of yours that used to lure in visitors only to see them painfully walk away is a thing of the past.


Create customized campaigns, track metrics, and drive conversions all at the same time with Hey Oliver.
 

Get lifetime access today
!

faqs.q: What is Seline and what does it do?
faqs.a: Seline is a lightweight, privacy-first SaaS analytics tool that combines marketing-site analytics, product/event tracking, and revenue attribution into a single workspace. It uses a small (~2KB) tracking script to follow visitors from first visit through product usage and payments so you can build funnels, profiles, journeys, and view revenue attribution in one dashboard.

faqs.q: How do I install Seline on my website or web app?
faqs.a: Install Seline by adding the provided script tag to your site (the docs show a snippet using data-token="PROJECT_TOKEN" and src="https://cdn.seline.com/seline.js"), then call seline.track and seline.setUser from your product as needed. The docs provide the exact script snippet and installation options.

faqs.q: How do I send custom events to Seline?
faqs.a: Send custom events from client or server code using the seline.track method (for example seline.track("user: signed up", { ...properties })). The custom-events docs show examples and explain how to attach properties to events for later analysis.

faqs.q: How can I track revenue and connect Stripe to Seline?
faqs.a: You can track revenue either by connecting Seline’s Stripe integration (recommended for profiles) or by sending revenue events directly with seline.track (including revenue: true, currency, and amount). Seline will attribute revenue to UTMs/referrers and show MRR/attribution in the dashboard; the docs explain configuration and currency settings.

faqs.q: How does Seline identify and merge user profiles?
faqs.a: Seline creates profiles when you send authenticated user data (using seline.setUser). Users are merged by userId or email; sending these identifiers builds a profile with traits, events, and full session history for funnels, churn/engagement filters, and Stripe-linked revenue features.

faqs.q: How do I track visitors across subdomains (e.g., app.example.com and www.example.com)?
faqs.a: To enable cross-subdomain tracking, add the Seline script with a project token to each subdomain you want tracked. Installing the script on each hostname allows Seline to combine sessions and avoid unwanted hostnames appearing in filters.

faqs.q: Is there an API to query events or export data from Seline?
faqs.a: Yes — Seline provides a public API (including a custom-events endpoint) that lets you query custom and charge events with pagination and filters; the API docs include endpoint examples, required parameters, and supported query options for exporting or programmatic access.

reviews_summary: Customers appreciate Seline, praising its simplicity, clean interface, and effective tracking of visitor journeys and funnels. The tool stands out as a user-friendly alternative to traditional analytics tools, making it ideal for small sites and teams. While some users noted minor issues like confusing project setup, these are just small bumps on the road. Overall, Seline is a solid choice for anyone looking for straightforward analytics. With a 60-day money-back guarantee, it's worth giving a try!

faqs.q: Do I need to install JavaScript, an SDK, or change my site to use Honeylog?
faqs.a: No. Honeylog needs no JavaScript tag, no SDK and no code changes — it reads requests at the server level. Most setups take under 30 minutes and support Nginx, Apache, Cloudflare, Fastly, AWS CloudFront or a custom edge.

faqs.q: Which AI crawlers does Honeylog track by name?
faqs.a: Honeylog tracks all major AI crawlers by name and user agent, including GPTBot (OpenAI), ClaudeBot (Anthropic), PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, Bytespider (ByteDance), CCBot (Common Crawl), Meta-ExternalAgent, Applebot-Extended, Amazonbot and others; the list is updated when new crawlers appear.

faqs.q: How does Honeylog detect spoofed user-agent strings?
faqs.a: Honeylog cross-references the reported user-agent against the official IP ranges published by vendors (OpenAI, Anthropic, Perplexity, Google and others) and flags requests as spoofed when the user-agent claims a known crawler but the request originates from IPs outside the vendor’s published ranges.

faqs.q: Does Honeylog work with CDNs such as Cloudflare, Fastly and AWS CloudFront?
faqs.a: Yes. Honeylog reads logs from all major CDNs (Cloudflare, Fastly, AWS CloudFront, Akamai) and from direct server logs (Nginx, Apache, Caddy). The documentation notes CDN integration is often the best option because it catches traffic before caching layers can hide it.

faqs.q: What integrations are available for sending Honeylog notifications to team chat tools?
faqs.a: Honeylog supports integrations to send notifications to Slack, Telegram and Google Chat. Slack uses an OAuth connect flow, Telegram uses a Honeylog Telegram bot to link chats or groups, and Google Chat uses incoming webhooks. Integrations require an active subscription.

faqs.q: How often does Honeylog re-scan sitemaps after I add them?
faqs.a: When you add sitemap URLs, Honeylog scans them immediately and then re-scans them about every hour so new URLs appear automatically. The Sitemap section also cross-references sitemap URLs with real traffic to show which pages bots actually crawl.

faqs.q: How do Honeylog Alerts work — evaluation frequency, notification limits and recipients?
faqs.a: Alerts measure a metric over a trailing time window and can be configured to check at intervals from every 5 minutes up to once a day. Honeylog checks due alerts every minute; alerts notify by email (you can add up to 10 recipients) and there is a limit of at most 10 alert emails per site per day (further triggers are recorded but suppressed). Alerts support filters and a preview/backtest before saving.

faqs.q: How often does Honeylog fetch and monitor a site's robots.txt?
faqs.a: Honeylog fetches your robots.txt once a day, in the morning of your site's timezone. It shows the file content, last-checked time, and preserves a history of distinct versions; site admins can also trigger an immediate fetch with a Check now button.

faqs.q: What social media platforms does AdaptlyPost support?
faqs.a: AdaptlyPost supports nine social media platforms: Twitter (X), LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest, Threads, and Bluesky.

faqs.q: How can I connect my Instagram account to AdaptlyPost?
faqs.a: To connect your Instagram account to AdaptlyPost, ensure you have an Instagram Business or Creator account linked to a Facebook Page. Then, in AdaptlyPost, go to the Connectors page, click 'Connect Instagram', and follow the prompts to authorize the connection.

faqs.q: Why can't I connect my Facebook Page to AdaptlyPost?
faqs.a: If you're unable to connect your Facebook Page, ensure you have admin access to the Page and that you're connecting through the personal Facebook account that owns or administers the Page. If issues persist, try removing the AdaptlyPost integration from your Facebook settings and reconnecting.

faqs.q: What is the bulk scheduling feature in AdaptlyPost?
faqs.a: The bulk scheduling feature allows you to upload and schedule multiple posts simultaneously. You can upload up to 100 videos or 30 image posts per session, set platform-specific settings for each post, and schedule them all at once.

faqs.q: How does AdaptlyPost connect to my social media accounts securely?
faqs.a: AdaptlyPost uses secure OAuth authentication to connect to your social media accounts. This process redirects you to the platform's official login page to authorize AdaptlyPost, ensuring that your passwords are never viewed or stored by AdaptlyPost.

faqs.q: What should I do if my Instagram posts are failing to publish through AdaptlyPost?
faqs.a: If your Instagram posts are failing to publish, try refreshing your Instagram connection in AdaptlyPost by navigating to the Accounts section and clicking 'Refresh Instagram'. This often resolves common posting issues.

faqs.q: Can I manage my social media accounts using AI with AdaptlyPost?
faqs.a: Yes, AdaptlyPost offers AI integration through its AI Agents feature, allowing you to manage social media tasks such as posting, scheduling, and tracking results across multiple platforms using AI assistants.

faqs.q: How do I set up an AI agent to manage my social media with AdaptlyPost?
faqs.a: To set up an AI agent, ensure you have an active AdaptlyPost account with at least one connected social media account. Obtain an API token from Settings > API Tokens, and configure your AI assistant (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor) with the provided settings to connect to AdaptlyPost.

faqs.q: What are the common issues when connecting Instagram to AdaptlyPost and how can I resolve them?
faqs.a: Common issues include connection problems after updating your Facebook or Instagram password, permission errors, or empty account lists. To resolve these, refresh your Instagram connection in AdaptlyPost by navigating to the Connections tab and clicking 'Refresh Instagram'.

faqs.q: How can I troubleshoot Facebook scheduled posts not working in AdaptlyPost?
faqs.a: If your Facebook scheduled posts are not working, common causes include expired access tokens, incorrect Page roles, or media format issues. Reconnecting your Facebook account to AdaptlyPost often resolves these problems.

faqs.q: What should I do if I encounter the 'account_ids is not set' error when adding social media accounts?
faqs.a: This error occurs when you click 'Add' without selecting any accounts from the dropdown menu. To resolve it, wait for the selection popup to fully load, select at least one account from the dropdown, and then click the 'Add' button.

faqs.q: How can I connect SocialBu to AI assistants like Claude?

faqs.q: What is the Queue feature in SocialBu, and how do I set it up?
faqs.a: The Queue feature allows you to automate and recycle evergreen content by adding multiple posts and setting them to repeat on a preferred schedule. To set it up, log in to SocialBu, navigate to Publish → Queues, click 'New Queue', name your queue, and assign it to a team member if desired.

faqs.q: How can I allow someone else to add social accounts to my SocialBu workspace?
faqs.a: To allow others to add social accounts, log in to SocialBu, go to 'Social Accounts' from your profile dropdown, click '+ Add Account', select 'Let someone else connect the accounts', choose the platform, and generate a unique connection link to share.

faqs.q: What does OpenGraph.xyz do?
faqs.a: OpenGraph.xyz helps you control how your links look when they are shared. Create branded Open Graph (OG) image templates once, then automatically generate a unique social preview image for every blog post, product page, listing, or landing page. You can also scan existing URLs, create shareable Short Links with custom previews, and track their clicks.

faqs.q: Who is OpenGraph.xyz for?
faqs.a: It is built for marketers, developers, content teams, agencies, WordPress users, and founders who want consistent, high-converting social previews without designing a new image for every page. It is especially useful for sites with frequently published content, catalogs, directories, or programmatic pages.

faqs.q: Do I need design or coding skills?
faqs.a: Not necessarily. Start from a premade design, ask AI to create a template inspired by your website, or use the visual editor to build one yourself. WordPress users can connect a template with the official plugin; custom websites need to place the generated image URL in their page metadata.

faqs.q: Can AI create an OG image template for my brand?
faqs.a: Yes. Enter your website URL and, optionally, describe the visual direction, layout, tone, or content type you want. OpenGraph.xyz creates a branded template in the background, which you can then refine in the visual editor. AI-generated templates can be retried if generation fails.

faqs.q: Can I edit AI-generated and premade templates?
faqs.a: Yes. You can edit text, images, shapes, colors, fonts, layout, crop settings, opacity, borders, shadows, and more. A premade template can be copied into your workspace so you can make it your own. When you ask AI to edit an existing template, it creates a new copy rather than overwriting the original.

faqs.q: Can I create a template from scratch?
faqs.a: Yes. The manual editor starts with a blank 1200 × 630 canvas and supports text, image, and rectangle layers. You can move, resize, rotate, reorder, hide, duplicate, rename, and style layers to create a fully custom layout.

faqs.q: What are template variables, and why do they matter?
faqs.a: Variables turn one design into a reusable system. For example, you can create variables for a title, description, featured image, author, price, or call to action. Each web page then supplies its own values while keeping the same branded layout.

faqs.q: Can OpenGraph.xyz generate a different social image for every page automatically?
faqs.a: Yes. Publish a template and use its dynamic image URL as the page’s `og:image`. Passing different URL-encoded variable values—such as a post title or product photo—creates a unique image for each page while preserving your design system.

faqs.q: Does OpenGraph.xyz host the generated images?
faqs.a: Yes. You can host generated renders with OpenGraph.xyz and use the resulting hosted URL in your metadata. You can also download a PNG if you prefer to upload the image elsewhere. Hosted images and downloaded images are separate workflows.

faqs.q: Can I use OpenGraph.xyz with my existing website or CMS?
faqs.a: Yes. Dynamic OG image URLs work with any stack that can put an `og:image` tag in the initial HTML response. The documentation includes guides for Next.js, Astro, Laravel, WordPress, and other frameworks, with template-specific snippets in the Automate tab.

faqs.q: Is there a WordPress integration?
faqs.a: Yes. Install the official OpenGraph.xyz plugin from the WordPress Plugin Directory, connect it with an API key, choose a published template, map its variables to WordPress content, select the page types, and save. Typical mappings include post title, featured image, excerpt, and URL.

faqs.q: Does the WordPress plugin work alongside SEO plugins?
faqs.a: The plugin overrides Open Graph output from supported SEO plugins. If another plugin outputs an `og:image` later in the page source, it may take precedence, so check for duplicate tags and clear WordPress, CDN, and social-platform caches after changes.

faqs.q: Does it work with React, Vue, SPAs, or site builders?
faqs.a: Yes, as long as your OG tags are available in the initial HTML response. Social crawlers often do not run client-side JavaScript, so inserting tags only after page load is unreliable. Use server-side rendering, static generation, your platform’s metadata fields, or another server/build-time solution.

faqs.q: Can I scan my existing site before changing anything?
faqs.a: Yes. The free scanner checks a public URL, shows the Open Graph metadata it finds, previews how the link can appear on major platforms, and highlights missing or problematic data. Scanning is diagnostic only—it does not change your website.

faqs.q: Which platforms can I preview and optimize for?
faqs.a: The scanner previews Facebook, X, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, and Discord. Open Graph metadata is also used broadly by services such as Slack and other messaging and social platforms.

faqs.q: Can I use text, a headline, or a CTA on my OG images?
faqs.a: Yes. Text overlays are useful for giving social scrollers immediate context and a reason to click. Keep important copy readable, high-contrast, and inside a safe central area to reduce cropping; make sure your `og:title` and `og:description` still clearly communicate the content of the page for accessibility.

faqs.q: What is the recommended image size for social previews?
faqs.a: OpenGraph.xyz templates use the widely compatible 1200 × 630 format. PNG and JPG offer the broadest support. Keep images reasonably small—WhatsApp and other chat crawlers can be stricter about image size.

faqs.q: Can I create Short Links with a custom social preview?
faqs.a: Yes. A Short Link sends visitors to your chosen destination while presenting its own title, description, and image. This is useful for campaigns, sharing links to a site you cannot edit, or fixing the preview of a specific shared URL without changing the destination page.

faqs.q: Can a Short Link use one of my templates?
faqs.a: Yes. A Short Link can use a fixed image from your media library or render one of your published templates with its own variable values. The link keeps the selected template version and values until you edit it.

faqs.q: Can I A/B test social previews without changing my website?
faqs.a: Yes. Create separate Short Links that point to the same destination, give each link a different title, description, or image, and share them with comparable audiences. Each link has separate click history, making it practical to compare variations and identify the stronger preview.

faqs.q: What analytics do Short Links include?
faqs.a: For each Short Link, you can review total clicks over time and breakdowns by country, device, browser, and referrer. Choose a date range to evaluate campaigns or compare preview variations.

faqs.q: Can I use my own domain for Short Links and hosted images?
faqs.a: Yes. Connect a branded subdomain, such as `share.example.com`, by adding a CNAME record to `cname.theopengraph.com` and waiting for verification. Apex/root domains are not supported; use a subdomain instead.

faqs.q: Can I upload or reuse images in my templates?
faqs.a: Yes. The media library lets you upload new images, reuse previously uploaded assets, or select an Unsplash image. You can use those assets in template image layers, variable values, and Short Link previews where an image picker is available.

faqs.q: Do draft template changes affect my live website immediately?
faqs.a: No. The editor autosaves your draft, but your automation and integrations continue using the published version until you select 'Publish Changes' and update the version in your template URL to the latest template version (or, in the WordPress plugin, select the latest version in the template version selector).

faqs.q: Can I use the API key for a general public API?
faqs.a: Not currently. API keys are used to connect the official OpenGraph.xyz WordPress plugin to your account. The product does not currently offer those keys for remote API access or a general public API.

faqs.q: Why is my new image not showing on Facebook, LinkedIn, X, or WhatsApp?
faqs.a: Social platforms cache previews independently. First, check that the page source contains one public absolute `og:image` URL and that the image loads without authentication. Then clear your site and CDN caches, check for duplicate OG tags, and refresh the platform cache where possible—for example, Facebook Sharing Debugger or LinkedIn Post Inspector. OpenGraph.xyz cannot clear a third-party platform’s cache directly.

faqs.q: Why did OpenGraph.xyz fail to scan my URL?
faqs.a: The page must be publicly reachable over HTTP or HTTPS, without login requirements. Firewalls, bot protection, CDNs, rate limits, or host security settings can block the scanner. If you use an IP allowlist, allow the crawler ranges `74.220.48.0/24` and `74.220.56.0/24`.

faqs.q: How do I activate my AppSumo license?
faqs.a: Use the AppSumo activation link or code provided with your purchase, then sign in to an existing OpenGraph.xyz account or create one. The license is linked to your workspace. A workspace that has previously used an OpenGraph.xyz subscription cannot link an AppSumo license.

faqs.q: What limits apply to the AppSumo deal?
faqs.a: Your AppSumo tier and the deal terms determine the included limits. Inside OpenGraph.xyz, Settings → Usage shows your measured usage, while the AppSumo deal page is the source of truth for the limits included with each tier.

faqs.q: Does PresEngage work inside Zoom and Google Meet?
faqs.a: Yes, on both tiers. Your audience opens the PresEngage side panel right inside the call and asks away, and your AI Co-Presenter answers from your presentation on the spot. No tab-switching, no juggling links.

faqs.q: What presentation tools is PresEngage compatible with?
faqs.a: If it exports to PDF, it works with PresEngage. Build in PowerPoint, Keynote, Google Slides or Canva, export a PDF and upload it, and your AI Co-Presenter gets to know your deck. While you present, share your audience link; on Tier 2 you also get a branded QR code and a ready-made Audience Connect slide to drop into your deck.

faqs.q: How do audience members join a PresEngage session during a presentation?
faqs.a: From any phone or laptop, with nothing to download. They open your presentation's link, or use the PresEngage side panel in Zoom or Google Meet. On Tier 2, an in-person audience simply scans your branded QR code.

faqs.q: Do attendees need an account, and can other attendees see their questions?
faqs.a: No account and no app, just a browser. By default attendees join with their name and email, or Google sign-in, so every question shows you exactly who asked. On the web, attendees don't see each other's questions. In Zoom and Google Meet, you choose which questions to feature for the room, shown with the asker's name. If you'd rather your audience ask without giving a name or email, you can switch on anonymous questions for a presentation. Its web attendees then go straight to your AI Co-Presenter, with no name or email, and you see them as "Anonymous attendee". It covers the web Q&A page only; Zoom and Google Meet still identify people.

faqs.q: Who do I contact for help after redeeming?
faqs.a: A real person on our team. In the app, open Help and choose Contact support: you get a reference number and a reply by email. Prefer email? Write to [email redacted]. Can't sign in yet? Use the Contact support link at the bottom of the sign-in page. For quick how-to questions, the Help assistant in the app answers right away.

faqs.q: Can I connect PresEngage to other apps, like Slack or Google Sheets?
faqs.a: Yes, through Zapier. Each text or WhatsApp message your audience sends can flow straight into Google Sheets, Slack, your CRM and thousands of other apps. Texting and WhatsApp are Tier 2 pay-as-you-go options; questions from the web, Zoom and Google Meet are waiting for you in your Messaging Center and Audience Intelligence.

faqs.q: Does PresEngage search the internet for answers?
faqs.a: Never. PresEngage answers only from what you give it: your slides, notes, documents and any web pages you choose to add (those are read once, when you add them). If the answer isn't in your material, it tells your attendee it isn't covered instead of guessing, and lets you know so you can follow up. Your audience gets your expertise, not the internet's.

faqs.q: What's the difference between Tier 1 and Tier 2?
faqs.a: Both tiers give you the full presenter toolkit: unlimited presentations, your AI Co-Presenter, Audience Intelligence, Smart Prompt, Smart Follow-Up and your own branding. Tier 1 is built for presenting online, with Google Meet and Zoom side panels and a link you can share anywhere. Tier 2 takes you into the room too: a branded QR code, a ready-made Audience Connect slide, Digital Wallet passes and your own custom domain.

faqs.q: Does PresEngage work with Microsoft Teams?
faqs.a: Not yet, but you can still use it in Teams today. Paste your PresEngage link into the meeting chat and your audience asks from their browser, with nothing to install.

faqs.q: Does PresEngage listen to my talk?
faqs.a: No, and it doesn't need to. Your AI Co-Presenter works from the slides, notes and documents you upload. Want it to know what you said, too? Export a transcript from your meeting tool as a PDF or Word file and add it as a supporting document.

faqs.q: Are text messages and WhatsApp included?
faqs.a: Texting and WhatsApp aren't part of lifetime pricing, because every message costs real money to send. Your web, QR, Google Meet and Zoom audiences come with no per-person fees.

faqs.q: Do my presentations stay live?
faqs.a: Yes, for as long as you're using them. Your AI Co-Presenter keeps answering around the clock, long after you've left the stage. A presentation that sits idle for about a month is archived, and later deleted, and we always email you first. Need an archived one back? Reactivate it from your original PDF, then add your supporting documents and links again.

faqs.q: Can I use my own branding?
faqs.a: Yes, on both tiers. Put your logo, name and colours on your audience pages and switch off PresEngage's sign-up prompts, so your audience sees your brand. A few things stay ours behind the scenes: the privacy and terms links, go.presengage.com short links, and follow-up emails sent from our address as "Your Name via PresEngage". Want your own web address too? Custom domains come with Tier 2.

faqs.q: Who sees my audience's details, and can I export them?
faqs.a: You do. By default each question arrives in your Messaging Center and Audience Intelligence with the asker's name and email, so you know exactly who to follow up with, and you can download the people who joined a presentation, with their conversations, as a CSV file. If you switch on anonymous questions for a presentation, its web attendees appear as "Anonymous attendee" with no name or email, and you can't email them afterwards. We don't sell your audience's information.

faqs.q: How do I activate my code or upgrade to Tier 2?
faqs.a: Activation is quick: redeem from your AppSumo account and you'll land on PresEngage's activation page to create or sign in to your account. Ready to take it into the room? Change your tier from Tier 1 to Tier 2 in your AppSumo account while the deal is live, and PresEngage updates automatically. Refunds are handled by AppSumo under its refund policy.

faqs.q: Can I use PresEngage for clients, stack codes, or move my license?
faqs.a: Absolutely: present for as many clients as you like from your own account. Each account is for one person, so please don't share a login across a team. Codes don't stack. Need to move your license to another account? Email [email redacted] from the account that holds it, with your AppSumo order number.

faqs.q: Is my content used to train AI models?
faqs.a: No. Your content is used only to run PresEngage for you: to power your AI Co-Presenter and answer your audience's questions. We don't use it to train AI models. Our Terms of Use and Privacy Policy have the details.

faqs.q: Can I add a video of my talk to my Q&A page?
faqs.a: Yes, on both tiers: paste a link to a video you host on YouTube, Vimeo, Wistia or Cloudflare Stream and your audience watches it on the web Q&A page while they ask your AI Co-Presenter questions, and it still answers from your slides and documents, not from the video.

faqs.q: Can attendees ask questions anonymously?
faqs.a: Yes, on both tiers: turn on Anonymous questions for a presentation (it is off by default and applies to the web Q&A page only) and viewers ask without giving a name or email, though you can't email them afterwards.

faqs.q: Can I send questions to my audience while I present?
faqs.a: Yes, on both tiers: write your questions ahead, send them from your phone during your talk, and choose when the results appear, on the web Q&A page and in the Google Meet and Zoom side panels.

faqs.q: Can I read audience questions in my own language?
faqs.a: Yes, on both tiers: pick your language once from 36, and new audience questions and AI replies show in it in your Messaging Center, translated by AI with the original one click away, while attendees keep asking in whatever language they like.

faqs.q: What audio file formats does AudioHero offer?
faqs.a: All audio files can be purchased as 16 bit / 44.1 kHz Broadcast WAV files or as 320 kbit MP3 files. Your purchase allows you to download either or both formats as many times as you wish.

faqs.q: Is AudioHero compatible with Mac, PC, and Linux?
faqs.a: Yes, all three operating system platforms can access the AudioHero.com website and its content without difficulty.

faqs.q: Are there any limitations on how many YouTube channels I can include under my AudioHero license?
faqs.a: There are no limitations on the number of YouTube channels you can include under your AudioHero license. To prevent copyright claims, share a link to your channel with us, and we'll whitelist it.

faqs.q: Does AudioHero integrate with Zapier or Make?
faqs.a: Unfortunately, AudioHero doesn’t currently integrate with Zapier or Make.

faqs.q: How often is new content added to AudioHero?
faqs.a: New content is added to AudioHero.com throughout the year.

faqs.q: What should I do if I can't find the music I downloaded on my computer?
faqs.a: Check your desktop, 'Received Files' folder, or 'My Music' folder. If you still can’t find the files, you can download them again from your account as many times as needed, provided you have an active account.

faqs.q: How do I find the perfect audio track on AudioHero?
faqs.a: Explore our search engines to locate the right sound effects for your productions. Direct links to these search engines can be found in the navigation bar at the top of each page.

faqs.q: What is Vois Studio?
faqs.a: Vois Studio is a desktop application that provides a comprehensive AI voice production environment. It allows users to write scripts, select voices, generate audio locally, edit timelines, master audio, and export final products, all within a single platform.

faqs.q: What are the system requirements for Vois Studio?
faqs.a: Vois Studio is compatible with macOS 12 or later (Apple Silicon) and Windows PCs. It requires 16 GB of RAM and 10 GB of free disk space for optimal performance.

faqs.q: How does voice cloning work in Vois Studio?
faqs.a: Vois Studio allows users to create custom voices by uploading a 10 to 15-second audio sample. The software learns the voice locally on the user's device, enabling its use for any text or language.

faqs.q: Can I use Vois Studio offline?
faqs.a: Yes, Vois Studio operates entirely on your local machine, allowing for offline use. However, internet access is required for initial setup, model downloads, activation, and periodic license validation.

faqs.q: How many voices are included in Vois Studio?
faqs.a: Vois Studio includes over 100 expressive voices across 21 categories, catering to various needs such as audiobook narrators, podcast hosts, game characters, app assistants, and explainers.

faqs.q: What production tools are included in Vois Studio?
faqs.a: Vois Studio offers a script editor with multi-speaker support, a multi-track timeline, mastering and EQ tools, and export presets for platforms like Spotify, YouTube, and ACX.

faqs.q: Do AppSumo Tiers 1, 2 or 3 include Vois Pro?
faqs.a:
All three AppSumo tiers provide lifetime access to the Vois Subscriber plan, with the features and limits listed for your selected tier:

• Tier 1: Subscriber plan with Tier 1 features and limits.
• Tier 2: Subscriber plan with Tier 2 features and limits.
• Tier 3: Subscriber plan with Tier 3 features and limits.

Vois Pro is not included in any AppSumo tier. Tier 3 is the highest AppSumo tier, not the Vois Pro plan.

“Subscriber” is the plan name from our website. Your AppSumo purchase is a one-time payment for lifetime access—not a recurring subscription. No additional purchase is required to use the features included in your tier.

reviews_summary: Customers appreciate Vois Studio for its local text-to-speech capabilities, an impressive selection of over 112 voices, and the ability to master audio with music and sound effects. While some users have noted minor issues like challenges with Japanese pronunciation and occasional audio artifacts, these are being actively addressed. Overall, Vois Studio is gaining traction and is a solid buy for anyone looking to create high-quality voiceovers. With a seven-day free trial, it's worth giving it a try!

faqs.q: What is Memogram?
faqs.a: Memogram is a platform that allows event hosts to collect and share photos and videos taken by guests during events. Guests can upload media by scanning a unique QR code or visiting a link, without the need to download an app.

faqs.q: Why not just use a WhatsApp group or Google Drive link?
faqs.a:
While those options may seem convenient, they often result in lost files, compressed media, poor organization, and low participation.
Memogram provides a centralized, professional system that makes it easier for customers and guests to upload content while helping you collect, organize, and manage everything in one place.

faqs.q: How do guests upload photos and videos to Memogram?
faqs.a: Guests can upload media by scanning the event's unique QR code with their phone's camera or any QR code scanner app, which directs them to the event's media-upload platform.

faqs.q: Can I customize my event page on Memogram?
faqs.a: Yes, Memogram allows you to personalize your event page with unique themes, colors, and layouts to match the style of your event.

faqs.q: Can I download all photos and videos from my event at once?
faqs.a: Yes, Memogram provides a one-click bulk download feature, allowing you to save all your event media instantly in high quality.

faqs.q: Can guests view and download each other's photos and videos?
faqs.a: It depends on the host’s settings. The event host can choose whether guests can only upload media or also view and download shared content.

faqs.q: Is Memogram compatible with multiple devices?
faqs.a: Yes, Memogram is compatible with smartphones, tablets, desktops, and laptops. Media uploads and updates are instantly synced across all devices, ensuring a consistent experience for all users.

faqs.q: How can I display uploaded photos and videos on a large screen during my event?
faqs.a: Memogram’s Screencast (Photo Wall) feature allows you to display all photos and videos uploaded by your guests on a large screen in real-time. You can set it up using a TV, projector, or any screen with internet access, and a device that can open a web browser.

faqs.q: Do guests need to download an app to upload photos and videos?
faqs.a: No, guests can upload their media instantly by scanning the QR code using their phone’s camera or browser—no app download required.

reviews_summary: Customers appreciate Memogram, praising its effortless photo and video collection via a simple QR code, the ease of setup for events, and the responsive customer support. faqs.q: What features does the Reading Position Indicator plugin offer?
faqs.a: The Reading Position Indicator plugin provides a horizontal progress bar displayed on posts and pages, customizable colors, opacity, rounded edges, and gradients. It is lightweight, performance-optimized, easy to set up without coding, translation-ready, and compatible with most WordPress themes.

faqs.q: How do I install and activate the Reading Position Indicator plugin?
faqs.a: To install and activate the Reading Position Indicator plugin: 1. Log in to your WordPress Admin panel. 2. Go to Plugins > Add New. 3. Search for 'Reading Position Indicator' and click Install Now. 4. After installation, click Activate. A new menu 'Progress' will appear under Appearance in your Admin Menu.

faqs.q: Can I customize the appearance of the progress bar?
faqs.a: Yes, you can customize the progress bar's colors, opacity, rounded edges, and gradients through the plugin settings under Appearance > Progress.

faqs.q: Will the progress bar affect my site's performance?
faqs.a: No, the plugin is lightweight and optimized to have minimal impact on your site's loading speed.

faqs.q: Is the progress bar responsive on mobile devices?
faqs.a: Yes, the progress bar is responsive and works well on all screen sizes.

faqs.q: What is included in the VectorGrove Lifetime Deal?
faqs.a: The VectorGrove Lifetime Deal offers unlimited access to over 2 million royalty-free vector images, regular updates with new vectors added weekly, a commercial license for personal and business use, organized collections for easy navigation, global usage rights, and fast download speeds. This is available for a one-time payment of $79.

faqs.q: What are the benefits of purchasing the VectorGrove Lifetime Deal?
faqs.a: Purchasing the VectorGrove Lifetime Deal provides a one-time payment with no monthly fees or yearly renewals, resulting in significant long-term savings. Users receive regular updates with fresh and trendy designs, unlimited downloads, and exclusive access to special collections and features available only to lifetime members.

faqs.q: What types of vector graphics does VectorGrove offer?
faqs.a: VectorGrove offers a wide range of vector graphics, including icons, illustrations, logos, infographics, cartoons, templates, fonts, flags, textures, and backgrounds. The platform adds approximately ten thousand new vectors every week, ensuring a constantly updated library.

faqs.q: How can I effectively search for vector graphics on VectorGrove?
faqs.a: VectorGrove provides advanced search features and filters to help users find the perfect vector graphics. Users can narrow down searches by text space, orientation, color, and safe search options. Additionally, organizing graphics into folders allows for better project management and easy access to favorites.

faqs.q: What are the licensing terms for VectorGrove's vector graphics?
faqs.a: VectorGrove offers both Standard and Extended Licenses. The Standard License allows use of images for web, social media, and advertisements, but does not permit reselling or trademarking designs without additional permissions. The Extended License is required for broader usage rights, such as reselling items with these designs.

faqs.q: Are there any limitations or restrictions with the VectorGrove Lifetime Deal?
faqs.a: The VectorGrove Lifetime Deal is for a single user and includes a daily download limit of 30 downloads. The deal is non-refundable and must be redeemed within 60 days of purchase. Reselling or redistributing files outside permitted uses is not allowed.

faqs.q: Is VectorGrove suitable for beginners?
faqs.a: Yes, VectorGrove is suitable for beginners. The user-friendly interface makes it easy to find and download vector graphics, and the platform offers a free plan, which is great for those starting out. Paid users also benefit from a 7-day refund policy.

faqs.q: How does VectorGrove compare to other vector graphic platforms?
faqs.a: VectorGrove offers a vast library of over 2 million royalty-free vector images at a budget-friendly price, including a free plan. While the quality of free images may vary, the platform provides flexible licensing and is easier to use than some competitors like Adobe Stock. However, for exclusive or high-end images, other platforms might be more suitable.

reviews_summary: Customers appreciate VectorGrove for its vast selection of free vector graphics, fair usability, and solid offer of free products. Some users have expressed disappointment with the standard license limitations and occasional website issues. Despite this, VectorGrove remains a valuable resource for free vector artwork, empowering creativity with millions of royalty-free vectors and graphics.

faqs.q: What is FlexClip?
faqs.a: FlexClip is an easy-to-use video editor available for Windows, Mac, and Linux. It offers over 4,000 templates for various purposes, including education, business, marketing, festivals, special events, and social media platforms. Users can enhance videos with animated texts, widgets, overlays, intros, and outros. The platform also provides access to over 4 million royalty-free videos, music, and photos. Key features include trimming, splitting, converting, combining, adjusting speed, recording voice-overs, screen and webcam recording, and support for popular formats like MOV, WEBM, M4V, MP4, AAC, FLAC, M4A, and MP3.

faqs.q: How does FlexClip work?

faqs.q: What browsers does FlexClip support?

faqs.q: Can I use FlexClip on my mobile phone?
faqs.a: Yes, you can access FlexClip on your mobile phone to use various image tools. However, for generating and editing videos, it is recommended to use a PC or Mac.

faqs.q: How can I trim a video clip in FlexClip?
faqs.a: To trim a video clip in FlexClip, select the clip and click the 'Trim' button on the timeline track. Then, drag the scene's left and right borders to the desired positions. Alternatively, you can trim the clip in the Media section by clicking the thumbnail and adjusting its length.

faqs.q: How do I record my screen using FlexClip?
faqs.a: To record your screen with FlexClip, click on 'Media' > 'Record' > 'Record Screen or Webcam' and select 'Screen Only.' Adjust the recording settings and click 'Start Recording.' Choose the screen you want to record and click 'Share.' After recording, click 'Stop recording' to review and edit your recording.

faqs.q: What should I do if I encounter bugs when using FlexClip?
faqs.a: If you encounter any bugs or issues while using FlexClip, please contact the support team at [email redacted] with detailed information about the problem. They will assist you in resolving the issue as soon as possible.

faqs.q: Why are AI-generated subtitles incomplete or failing in FlexClip?
faqs.a: AI-generated subtitles may be incomplete or fail due to several reasons: the project contains multiple audio tracks, the video/audio has original background music, or the video/audio is too long. To improve subtitle generation, ensure only one vocal track is present, separate vocals from background music, and keep each audio/video clip under 20 minutes.

faqs.q: What should I do if my video project is not loading in FlexClip?
faqs.a: If your video project fails to load, first check if the image and video files in the Media section have loaded correctly. If not, click 'Retry' or 'Relink.' If the loading icon keeps spinning or a white screen appears, update your browser, clear the cache, or try using an incognito window. If the issue persists, contact FlexClip support with your account and project ID.

faqs.q: What is ImageDino and what can it be used for?
faqs.a: ImageDino is a platform that automates image generation from a single design template and dynamic data. Using its visual editor you design a template, connect data (API / files / automation tools) and map parameters so ImageDino can generate large numbers of images for use cases such as e‑commerce product images, ad banners, personalized email visuals, Open Graph/link previews, social posts, real‑estate listings and other bulk or dynamic creatives.

faqs.q: Does ImageDino offer a developer API?
faqs.a: Yes. ImageDino provides a REST API for rendering published designs from code (developers send a design ID and modifiers and receive rendered image URLs). Documentation and API reference are published in the ImageDino docs.

faqs.q: How do I create an image via the API?
faqs.a: You call the renders endpoint (POST /v1/renders) with your API key, a published design_id, modifiers for the fields you want to change (for example text, fills, font size) and output options; the API returns an image URL. The docs show a curl example that posts design_id, mode (sync/async), modifiers and output.format/scale.

faqs.q: How do I authenticate API requests to ImageDino?
faqs.a: ImageDino API requests are authenticated using Bearer API keys. The documentation instructs keeping API keys server‑side and making API requests from a trusted environment.

faqs.q: Do I need a Figma account to use ImageDino?
faqs.a: Yes — ImageDino uses your Figma design as the template source, so you must have a Figma account to automate image generation from Figma frames. The site states a free Figma account is sufficient.

faqs.q: What data sources and integrations does ImageDino support for bulk or automated generation?
faqs.a: ImageDino supports bringing in data from files and CSVs and integrates with no‑code automation tools (the site references Make and Zapier/Airtable/Google Sheets integrations) so you can connect product catalogs or spreadsheets and generate images automatically at scale.

faqs.q: Does ImageDino support Dynamic URLs or signed image URLs for on‑the‑fly rendering?
faqs.a: Yes. The documentation includes a Dynamic URLs section: ImageDino can render images from URL parameters and supports signing protected URLs on your server so images can be generated or served dynamically with access control.

faqs.q: What output options (formats and scaling) are available when rendering images?
faqs.a: The API render request supports output configuration such as format (for example "png") and scale (numeric scale factor). The docs show these fields in the POST /v1/renders example.

faqs.q: How do I change design elements (text, fills, fonts, sizes) when rendering?
faqs.a: The docs provide 'Modifiers' and 'Fonts' references: render requests can change named properties (modifiers) such as text, fills, font family/weight/size, position, opacity, strokes, shadows and rounded corners to produce the desired variant of a published design.

faqs.q: What is AvoMap?
faqs.a: AvoMap is an online tool that allows users to transform their adventures and events into animated 3D videos. It enables the creation of route maps by uploading GPX or KML files or manually designing custom routes, which can then be customized and exported as high-quality videos.

faqs.q: How do I create a 3D video of my route using AvoMap?
faqs.a: To create a 3D video with AvoMap: 1) Upload a GPX or KML file, or manually design your route using the AvoMap editor. 2) Customize your route by adding segments like drive, walk, or flight, and insert pauses or adjust camera angles. 3) Preview the animation in real-time and tweak settings for smooth transitions, labels, and map styles. 4) Export your video in Full HD or 4K resolution.

faqs.q: Is AvoMap compatible with mobile devices?
faqs.a: Yes, AvoMap is fully optimized for mobile devices. You can convert files and create 3D videos directly from your phone or tablet using any modern mobile browser without the need for app installation.

faqs.q: Do I need to install any software to use AvoMap?
faqs.a: No installation is required. AvoMap is a completely browser-based tool, allowing you to convert files and create videos instantly without downloading or setting up any software. It works on Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, and Android.

faqs.q: Can I add custom markers or symbols to my route in AvoMap?
faqs.a: Yes, AvoMap allows you to add markers, symbols, or points of interest to your map easily. It offers over 100 presets for various occasions, and you can also upload your own symbols and icons, placing them anywhere along your route and customizing their size and appearance.

faqs.q: Is AvoMap free to use?
faqs.a: The AvoMap video editor is free to use without any limitations or settings restrictions. You can use it as long as needed until you're satisfied with the preview of your video. Each export and rendering of your video will cost 1 Render Credit. AvoMap operates on a pay-per-use model without monthly subscriptions or hidden fees.

faqs.q: How long does it take to render a video in AvoMap?
faqs.a: Most videos are ready within a few minutes. Even 4K videos render quickly thanks to AvoMap's optimized cloud-based pipeline.

faqs.q: Can I convert GPX files to KML using AvoMap?
faqs.a: Yes, AvoMap offers a free GPX to KML converter that allows you to convert GPX files to KML in seconds with an instant 3D preview. The tool is browser-based and does not require any software installation.

faqs.q: Is it safe to use AvoMap's converters?
faqs.a: Yes, your privacy is important to AvoMap. All conversions happen entirely in your browser—your files are never uploaded, stored, or shared with any server. It's 100% secure and private.

faqs.q: Does AvoMap support large files?
faqs.a: Yes, AvoMap can handle most standard GPX and KML files used in common mapping and fitness apps. However, extremely large files with tens of thousands of points may be slower to process, depending on your device's performance.

reviews_summary: Customers are all about AvoMap, praising its ease of use, responsive developer, and continuous updates. There are a few hiccups like additional costs for certain features and minor UI issues on mobile. Weighing the raves against the occasional grumbles, AvoMap is hitting the mark and is a solid buy for those in need of a tool to bring their routes and adventures to life with stunning animated maps. body: None

faqs.q: What does Voicina do?
faqs.a: Voicina is an AI media localization workspace that handles transcription, subtitles, translation, dubbing, voiceover, and live real-time captions — all in one place. Upload a file or paste a link, and you can transcribe, generate subtitles, translate into 125+ languages, and produce dubbed audio without switching tools.

faqs.q: What is lifetime access?
faqs.a: You pay once and keep access to your tier's features and monthly credit allowance forever, including future updates. AppSumo's standard 60-day money-back guarantee applies.

faqs.q: What are credits and how are they used?
faqs.a:
Credits are Voicina's usage currency. Each feature consumes credits at a different rate: 
-Transcription: 2 credits/min
- Subtitles: 2 credits/min
- Subtitle translation: 13 credits/min per language
- Fast subtitle translation: 3 credits/min per language
- Voiceover: 60 credits/min per language
- Light voiceover: 35 credits/min per language
- Text to speech: 60 credits/min
- Light text to speech: 35 credits/min
- Real-time captions: 5 credits/session min
- Real-time translation: 5 credits/session min
- Real-time voiceover: 52 credits/session min
A full dub costs 75 credits/min per language (2 transcription + 13 translation + 60 text to speech). With the fast/light options, it's 40 credits/min (2 + 3 + 35).

faqs.q: Which languages does Voicina support?
faqs.a: Voicina supports transcription, subtitles, and dubbing across 125+ languages. For dubbing and translation, the platform uses context-aware translation rather than word-by-word substitution, and voice cloning lets you reuse a speaker's voice across languages so the dubbed version sounds like the same person. Transcription for languages written without spaces between words, such as Chinese, Japanese, and Thai, is still being improved. Translating and dubbing into these languages works fully.

faqs.q: What is voice cloning and how does it work?
faqs.a: Voice cloning lets you clone any speaker's voice you have the right to use from a sample and reuse it across languages. If you dub a podcast host into Spanish, the dubbed version sounds like that host — not a generic TTS voice. Clone once, use across every language and project.

faqs.q: What are real-time sessions?
faqs.a: Live sessions let you run meetings, streams, and events with real-time captions, live translation, and live dubbing. Real-time sessions are included on all AppSumo tiers.

faqs.q: Does Voicina have an API?
faqs.a: Pro and higher accounts can create Bearer API keys in the dashboard. The API covers transcription, subtitles, voiceover, and text to speech — all running against your existing credit balance, not a separate meter. REST API access is included on all AppSumo tiers.

faqs.q: What formats can I export?
faqs.a: Voicina exports SRT, VTT, TXT, and JSON. You can also burn subtitles directly into the video file as hardsubs. SRT, TXT, VTT, SBV, and JSON export are included on all AppSumo tiers. Dubbed videos are exported as MP4.

faqs.q: Can I use Voicina for live events and meetings?
faqs.a: Yes. Live sessions give you real-time captions, live translation as you speak, and live dubbing with real-time voice. Live sessions run in the Voicina web app, and they depend on your own network connection and hardware. There are currently no direct Zoom, Meet, or Teams integrations.

faqs.q: Is my content private? How long do you keep my files?
faqs.a: Yes, files are encrypted. Uploaded media and generated speech are kept for 60 days and then permanently deleted, so download your exports before then. You can delete a project at any time. Your recordings are never used to train anything.

faqs.q: What subtitle formats can I export, and can I burn captions into the video?
faqs.a: You can export SRT, VTT and SBV for editors that need soft captions. You can also burn styled captions directly into the video file. Pick a caption preset or set your own fonts, colors, margins and position. Timing, wording and styling can all be fine-tuned before you export.

faqs.q: Can the dub sound like the original speaker?
faqs.a: Yes. With voice cloning, you clone a speaker's voice once and reuse it across languages, so your host still sounds like your host. You can also pick from a library of hundreds of voices and accents. Cloning is only for voices you have the right to use. Our Terms don't allow cloning a real person's voice without their consent.

faqs.q: How does AI dubbing work?
faqs.a: Voicina transcribes your video, translates it into your target language, and generates a voice for each line. The dub is fitted to the original timing, and lines that would run too fast are adjusted so the speech keeps a natural pace. You can review everything before exporting. Voicina does not speed up the voice to fit the original timing. Instead, it manages the pacing of each line so the dub keeps a natural speaking speed.

faqs.q: How is Voicina's translation different from plain machine translation?
faqs.a:
- Context-aware translation of the whole file, not line by line
- Formal or conversational tone, chosen by the user
- Consistent names and terms across the file (Voicina extracts each video's terminology automatically)
- Subtitles respect reading speed and line length
- In dubbing, lines are adapted to the original timing so the voice keeps a natural pace
- Side-by-side review before publishing

faqs.q: How accurate is the transcription, and does it detect different speakers?
faqs.a: Transcription includes speaker detection, punctuation and word-level timestamps. Accuracy depends on audio quality: clear recordings give the best results. Everything stays editable, so you can search, correct and export without leaving the tab. Transcription for languages written without spaces between words, such as Chinese, Japanese, and Thai, is still being improved. Translating and dubbing into these languages works fully.

faqs.q: What kinds of files can I upload?
faqs.a: You can upload MP4, MOV, MP3, WAV and M4A files up to 2 GB. You can also paste a YouTube or media link, or record directly in your browser. Everything goes through the same pipeline, whichever way it gets in.

faqs.q: What does VideoMule do with a screen recording?
faqs.a:
VideoMule analyzes the actions in your recording, writes a script to explain them, and generates an AI voiceover synced to the video. You can then edit the script and finish the tutorial in the video editor.

Use it to explain a software feature, walk a customer through a task, or record a process for your team.

faqs.q: Can I change the script and edit the video?
faqs.a: Yes. Edit script lines and regenerate the narration after a change. The multitrack editor lets you work with video, audio, and captions, with zoom-ins and callouts to help viewers follow the steps.

faqs.q: Which allowances renew each month?
faqs.a:
Usage is charged based on the analysis mode you select when processing a recording, not on whether the recording contains audio. The Audio only mode uses your monthly upload minutes, while the Video only and Both modes use your one-time video-analysis minutes. Upload minutes and cloud renders renew monthly. Video-analysis minutes, avatar generation, avatar training, and translations are one-time allocations, and monthly upload minutes do not replenish your video-analysis allowance. Check the tier table for the amounts included in your plan. Once you use your included video-analysis allowance, you can purchase additional credits.
Silent recordings use the separate video-analysis allowance. Monthly upload minutes do not replenish that allowance. Check the tier table for the amounts included in your plan. Additional video-analysis credits are available for purchase once you use your includ

faqs.q: Can I create a translated version of a tutorial?
faqs.a:
Yes. VideoMule can create a translated script, voiceover, and captions for the same screen recording. Each AppSumo tier includes a one-time translation allocation, shown in the pricing table.

One credit covers one translation of one video. You can also purchase additional credits through the "150 video analysis minutes" add-on available above for $59 per 150 minute pack.

faqs.q: Can I add an avatar or create one of myself?
faqs.a:
Yes. Choose a stock presenter, or use your tier's photo-avatar or digital-twin training allowance to create an avatar of yourself. Each tier also has a separate one-time allowance for generating avatar video.

Quality affects usage: one minute of output uses 1 credit at Normal quality, 3 at Standard quality, or 4 at High quality. During the refund window, available credits are 2 / 4 / 6 / 8 / 10 for Tiers 1–5 respectively. The rest of your included avatar credits become available after the 60-day refund window.

faqs.q: How does the ElevenLabs connections work?
faqs.a: You can connect your own provider key to use premium voiceover, voice cloning, and dubbing through ElevenLabs. VideoMule does not meter generations made with your supported provider key. The provider's own charges and limits apply.

faqs.q: What is the difference between local and cloud renders?
faqs.a:
A render creates the finished video file. Local renders use your own device and are unlimited on every tier. Cloud renders run on remote servers and count toward the monthly cloud-render allowance in your plan.

Exporting locally does not replenish the separate upload, video-analysis, avatar, or translation allowances.

faqs.q: What is Tough Tongue AI?
faqs.a: Tough Tongue AI is a platform that enables users to build, customize, and deploy advanced multimodal AI agents for various applications, including sales coaching, leadership development, and interview preparation. These agents can process voice directly and interact using tools like whiteboards, slides, images, and code editors.

faqs.q: How can I integrate Tough Tongue AI with my existing phone system?
faqs.a: To integrate Tough Tongue AI with your phone system, you'll need a SIP trunking account with a telephony provider (such as Twilio, Plivo, or Vonage) and one or more phone numbers in E.164 format. This setup allows your AI agents to place and receive real phone calls, with features like transcripts, optional recordings, and post-call analysis.

faqs.q: What are the benefits of using AI-powered sales coaching with Tough Tongue AI?
faqs.a: AI-powered sales coaching with Tough Tongue AI offers hyper-realistic scenarios and personalized coaching experiences. It allows sales teams to practice objection handling and closing techniques, receive feedback on voice and expressions, and improve their performance through consistent, high-quality coaching without adding headcount.

faqs.q: Can Tough Tongue AI be used for interview preparation?
faqs.a: Yes, Tough Tongue AI provides AI-powered simulations for job interview preparation. Users can engage in high-quality mock interviews and receive personalized feedback on their performance, helping them refine their skills and boost confidence.

faqs.q: What integrations are available with Tough Tongue AI?
faqs.a: Tough Tongue AI integrates with various platforms, including Gmail, Google Sheets, HubSpot, Cal.com, Calendly, Google Meet, and Zoom. These integrations enable seamless deployment of AI agents across different channels and tools.

faqs.q: I redeemed my AppSumo plan, but Tough Tongue still shows the Free plan. What do I do?
faqs.a:
AppSumo Tier 3 and Tier 4 are team accounts, so the paid plan and minutes live on the org and not on your personal workspace. Sign-in often opens personal first, which is why it still looks like Free.

To switch, after you log in, go to the top right and select your team account. Then open Billing: you'll see both the org balance (your AppSumo plan) and your personal balance. You can add minutes to your personal account from Members tab.

Walkthrough: https://youtu.be/JGMLJA06mU4

reviews_summary: Customers appreciate Tough Tongue AI, praising its ability to create interactive AI agents for live calls, run engaging demos, and provide effective coaching. The user-friendly interface and onboarding support are also standout features. Minor drawbacks include occasional lag in responses and some initial confusion around setting up agents. Overall, Tough Tongue AI is making waves in the market, and with a 60-day money-back guarantee, it's a no-brainer to give it a try for anyone looking to enhance their business interactions!

faqs.q: What features does IdeaBuddy offer to help develop and validate a business idea?
faqs.a: IdeaBuddy provides a comprehensive suite of tools to assist in developing and validating business ideas. Key features include a step-by-step business planning guide, financial planning tools, a business plan builder, an Idea Plan canvas for visualizing business models, and an idea validation tool to assess the feasibility of your concept.

faqs.q: How does the Idea Plan canvas assist in structuring a business model?
faqs.a: The Idea Plan canvas allows users to quickly map out their business model by using sticky notes to brainstorm ideas and connecting building blocks to define how the business will create value for target customers. It provides an overview of the business model and helps identify internal and external factors that may affect the business.

faqs.q: Can I collaborate with team members using IdeaBuddy?
faqs.a: Yes, IdeaBuddy enables collaboration by allowing users to invite team members and mentors to brainstorm together. Collaborators can be given access to view or edit progress directly within the platform.

faqs.q: Does IdeaBuddy offer AI assistance in business planning?
faqs.a: Yes, IdeaBuddy incorporates AI-powered tools to support users at every step of their planning journey. The AI provides tailored suggestions, helps estimate revenues and expenses, and offers writing assistance in multiple languages.

faqs.q: What export options are available for business plans and financial projections in IdeaBuddy?
faqs.a: Users can export their Canvas, Financial Plan, or Business Plan as Word documents, PDFs, or Excel files. Additionally, they can share a link with partners and investors.

faqs.q: Is there a feature in IdeaBuddy to plan and document the technology stack for a business?
faqs.a: While IdeaBuddy does not have a dedicated unit for planning a technology stack, users can utilize the Notes section to document additional information related to their planning, including the tech stack. Additionally, the whiteboard tool can be used for brainstorming and visualizing ideas, though this feature may not be available in all plans.

faqs.q: How does IdeaBuddy assist in financial planning for startups?
faqs.a: IdeaBuddy's Financial Plan feature helps users create realistic financial projections by using AI suggestions and automated financial calculators. It allows for forecasting profit and loss, making cash flow projections, and mapping out the future of the business, even for users without a strong financial background.

faqs.q: What is the purpose of the idea validation tool in IdeaBuddy?
faqs.a: The idea validation tool helps users quickly evaluate the strength and viability of their business idea. It involves a questionnaire based on the steps completed in the Guide and the assumptions used, resulting in an overall score and highlighting areas that need improvement.

faqs.q: Does IdeaBuddy offer industry-specific templates and guides?
faqs.a: Yes, IdeaBuddy provides idea templates with industry-based business guides. These templates offer detailed instructions for every step of starting a business, tailored to specific industries, making it easier to understand the requirements for launching a business in that field.

faqs.q: Is IdeaBuddy accessible on mobile devices?
faqs.a: Yes, IdeaBuddy is mobile-friendly, allowing users to work on their ideas from the palm of their hand. This ensures that users can continue their planning process while on the go.

reviews_summary: Customers appreciate IdeaBuddy, praising its intuitive interface, AI-powered guidance, and structured approach to business planning. The software excels at helping users validate ideas and create actionable plans. Recent updates have improved financial projections and usability, addressing previous concerns. There are still some minor drawbacks, such as limited export options, but these are just small bumps on the road. Weighing the raves against the occasional grumbles, IdeaBuddy is hitting the mark and is a solid buy for aspiring entrepreneurs. With a 60-day money-back guarantee, it’s worth giving it a try for just $69!
