body:
$1 Million Online Business
 is an ebook created by AppSumo and Jack Butcher to help service business owners earn more in less time—by productizing yourself.


 
 
 
 
 


Jack Butcher was a designer who started his own agency, and even though he was successful, he was still strapped for time.


He realized he needed to 
break the constraints of running a service business
, and that meant thinking unconventionally.


Jack’s business, Visualize Value, was his way of “productizing himself” to take back his time and turn his design work into a scalable, one-person business.


With this playbook, you can 
make your work go way further by yourself with the exact tactics Jack Butcher used
.


 
 
 
 
 


Jack’s online following is no joke, either.


He regularly creates new graphics to share to an audience of hundreds of thousands, distilling complex learnings into simple black and white illustrations.


We 
break down the steps Jack took to go viral
, grow his Twitter following, and ultimately get big names in business to share his posts.


 
 
 
 
 


What does it take to become an expert in your field?


This ebook 
explores how Jack put in the deep work
 to become an expert designer through the power of feedback and iteration.


With these lessons, you’ll 
discover how to master your own craft, get people’s attention, and build your audience
.


Plus, 
$1 Million Online Business
 unpacks how to use the resources you already have to
 learn from the best mentors in your field and carve out your own brand
.


When you’re done, you’ll know how to make yourself the product—not just the work you do for other people. And you’ll have the tools to just keep on growing.


 
 
 
 
 


You only have so much time, and selling it all to other people is a surefire way to miss out on what’s 
really
 important (e.g., sleeping in past 11 a.m. and taking impromptu trips to Target).


The $1 Million Online Business ebook was created with Jack Butcher to help you scale your business services while freeing up your time—all without increasing your budget.


Make your work go further.


Get access to 
$1 Million Online Business: How Jack Butcher Productized Himself to Launch a One-Person, Seven-Figure Company
 today!

body:
The Mint Marketing Plan for Any Business Launch is an ebook that breaks down actionable, real-world strategies for launching your business.


 
 
 
 
 


First things first — you’ll need to have a destination in mind if you’re going to follow a roadmap.


This ebook starts you off right by helping you figure out your goals.


You’ll get crucial advice on how to effectively 
define success for your business
, so you can move on to 
specifying your audience
.


Outlining your targeted users is simple with the 
interactive worksheets provided
, and you’ll have a much more concrete idea of how to get your product into their hands.


Now that you know the endgame, it’s time to figure out how to get there.


 
 
 
 
 

Quant-based marketing sounds like something out of 
Star Trek
, but it’s not a complex sci-fi concept (
yet)
.


You’ll learn this 
hyper-effective marketing system
 
the easy way
, with 
weekly tactics and handy visualizations
 to keep you on track.

Everything explained in the guide is, above all, 
actionable
.
 

Skip the pretentious discussions on theory and get to the nitty-gritty parts that’ll put money in your pocket.


Noah used this exact method to get a million users in six months, so you’re in excellent company.


Getting into marketing specifics is the meat of the book, with 
streamlined chapters on messaging, SEO, content strategy, social media and more
.


 
 
 
 
 


Each section starts with a clear definition of what Noah did with each concept, as well as the “how” of it.


For every week of the quant-based marketing system, you’ll have tasks and checklists to keep you grounded and get you tangible results.


You’ll learn how to track your progress and measure your outcomes so you can get even better with time, like a fine wine or your retirement fund.


 
 
 
 
 


As the title suggests, 
The Mint Marketing Plan 
can be 
applied to any business launch 
you can think of.


That’s because you’re getting the rundown on specific marketing efforts with 
real-world effects
 on an actual company.


You’re also getting an inside look behind mistakes made along the way, so you don’t have to repeat the process.


The book is designed to be a 
versatile guide that’s matched to your needs
 and focused on making your launch as awesome as possible.


 
 
 
 
 

All too often business launches turn into hot-mess misfires.


That’s why you don’t want to go it alone based on generic advice or untested outcomes.


So take advantage of the marketing strategies developed by one of the best in the biz.


You’ll send your company straight to the moon (without putting a dent in your marketing budget).


Get 
The Mint Marketing Plan for Any Business Launch
 for free today!

faqs.q: What are the key strategies recommended in 'Noah Kagan's YouTube Growth Hacks' for increasing video views?
faqs.a: The key strategies include optimizing your channel page with Power Playlists and a compelling 'About' section, focusing on quality over quantity in video production, leveraging suggested videos by creating content on high-volume topics, avoiding production mistakes like boring intros or poor audio, embedding videos on your blog to drive more views, and designing thumbnails with standout colors to increase click-through rates.

faqs.q: How can I predict which YouTube videos will be popular?
faqs.a: To predict popular videos, create 'searchable and discovery content' by researching your niche for high-view, low-subscriber videos, analyzing their titles, thumbnails, and content, and applying these insights to your own videos to increase the chances of being featured as suggested content.

faqs.q: Why is posting frequency important for YouTube channel growth?
faqs.a: Posting frequently is crucial because YouTube's algorithm favors content that brings viewers back regularly. Increasing your posting frequency, such as moving from two to three times per week, can enhance your channel's growth by aligning with viewer habits and platform preferences.

faqs.q: What are 'Power Playlists' and how do they benefit my YouTube channel?
faqs.a: Power Playlists are curated collections of your videos organized around specific themes or topics. They help in keeping viewers engaged longer by guiding them through related content, thereby increasing watch time and improving your channel's performance in YouTube's algorithm.

faqs.q: How can I effectively use thumbnails to increase my YouTube video's click-through rate?
faqs.a: To enhance click-through rates, design thumbnails that complement your video titles without repeating text, use clear visuals that connect with the title, and avoid redundant text in the thumbnail. This approach makes your videos more appealing and encourages more clicks.

faqs.q: What role does audience retention play in growing a YouTube channel?
faqs.a: Audience retention, or how long viewers watch your videos, is critical for channel growth. High retention rates signal to YouTube that your content is engaging, leading to better promotion. To improve retention, start videos with a strong hook, avoid unnecessary images before speaking, and eliminate rambling.

faqs.q: How can I leverage collaborations to grow my YouTube channel?
faqs.a: Collaborating with other creators allows you to tap into their audience, increasing your reach. Find complementary channels, offer mutual value, and create content that appeals to both audiences to maximize the benefits of collaboration.

faqs.q: What are some common production mistakes to avoid on YouTube?
faqs.a: Common mistakes include having boring intros, poor audio quality, and videos that are too short. Ensuring engaging openings, clear sound, and appropriate video length can significantly improve viewer experience and retention.

faqs.q: How can embedding my YouTube videos on my blog help increase views?
faqs.a: Embedding your YouTube videos in blog posts can drive additional traffic to your videos, increasing views. This strategy leverages your existing audience and enhances your content's reach.

faqs.q: What is the importance of creating both 'searchable and discovery content' and 'community content'?
faqs.a: Creating 'searchable and discovery content' helps attract new viewers through search and suggested videos, while 'community content' caters to your existing audience, fostering loyalty and engagement. Balancing both types ensures steady channel growth and viewer satisfaction.

reviews_summary: Customers appreciate Noah Kagan's YouTube Growth Hacks for its actionable content, practical tips, and user-friendly format. Some wish for more in-depth coverage of analytics. Overall, the overwhelmingly positive feedback makes it a solid choice for anyone looking to grow their YouTube channel. With an overall rating of 4.9 and 13 reviews, the love for this freebie is loud and clear, making it a must-have for YouTube creators.

body:

 will help you 
find success after acquisition
. (

)

.

.

From raising prices to automating workflows, 
The Acquisition Playbook
 gives you proven strategies you can start using today to make the most of your newly acquired business.


Make smarter plays with your business.


Get free access to 
The Acquisition Playbook
 today!

body:
The Collection of 10 SaaS Acquisition Books is a series of ebooks that covers everything you need to know about acquiring or selling a SaaS business.


 
 
 
 
 




Thinking about selling your SaaS business? Or maybe you want to acquire a SaaS brand? Maybe you’re that unicorn that wants to do both. (
You go-getter you.
)


This Collection of 10 SaaS Acquisition Books was created by Andrew Gazdecki, CEO at MicroAquire, a marketplace for startup acquisitions. 


He’s taken his experience from
 helping over 300+ startups get acquired 
and distilled it into 10 ebooks covering different aspects of acquisition from both the buyer and seller perspective.


 
 
 
 
 



Acquiring a startup involves months of due diligence, paperwork, and endless meetings, so it’s important to 
go into the process with a basic understanding of what to expect
.


In this collection, you’ll 
learn why you should buy a SaaS startup, three signs a SaaS business is worth acquiring, and what to expect from the 6 legal stages of acquisition
.


You’ll also
 get important details on financing your startup acquisition
, like how to use SBA loans and how seller financing can help. (
“It’s just me and my cat in a studio—is that a small business?”
)


 
 
 
 
 



Selling a business for the first time? The acquisition process can be difficult to navigate unless you 
learn what you need to know about SaaS acquisition from the seller’s perspective
.


In this ebook collection, you’ll 
find guidance on how to correctly estimate the value of your SaaS startup
, helping you move confidently into the process. (
#KnowYourWorth
)


You’ll also
 learn how to prepare your startup for acquisition in just 6 steps
, so that you’re fully ready to go when the time comes.


 
 
 
 
 



SaaS acquisition takes time, but you don’t have to dread the process like it’s a bad trip to the dentist. (
“Uh, were we supposed to pull that one?”
)


This Collection of 10 SaaS Acquisition Books gives you all the information and insights you need to make the process a bit smoother, whether you’re selling or buying.


The collection covers 10 different topics that are all vital to the process, and you’re getting it for free!


Get free access to Collection of 10 SaaS Acquisition Books today!

Learn how to land the type of clients that will support your business long-term
Discover the financial formula that will show you when to make the big moves
body:
Starting From Zero is an online course that shows you an eight-step plan to build a solid freelance business from scratch.


 
 
 
 
 


The course is called Starting From Zero for a reason, so you won’t be thrown into the deep end of entrepreneurship. (
“Drowning in invoices…”
)


This course will
 show you practical tips on prototyping your service before you get started
.


Then you’ll move on to how to snag clients, even if you don’t have a client history.


And not just any clients, either—you’ll discover how to
 find the right client to give you solid footing for your service business in the long-term
.


 
 
 
 
 



Starting From Zero also guides you through deciding when to take your side hustle full-time with a methodical framework.


You’ll 
learn tricks for scaling word-of-mouth growth for your business
, so you don’t have to worry about adspend right off the bat.


This course will also teach you a simple financial formula that 
reveals when it’s time to make big moves 
and take your business to the next level.



 
 
 
 
 


Early adopters are key to any endeavor, and you’ll find out how to make them swoon for your service.


You’ll also
 learn sales amplification strategies for capitalizing on your initial success
, instead of just doing your happy dance in the kitchen (though we do encourage that, too).


Plus, one of the main takeaways from the course is how to a
void hidden debts while getting your business off the ground
. 


Thanks to Starting From Zero, you can rest assured that you won’t dip into the negatives.



 
 
 
 
 


The golden handcuffs of an unfulfilling 9 to 5 aren’t so easily broken, but that doesn’t mean you don’t have the power to wiggle out of them. (
“A freelance gig here, a little ebook there…”
)


Starting From Zero shows you how to take control of your work life, regardless of whether or not you have potential clients or a service plan laid out.


Don’t feel like you’re always stuck at the bottom.


Get free access to Starting From Zero today!

public_name: AppSumo's Freelancing and Consulting as a Side Hustle
subheader: Get expert advice on how to launch a freelance or consulting side hustle that actually pays
highlights: Get multiple blueprints for setting your rates (and earning what you’re worth)
Find your first clients using nine proven techniques
Learn the best practices for sending invoices, avoiding sketchy clients, managing your time, and so much more
body:
Freelancing and Consulting as a Side Hustle
 is the ultimate launch guide for anyone who’s ever considered selling professional services.


 
 
 
 
 


Professional services are the lifehack you’re looking for to bolster your income (and shoestring budget).


Freelancing and consulting offer low overhead, flexible work schedules, and no employee drama—if you’re doing them right.


This ebook will 
break down the big issues for people just starting out, like how much to charge, when to pay taxes, and if you should incorporate
.


You’ll be free from the guesswork and early stumbling blocks of going solo, so you can launch with confidence.


 
 
 
 
 


There’s more than one way to price your services.


This guide
 shows you the four most common ways to charge
: hourly pricing, retainer, fixed fee, and the all-powerful value-based fee.


It also covers several pricing pointers, like what it means to factor “risk” into your pricing, to make sure you don’t under-charge for the services you’re offering (because you’re worth it).


 
 
 
 
 


One of the hardest parts of running a solo business is finding customers. That’s why 
Freelancing and Consulting as a Side Hustle
 offers nine ways to snag your first clients.


Dive into multiple tactics for using social media to connect with clients
, or try different partnerships with other freelancers and agencies to launch a powerful referral network.


You’ll also 
get networking pointers to help you get the most out of digital and in-person events
 (#nostalgia).


And there are even more tips to get you raking in new clients with ease.


 
 
 
 
 


This ebook features takeaways based on in-depth advice with heavy hitters in the freelancing/consulting space.


You’ll access tips from Michael Zipursky, the CEO of Consulting Success, that cover 
how to avoid the most common consulting mistakes
.


Learn from Rafael Espinal, Executive Director of Freelancers Union, who’s added his 
expertise on contracts and the importance of defining scope
.


We even 
included all the ideas and tactics we’ve learned over the years at AppSumo
 by helping and working with thousands (yes, thousands) of freelancers.


 
 
 
 
 


Starting something new is always daunting—if you have a bad first experience, you’re not inclined to try again. (
See also: why I don’t night snorkel.
)


Whether you’re just getting started in freelancing and consulting—or you’re preparing to launch—this guide will answer the most common questions and start you on the right foot.


Make sure you don’t put the “free” in “freelancing.”


Get access to 
Freelancing and Consulting as a Side Hustle
 today!

body:
Just Go With It
 is an ebook where entrepreneur, CEO, and innovator Mandy Gilbert shares her journey to guide and inspire both new and established entrepreneurs.


 
 
 
 
 




In 
Just Go With It
, entrepreneur, CEO, and innovator Mandy Gilbert shares her journey to 
guide and inspire both new and established entrepreneurs alike
. 


To Mandy, entrepreneurship is definitely an adventure worth taking—even if the path
is rarely a straight line. (Much like popping into Target for “just one thing.”)


In the book, she shares her lessons on how to 
strike that perfect balance between managing your personal life, developing your people, and maintaining a healthy bottom line
.


 
 
 
 
 



For those who are brand new to entrepreneurship, you’ll learn how to 
get started and build a solid business foundation that’ll let you stick around for the long haul
.


Chaos is part of the entrepreneurial experience. This book shows you ways to
 effectively deal with chaotic or unexpected circumstances
 based on Mandy’s own experiences.


You’ll also 
gain insights into how to reset the company culture
.

body:
The Ultimate Guide to Buying and Selling Online Businesses
 is your one-stop guide for navigating the secondary market for online companies.


 
 
 
 
 



With all the work it takes to get a business off the ground, purchasing a fully-formed company can be a smart choice for skipping the first several months or years of work.
 

The Ultimate Guide to Buying and Selling Online Businesses
 is your helpful companion into this exciting opportunity-filled world. (
It’ll be less confusing than NFTs, we promise.
)


We 
sourced the most common business buying and selling challenges and questions
 to help first-timers make an educated decision.


 
 
 
 
 



To write this guide, we
 interviewed several experts about their experiences buying and selling online businesses
.


Discover how copywriter Jacob McMillen bought a profitable blog that passively earns him $2,300 monthly and read about how Empire Flippers preps business owners for a seamless exit.
 

You’ll also 
learn how Noah Kagan used small WordPress plugin acquisitions
 as a marketing strategy to grow AppSumo.
 

Plus, the guide even 
offers insider tactics from Codie Sanchez about buying newsletters
 to expand her business.
 

 
 
 
 
 



What are the differences between Flippa, Empire Flippers, and other online business marketplaces?


How do you
 find under-monetized businesses that you can reasonably scale
?


How do you avoid falling for business buying scams? (
“I’ve got a bridge building business to sell you.”
)


With tips on where to buy your business, 
best practices for vetting businesses and how much to pay
, and advice on finding businesses with “moats,” we’ll tackle all these questions and more.


 
 
 
 
 



Buying is just half the battle.
 

Once you’ve grown an awesome business and you’re ready to sell, this guide will help you
 get your exit planning right and find the right buyer
.


You’ll uncover tips on how to sell your business for top dollar and
 learn exactly what to avoid
, from overcutting expenses to getting too attached to your business.


That way, whether you do it on your own or through a broker, you can sell with confidence.


 
 
 
 
 



“That’s none of your business!” But it could be... for the right price.


From valuation best practices to tactics for sourcing off-market deals, 
The Ultimate Guide to Buying and Selling Online Businesses
 is your starter pack for buying or selling online business.
 

So open up your possibilities with a new kind of investment.


Get access to 
The Ultimate Guide to Buying and Selling Online Businesses
 today!

faqs.q: Is this really a one-time payment?
faqs.a: Yes. You pay $29 or $79 once and get all future Lifetime plan updates. Pro ($8.25/mo billed yearly) is optional.

faqs.q: Individual or Agency?
faqs.a: Individual is one person. Agency adds 3 team members (4 seats including you), a team page, round robin, collective meetings, and 10 SMS a month.

faqs.q: Can I run more than one business or brand?
faqs.a: On Agency, yes. Your personal booking page covers one business, and each other business can be a team with its own name, logo, description, and page URL. Each booking type can have its own colors, so every brand's pages can match. A separate custom domain for each brand needs Pro. On Individual, use a second account for a second business.

faqs.q: Can I upgrade or stack codes?
faqs.a: There are no codes and no stacking. You can move up from Individual to Agency while the deal is live, or move down within 60 days. On an older TidyCal plan with a custom domain? Email [email redacted] before you upgrade so you keep it.

faqs.q: Are there fees on paid bookings?
faqs.a: Free and Lifetime pay a 1% platform fee on paid bookings, on top of Stripe or PayPal fees. Pro has none.

faqs.q: Can I remove TidyCal branding?
faqs.a: Lifetime plans show a "Powered by TidyCal" bar at the bottom of your booking page and a TidyCal logo in emails. Removing them and using your own domain are part of Pro.

faqs.q: Which calendars and video tools work?
faqs.a: Google, Outlook/Office 365, and Apple (iCal). Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams links are created automatically.

faqs.q: Do SMS reminders work outside the US and Canada?
faqs.a: Not yet. SMS is US/Canada only, on Agency (10/mo) and Pro. Email reminders work everywhere.

faqs.q: How do I reach support?
faqs.a: Email [email redacted]. A person on our team answers.

faqs.q: Can I try it first?
faqs.a: Yes. There's a free plan at tidycal.com, and AppSumo gives you 60 days to request a refund.

faqs.q: Do my teammates need their own plan?
faqs.a: No. Each teammate signs up for a free TidyCal account and accepts your invite. Your Agency plan covers the team page, round robin, and collective meetings. Teammates set their own availability. On a free account each teammate can connect 1 calendar. Only you, or an admin you choose, can edit team booking types. Zoom and Teams links for team bookings are created on your account. Google Meet links use the booked teammate's Google calendar.

faqs.q: How do I embed TidyCal on my website or landing page?
faqs.a:
There are two main ways to embed TidyCal on your website:
* Embed a specific Booking Type. This will display only the Booking Type you choose to embed.
* Embed your entire Booking Page. This will show all public Booking Types on an embed unit.

Time Blocks are crucial because they define the availability for your bookings. If your Time Blocks are too short, your dates might not show up.

faqs.a: A document is considered one document, regardless of changes or addendums. If you send it out for signing, it counts as one document, even if it's modified later.

faqs.q: Can I upload my custom logo?
faqs.a: Yes! Tier 2 supports custom logo for recipient facing email and document branding.

faqs.q: Does the recipient need an account to sign a document?
faqs.a: No, recipients do not need to create an account to sign the document. They can simply click the link and sign it on any device without signing up.

faqs.q: What is Clawdia?
faqs.a: Clawdia is an AI desktop workspace that allows users to control their browser, terminal, and filesystem through natural language commands. It leverages your active browser sessions to interact with authenticated accounts, enabling tasks like navigating websites, managing files, and executing scripts directly on your machine.

faqs.q: How do I install Clawdia on macOS?
faqs.a:
To install Clawdia on macOS, first ensure you have Homebrew installed. Then, execute the following commands in your terminal:

1. Install Node.js:
 ```
 brew install node@20
 ```

2. Install Clawdia globally using npm:
 ```
 npm install -g clawdia
 ```

3. Run the onboarding process:
 ```
 clawdia onboard
 ```

4. Access Clawdia at `http://localhost:3000`.

faqs.q: How can I install the Clawdia Chrome extension?
faqs.a:
To install the Clawdia Chrome extension:

1. Install the extension to a stable local path:
 ```
 clawdia browser extension install
 ```

2. Print the installed extension directory path:
 ```
 clawdia browser extension path
 ```

3. Open Chrome and navigate to `chrome://extensions`.

4. Enable 'Developer mode'.

5. Click 'Load unpacked' and select the directory printed in step 2.

6. Pin the extension for easy access.

faqs.q: What should I do if I encounter a 'GatewayLockError' when starting Clawdia?
faqs.a:
A 'GatewayLockError' indicates that another gateway instance is already listening on the specified port. To resolve this:

1. Ensure no other process is occupying the port.

2. If the port is in use, free it or choose another port by running:
 ```
 clawdia gateway --port 

 ```

3. If the issue persists, verify that no stale lock files are present and that the gateway is properly shutting down to release the port.

faqs.q: How can I manage and share AI skills using Clawdia?
faqs.a:
ClawdiaHub is a platform where you can discover, manage, and share AI skills to extend Clawdia's capabilities. It offers semantic search to find skills by meaning, version control for tracking changes, and community-driven features like ratings and recommendations. To install a skill, use the command:
 ```
 npx clawdiahub@latest install 

 ```

faqs.q: What is the difference between using cron jobs and heartbeat in Clawdia?
faqs.a: In Clawdia, 'heartbeat' handles routine monitoring tasks (e.g., checking inboxes, calendars) at regular intervals, while 'cron' is used for precise scheduling of tasks (e.g., daily reports, weekly reviews). Combining both allows for efficient automation: heartbeat for routine checks and cron for tasks requiring specific timing.

faqs.q: How does Clawdia handle context during interactions?
faqs.a: Clawdia's 'context' includes the system prompt, conversation history, tool calls/results, and attachments. This context is bounded by the model's token limit and is essential for maintaining coherent interactions. Users can inspect the context using commands like `/status`, `/context list`, and `/context detail` to monitor and manage the information being processed.

faqs.q: What are the security implications of using the Clawdia Chrome extension?
faqs.a: The Clawdia Chrome extension uses Chrome's debugger API to control your browser tabs, granting the model access to your active sessions. This means the model can click, type, navigate, and read page content within the attached tab. To mitigate risks, it's recommended to use a dedicated Chrome profile separate from personal browsing and to keep the browser control server restricted to trusted networks.

faqs.q: How can I contact Clawdia support for assistance?
faqs.a: For any questions or requests, you can contact Clawdia support via email at [email redacted] or by phone at 1-844-793-0727.

value_prop: Work With Me, People!

body:
Peoplebox is a tool that tracks remote employee performance and engagement, helps you build OKRs, and supports more productive 1:1s.




Let’s start with the dashboard, which lines up metrics that matter and 
provides an overview of Employee Net Promoter Scores (eNPS), Manager Scores, and Drivers
.


Advanced analytics and segmentation 
give you insight on exactly what needs to be improved
, so you can focus on managerial development and rewarding great work.


It’s all right there for your convenience.


 
 
 
 
 


The dashboard gives you an overview of useful insights, combined with powerful segmentation.


All that awesome dashboard info is built on honest feedback, too.


Peoplebox lets you 
run anonymous engagement surveys
 focused on remote teams, so you’ll always have up-to-date information.


Plus, 
speak with your team through anonymous messaging
 to get to the root of any problems without compromising the integrity of responses.


For sensitive subjects, it’s an even better alternative to face-to-face meetings (if you’re the one person who likes pineapple on pizza, your secret is safe).


 
 
 
 
 


Provide feedback through anonymous surveys and messaging for honest evaluations.


Get ready for way more productive 1:1s with Peoplebox.


First, you can 
sync with your Google or Outlook calendar
. That way, you’re not scrambling to get something together five minutes after the meeting was supposed to start (#whoops).


Plus, Peoplebox 
integrates with Slack
, so you can keep track of your meetings without leaving your chats!


 
 
 
 
 


Peoplebox’s Slack integration sends reminders about your 1:1s, so you never miss a beat!


The Peoplebox platform lets you 
view all of your previous 1:1s with a single scroll 
and start the meeting with the previous week’s action items.


Plus, 
get suggested talking points for both manager and employee
.


Peoplebox even allows you to peek at an employee’s productivity to see where potential hang ups might be.


 
 
 
 
 


Power-up your 1:1s with suggested talking points and quick views of all your previous meetings.


Remote teams tend to focus more on output than time management, since you don’t need to be in an office for a set time to get your work done.


That’s why Peoplebox lets you 
build Objectives and Key Results 
("OKRs")
 
to effectively set goals and measure outcomes.


Track your team’s progress through easy-to-read percentage bars
 for a comprehensive outlook on projects that keeps the team updated on goal performance.


You might find employees much more productive when they’re not fighting the morning traffic just to get to their desks.


 
 
 
 
 


Easily build and track OKRs to stay productive while working remotely!


Remote work has its own set of challenges, like finding reasons not to eat ice cream at 10 AM (
I don’t play by the rules of “breakfast”
). 


Your team needs special attention to match their new environment, and getting clear, honest feedback while staying on task is a tall order.


Peoplebox keeps everyone on the ball, merging feedback, messaging, analytics, productivity features, and managerial tools in perfect harmony.


Get one year of access to Peoplebox today!


P.S.
 Learn how to use Peoplebox like a pro by catching our training webinar replay here: 
Webinar Replay
!

faqs.q: What features does Peoplebox offer?
faqs.a: Peoplebox provides a comprehensive suite of features including performance reviews, OKRs (Objectives and Key Results), 1:1 meetings, engagement surveys, KPIs, 9-box grids, competency frameworks, and strategic meetings.

faqs.q: How can I integrate Microsoft Teams with Peoplebox?
faqs.a: To integrate Microsoft Teams with Peoplebox, ensure you have admin access to your Microsoft account and that your Peoplebox account uses the same email as your Microsoft Teams login. Download the Peoplebox app zip file, upload it via the Microsoft Teams admin center, and add it to the installed and pinned apps sections. After 10-15 minutes, the app will be available in Microsoft Teams.

faqs.q: What integrations does Peoplebox support for OKR management?
faqs.a: Peoplebox supports integrations with tools such as Google Sheets, Jira, BigQuery, MySQL, PostgreSQL, and HubSpot to facilitate seamless OKR management.

faqs.q: How do I add and invite employees to Peoplebox?
faqs.a: As an admin, navigate to 'Settings' in your profile, select 'Employees,' and click 'Add Employees.' Fill out the required fields, save, and then click 'Invite' under the status column to send an invitation to the new employee.

faqs.q: Can I customize performance review cycles in Peoplebox?
faqs.a: Yes, Peoplebox allows you to customize every step of your review process, including questions, reviewers, competency mapping, performance scoring, goal selection, approval, and cycle configuration.

faqs.q: How do I configure the performance review flow in Peoplebox?
faqs.a: To configure the performance review flow, click on the 'Reviews' icon in your dashboard, select 'Create New Cycle,' choose the type of review (360-degree or Performance), enter the review title, and configure the steps by enabling the desired reviewer types.

faqs.q: Who can see my 1-on-1 meeting notes in Peoplebox?
faqs.a: Notes in the 'Shared Notes' section are visible to both meeting attendees and admins. Notes in the 'Private Notes' section are only visible to you.

faqs.q: How secure is my data with Peoplebox?
faqs.a: Peoplebox is fully GDPR-compliant and follows SOC-2 standards, ensuring that your data is protected with the highest security measures.

faqs.q: Does Peoplebox provide support during implementation and onboarding?
faqs.a: Yes, Peoplebox offers white-glove support that includes admin training, manager training, and complete onboarding assistance.

faqs.q: Can I link goals with performance reviews in Peoplebox?
faqs.a: Yes, Peoplebox provides a single goal platform where all company, team, and individual goals can be aligned and updated in real-time, facilitating seamless integration with performance reviews.

reviews_summary: Customers appreciate Peoplebox, praising its unique features, clean UI, and solid support. A couple of minor drawbacks include the lack of white-label and multi-language support. However, considering the overwhelmingly positive feedback, Peoplebox is hitting the mark and is a solid buy for those in need of robust employee engagement and performance management for remote teams. Thank you! :)

faqs.q: What are the core capabilities of PlutusDoc relevant to AppSumo buyers?
faqs.a: PlutusDoc is an agent‑operated document workspace that drafts and edits documents, fills placeholders, adds recipients and signing fields, sends and tracks documents, runs reminders, provides document analytics and templates, and exposes the same actions to agents and to developers via an action layer. These capabilities (drafting, placeholders, sending, tracking, reminders, templates, analytics and an action registry) are described on PlutusDoc’s main product pages.

faqs.q: Does PlutusDoc support electronic signatures and working with uploaded PDFs?
faqs.a: Yes. PlutusDoc lets you add signature, initials, date and other fields to a page; uploaded PDFs can be drawn on, rotated, saved as a copy or over the original; and finished PDFs have signature fields flattened into the page so the signed result is fixed in the file.

faqs.q: Can I connect external agents or LLM clients (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini) to PlutusDoc?
faqs.a: Yes. PlutusDoc runs an MCP server and supports connecting MCP clients (including Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, Gemini or your own agent). Connected clients are authorized via OAuth and can call the same set of actions the app exposes, subject to scopes and approval gates.

faqs.q: How do external agents and integrations authenticate and get permission to act in PlutusDoc?
faqs.a: PlutusDoc uses OAuth 2.1 for MCP client connections (clients register and present a consent screen). Connections start with read scopes by default; write scopes are requested when an action genuinely needs them. Connected clients and API keys are listed in settings and can be revoked.

faqs.q: What developer interfaces does PlutusDoc provide and how do I start?
faqs.a: PlutusDoc provides a REST API and an MCP (agent) endpoint plus webhooks. The developer quickstart is: (1) create a scoped API key in the developer console, (2) make REST calls with bearer auth, a workspace header and an idempotency key on writes, and (3) receive lifecycle events via webhooks (document.created, .sent, .viewed, .signed, .completed, .declined, .voided).

faqs.q: What agent/developer actions are available (what can agents do)?
faqs.a: PlutusDoc exposes a single action registry of nineteen actions covering documents (list, read, create draft, send, check send‑readiness, list placeholders), reminders (read and send), analytics (summarize activity, explain a stalled document), contacts/teams (search contacts, list workspaces, read team state) and calendar actions (read availability, manage meetings, send reschedules).

faqs.q: How does PlutusDoc ensure actions taken by agents are auditable and governed?
faqs.a: Agent actions are subject to approval gates (seven of nineteen actions cannot complete without human approval), scoped OAuth grants (least privilege by default), revocable connections and keys, and a single audit trail that records every view, download, signature and agent action with time, IP address and device on the document record so agent activity appears in the same history as human actions.

faqs.q: What developer safeguards exist to avoid duplicate writes or unintended sends when using the API?
faqs.a: API keys are scoped and write requests are expected to include an idempotency key so retries cannot quietly create duplicate sends; webhooks cover the full document lifecycle so systems can observe state changes rather than guessing.

faqs.a: Equitest ensures data security through end-to-end encryption using AES-256 standards, compliance with SOC 2 Type II, GDPR, and IVS data handling protocols, and a zero-knowledge infrastructure where employees cannot access private financial data.

faqs.a: Equitest's AI automatically syncs and pulls the exact metrics required from over 3 million financial records, including data from 50,000+ public companies. This eliminates the need for manual data hunting and ensures efficient data integration and analysis.

faqs.a: Yes, Equitest is versatile and can be used for various valuation purposes, including buy/sell transactions, divorce and asset division, fundraising and equity dilution, early-stage/ideation evaluations, and public company analysis.

faqs.q: What additional reports can Equitest generate beyond business valuations?
faqs.a: Beyond valuations, Equitest automates the generation of diverse, audit-ready financial reports, including industry analysis, SWOT & Porter's Five Forces, M&A transaction analysis, 409A valuation reports, SDE multiple analysis, and DCF analysis.

faqs.q: What is Robomotion RPA?
faqs.a: Robomotion RPA is a cloud-native, low-code Robotic Process Automation platform that enables users to automate manual and repetitive tasks using programmable software robots. These robots can operate both web and desktop applications to streamline workflows and enhance efficiency.

faqs.q: How do I install Robomotion RPA on my system?
faqs.a: To install Robomotion RPA, download the appropriate installer for your operating system from the official website. The installer includes the Robomotion Desktop Application, Software Robot, and an Agent Software to interact with your machine. Detailed installation guides are available for various platforms.

faqs.q: What operating systems are compatible with Robomotion RPA?
faqs.a: Robomotion RPA supports multiple operating systems, including Windows, Linux (Ubuntu 22.04 and 24.04), macOS (ARM and Intel architectures), and Raspberry Pi. Specific installation packages are available for each platform.

faqs.q: Can Robomotion RPA automate web applications?
faqs.a: Yes, Robomotion RPA is highly effective at web automation. It can seamlessly connect and automate web applications, enabling tasks such as data extraction, content aggregation, and integration with API services.

faqs.q: How can I set up a robot to execute my automation flows?
faqs.a: Robots in Robomotion RPA are software agents installed on your computer, virtual machine, or remote server. They execute the automation flows you design in the Flow Designer. A robot can run one flow at a time and must complete the current flow before starting another.

faqs.q: Does Robomotion RPA support triggered automation?
faqs.a: Yes, Robomotion RPA supports triggered automation. Instead of scheduling flows to check for events, robots can watch for specific events in the background and start a flow when an event occurs. Supported triggers include File System, Email, HTTP, and Queue triggers.

faqs.q: What is the difference between Development and Production Robots in Robomotion RPA?
faqs.a: Development Robots are intended exclusively for development purposes and are not eligible for scheduling or trigger-based operations. Production Robots serve both development and production purposes and can seamlessly transition between developmental tasks and actual production operations.

faqs.q: How can I secure my RPA reports with SSL on my web service?
faqs.a: To secure your RPA reports with SSL on your web service, create a directory named 'robomotion_certificates' in your C: drive, move your .crt and .key files to this directory, and edit the 'config.properties' file located at '%LOCALAPPDATA%\Robomotion\config.properties' to point to these certificate files.

faqs.q: What should I do if I encounter a capture device auto-detect problem on Mac?
faqs.a: If you encounter a capture device auto-detect problem on Mac, open the Terminal and run the command '$HOME/.config/robomotion/packages/bin/Robomotion/FFmpeg/0.2.3/ffmpeg -f avfoundation -list_devices true -i ""' to list available capture devices. Then, update the 'msg.recording_input' value in your flow with the correct device number.

faqs.q: Where can I find support and community resources for Robomotion RPA?
faqs.a: Robomotion RPA has a growing Discord community with over 4,900 members. You can join to ask questions, collaborate, enroll in job posts, and socialize. The community and dedicated team are available to provide prompt assistance whenever needed.

reviews_summary: Robomotion RPA has received positive feedback from customers, who appreciate its powerful automation capabilities, responsive support, and active community. While there are minor challenges with the user interface and documentation, the overall rating of 4.7 and a 60-day money-back guarantee make Robomotion RPA a solid choice for those seeking efficient automation solutions.

faqs.q: What is ProxiedMail?
faqs.a: ProxiedMail is a service that allows users to generate unlimited unique email addresses (proxy-emails) that forward incoming messages to their real email inboxes. This enhances privacy and security by separating email addresses from email clients, reducing dependence on providers like Gmail or ProtonMail.

faqs.q: How do I reply to emails received through a proxy-email?
faqs.a: You can reply directly from your email client. When you click 'reply,' the response is routed through ProxiedMail, ensuring the reply appears to come from your proxy-email, keeping your real email address hidden from the original sender.

faqs.q: Can I send new emails from a proxy-email?
faqs.a: Yes, using the 'Contacts' feature, you can initiate new conversations from your proxy-email. This involves selecting the proxy-email, entering the recipient's address, and sending the email through a special alias generated by ProxiedMail.

faqs.q: Is it possible to use ProxiedMail with custom domains?
faqs.a: Yes, you can attach your own domain to ProxiedMail, allowing you to create unlimited proxy-emails with your custom domain. This setup enables you to receive forwarded messages, reply to them, and send new ones, effectively providing hassle-free email hosting on your domain.

faqs.q: How does ProxiedMail differ from temporary email services?
faqs.a: Unlike temporary email services that provide short-lived email addresses, ProxiedMail offers permanent proxy-emails that forward messages to your real inbox. Additionally, ProxiedMail does not store your emails; they are stored in your own mailbox.

faqs.q: Can I use ProxiedMail for important services like banks or government accounts?
faqs.a: Yes, ProxiedMail is designed to be a reliable and trustworthy email service, suitable for use with important services such as banks and government accounts. It provides enhanced security and privacy by separating your email address from the email client.

faqs.q: What features are currently being developed for ProxiedMail?
faqs.a: Upcoming features include creating proxy emails by rules (currently available for custom domains) and a mobile app, both expected by the end of summer. Future developments may include forwarding rules, sharing capabilities, and additional privacy features.

faqs.q: How can I import aliases from another service like SimpleLogin into ProxiedMail?
faqs.a: Currently, you can export your aliases from SimpleLogin and send them to ProxiedMail's support. They will assist in importing them into your ProxiedMail account, typically completing the process within a day.

faqs.q: Where are ProxiedMail's servers located?
faqs.a: ProxiedMail utilizes Digital Ocean servers located in the Netherlands.

faqs.q: Can I restore a deleted proxy-email?
faqs.a: Yes, you can recreate a proxy-email with the same address. Once you create a proxy-email address, it is reserved for you indefinitely.

reviews_summary: Customers appreciate ProxiedMail, praising its ease of use, ability to manage multiple email identities seamlessly, and the added privacy features. The service effectively keeps inboxes clean and enhances email security. There are minor drawbacks, such as the need for users to set up forwarding for custom domains and some users wishing for additional features like a more polished interface. faqs.q: What is Kortex?
faqs.a: Kortex is a browser extension that enhances NotebookLM by adding export functionality, prompt management, and source viewing features. It allows users to export notebook sources in multiple formats, save and organize prompts, and create custom source views.

faqs.q: Do I need to sign in to use Kortex?
faqs.a: Yes, signing in is required to track your usage, sync your subscription status, access premium features, and sync your saved prompts and views across devices.

faqs.q: Which browsers are supported by Kortex?
faqs.a: Kortex currently supports Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge (Chromium-based), Brave Browser, and other Chromium-based browsers. Firefox support is coming soon.

faqs.q: What formats can I export to using Kortex?
faqs.a: You can export to PDF (formatted documents), Markdown (intelligently formatted with hierarchy detection), Text (plain text), and ZIP (compressed archives).

faqs.q: Do failed exports count against my monthly limit?
faqs.a: No, failed exports do not count against your monthly limit. Only successful exports are counted.

faqs.q: What is the Prompt Holder feature in Kortex?
faqs.a: The Prompt Holder lets you save and organize your NotebookLM prompts. You can create folders, add tags, and quickly access saved prompts.

faqs.q: Can I delete sources directly from NotebookLM notebooks using Kortex?
faqs.a: Yes, you can delete sources directly from NotebookLM notebooks using the delete button in the source panel header. This feature is available to Lite and Pro users only.

faqs.q: Is my data secure with Kortex?
faqs.a: Yes, Kortex uses Google OAuth for authentication, Firebase for secure backend services, and Firestore for cloud storage. No sensitive data is stored on our servers except usage statistics. All exports are processed locally in your browser.

reviews_summary: Customers appreciate Kortex for its seamless AI chat capture, efficient source export, and streamlined NotebookLM automation. While some users have reported minor issues like occasional slowdowns and licensing hiccups, the overall sentiment is positive. With a 3.6 rating from 25 reviews, Kortex seems to be hitting the mark. Given its refundable nature and the 60-day money-back guarantee, it's worth giving Kortex a try for those in need of a versatile Chrome extension for AI chat management and NotebookLM workflows.

faqs.q: What is BetterClaw?
faqs.a:
BetterClaw gives you AI agents that work 24/7 on their own private cloud computers, doing jobs like triaging your inbox, sending your morning briefing, chasing failed payments and qualifying leads. Each agent is isolated from the others and never shares logins or data.

Pick a template or describe the job in plain English, and your agent is live in 60 seconds with no code or servers. Connect 1,000+ apps, plus any tool with MCP or an API. Run it on any model you like (API key, ChatGPT or Claude subscription, or a local model) with zero markup, and choose which actions need your approval before they go out.

faqs.q: What are credits, and do I need them if I bring my own key?
faqs.a: Yes. Credits pay for your agent's runtime, not for AI tokens. 1 credit is roughly 1 minute of agent runtime. Some premium features use extra credits: proxies, the X/Twitter connector, and Google or Meta Ads. Most tasks finish in 5 to 10 minutes, so on Tier 3 (12,000 credits) that's around 2,000 task runs a month. Credits reset monthly, and you can top up in the app.

faqs.q: Are there limits on scheduled tasks or workflows?
faqs.a: No. You can create as many as you want. Each run uses credits.

faqs.q: Can I use a local model (Ollama)?
faqs.a: Yes. Download our app from betterclaw.io/downloads and use it to connect your local model to your agents. You don't need to open ports or set up tunnels, and it costs nothing in API fees.t.

faqs.q: Where is data hosted, and is it GDPR-ready?
faqs.a:
The platform is hosted in the US, with EU agent hosting available on request. Every tier gets AES-256 encryption at rest and in transit, a public subprocessor list, 90-day retention for logs and backups, and we never train on your data. We’re ISO 27001 certified.

Our standard DPA at betterclaw.io/legal/dpa covers every tier. A countersigned custom DPA, EU hosting and the ISO 27001 certificate are included on Tier 5. Request them at [email redacted].

faqs.q: Is there an API, MCP or webhooks?
faqs.a: Yes to MCP and the API. Your agents can connect to any MCP server, so any tool that exposes one becomes available to your agent alongside the 500+ built-in connectors. The Agent API (OpenAI-compatible) is also live, so you can trigger agents, pass context and get results back from your own code. Webhooks, BetterClaw running as an MCP server, and multi-agent collaboration are in progress.

faqs.q: Can I use BetterClaw for client work?
faqs.a: Yes. Use one agent per client so each client's data stays isolated, since every agent runs in its own container. You can also build one master agent and clone it in one click. The clone copies settings, skills, workflows and secrets, and you then swap in the client's credentials.

reviews_summary: Customers appreciate BetterClaw, praising its powerful AI agent capabilities, no-code setup, and seamless integration with over 90 one-click connectors. While some users note a learning curve and the need for clearer explanations on certain features, these are minor bumps in an otherwise smooth experience. With a solid rating of 4.4 and a 60-day money-back guarantee, BetterClaw is a fantastic choice for anyone looking to streamline their workflow with AI agents. Give it a try—it's refundable, so there's nothing to lose!

faqs.q: What is AI Toolbox?
faqs.a: AI Toolbox is a Chrome extension that enhances ChatGPT, Gemini, and Claude by adding features like folders, full-text search, bulk export, smart tags, and prompt chaining. It works on all Chromium browsers and has over 20,000 users with a 4.5/5 rating on the Chrome Web Store.

faqs.q: How do I install AI Toolbox?
faqs.a: To install AI Toolbox, visit the Chrome Web Store, search for 'AI Toolbox', and click 'Add to Chrome'. It works on all Chromium-based browsers and starts working immediately on chatgpt.com, gemini.google.com, and claude.ai. No account creation is required for the free plan.

faqs.q: What features does AI Toolbox offer?
faqs.a: AI Toolbox offers features such as folders, subfolders, advanced full-text search, bulk export (TXT/JSON), prompt library, prompt chaining, media gallery, pinning, bulk delete/archive, RTL support for 10 languages, and custom themes.

faqs.q: Which AI platforms does AI Toolbox support?
faqs.a: AI Toolbox currently supports ChatGPT, Google Gemini, and Anthropic Claude. One extension covers all these platforms, and future platforms will join your account automatically when added.

faqs.q: How do I organize my chats into folders?
faqs.a: After installing AI Toolbox, open ChatGPT, Gemini, or Claude. A new sidebar panel with a folder icon will appear. You can create folders and subfolders to organize your conversations. Free users can create up to 2 folders, while Premium users have unlimited folders.

faqs.q: Can I export my AI conversations?
faqs.a: Yes, AI Toolbox allows you to export individual conversations or bulk export multiple chats in TXT, JSON, or PDF formats. You can also export entire folders as ZIP archives or full ChatGPT projects in one click.

faqs.q: Is AI Toolbox safe to use?
faqs.a: Yes, AI Toolbox stores all data locally in your browser. Nothing is sent to external servers. The extension is GDPR compliant, does not collect personal data, and does not read or store your AI conversations on any server. It has passed Chrome Web Store security review.

faqs.q: Does AI Toolbox work with all ChatGPT, Gemini, and Claude models?
faqs.a: Yes, AI Toolbox works with every ChatGPT, Gemini, and Claude model their providers release. The extension enhances the platform interface, not the AI model itself, so it is compatible with all current and future models.

faqs.q: Who is behind AI Toolbox?
faqs.a: AI Toolbox was co-founded by Adi Leviim and Mohammad El-Esawi, two full-stack developers with a combined 12+ years of experience building SaaS products. They lead product development and specialize in backend architecture and AI/LLM systems.

While some users noted minor drawbacks like previous slow performance on larger accounts and indexing issues, recent updates have addressed many of these concerns, resulting in faster search and improved export functionalities. Overall, AI Toolbox is making waves and is a solid buy for anyone looking to enhance their productivity across multiple AI platforms. With a 60-day money-back guarantee, it's worth giving it a try!

faqs.q: What is WorkLLM and who is it for?
faqs.a: WorkLLM is an AI workspace for small and mid-sized teams that want to use AI in daily work without needing technical skills. It is built for businesses that want to grow, but cannot keep adding headcount or buying a new tool for every new task.

faqs.q: How does WorkLLM help my team use AI without special skills?
faqs.a: WorkLLM is designed in such a way that your team does not need AI expertise to get real work done. People can talk to AI in plain language or use ready-made agents, choosing what they want to do and adding a few details to get results.

faqs.q: What is AI Chat and AI Agents in WorkLLM?
faqs.a: AI Chat is where your team talks to AI, works across multiple models, and collaborates in shared threads. AI Agents are prebuilt AI workflows for getting answers from specific knowledge-based or for common tasks so people can get work done without writing prompts.

faqs.q: What is Organization Memory in WorkLLM?
faqs.a: Organization Memory is how WorkLLM remembers your company. It uses your documents, past work, and decisions so the AI already knows your context. You do not need to re-explain your business in every conversation, and good work can be saved so others can build on it.

faqs.q: How is WorkLLM different from just using ChatGPT or another single AI tool?
faqs.a: With WorkLLM, your team gets multi-model AI chat, shared threads, ready-made agents for real workflows, and built-in organization memory in one workspace. Instead of each person using AI alone in a separate tool, your whole team uses AI together with shared context.

faqs.q: Can my whole team collaborate inside WorkLLM?
faqs.a: Yes. Threads can be shared, commented on, and continued by multiple people. Teammates can tag each other, review AI output together, and fork conversations to explore different options without losing the original work.

faqs.q: How does WorkLLM use my company’s data safely?
faqs.a: Your data is used to improve answers for your workspace only. Models do not retain your data for training, and access is controlled by roles and permissions. You stay in control of what is connected and who can see what.

faqs.q: What kinds of day-to-day tasks can WorkLLM help with?
faqs.a: Teams use WorkLLM for things like writing emails and proposals, creating content, summarizing calls or documents, drafting SOPs, doing research, qualifying leads, preparing reports, and answering internal questions about policies, products, and past work.

faqs.q: Do I need to set up complex workflows before my team can use WorkLLM?
faqs.a: No. You can start with AI Chat and the library of ready-made agents on day one. As your team gets comfortable, you can customize existing agents or create your own for your specific workflows.

faqs.q: Is WorkLLM suitable if I already use other AI tools?
faqs.a: Yes. Many teams come in already using ChatGPT or other tools. WorkLLM gives them a shared place to use AI together, compare models, and keep work organized with memory, agents, and collaboration features.

faqs.q: What kind of support can I expect as an AppSumo buyer?
faqs.a: AppSumo buyers get product updates, access to new agents and improvements, and direct channels to share feedback. We actively use this feedback to decide which agents, workflows, and memory features to build next.

faqs.q: What is an AI credit?
faqs.a: A credit is our internal unit representing actual model usage, it's not a flat one credit equals one token or one question system. We convert the model provider's token cost into credits based on that model's pricing along with a few other factors on our end, like infrastructure, storage, and overall platform costs, so credit cost reflects the real cost of running that model through WorkLLM, not just a simple pass-through number. For example, a roughly 500 word answer might cost around 2 credits on a lighter model, and around 3 credits on a higher end model like Claude Opus or OpenAI 5.6 Sol, since those cost more to run.

faqs.q: Do I always need to pick a model myself?
faqs.a: No. Model selection is optional. If you don't choose one, we automatically pick the best recommended model for your question, balancing quality and cost, so you're not spending more credits than a task actually needs.

faqs.q: How far will my monthly credits go?
faqs.a: For everyday mixed use, normal questions, some research, occasional longer tasks, and basic AI agent usage, credits typically cover somewhere around 200 to 300 total interactions per 800 credits, though this shifts depending on which models you use. Heavier models consume more credits per response, so you'll get fewer total interactions, while lighter models stretch further.

faqs.q: Does uploading documents to memory use credits?
faqs.a: Yes, adding files to memory consumes credits once, since indexing goes through an embedding model. After that, retrieving and using that stored knowledge in future queries doesn't consume additional credits, credits are only used when a model is actively generating a response, not for retrieval.

reviews_summary: Customers appreciate WorkLLM, praising its extensive model selection with over 200 options, the robust organization memory that enhances collaboration, and the seamless team functionality that boosts productivity. Users have noted improvements in credit efficiency and transparency, addressing previous concerns about credit consumption. Additionally, the platform now supports over 100 native app integrations, enhancing its versatility. With a solid rating of 4.6 and a 60-day money-back guarantee, WorkLLM is a fantastic choice for anyone looking to streamline their daily work with AI. Give it a try!

faqs.q: What is Acti, and why did we build it?
faqs.a:
Acti is an agentic keyboard and desktop assistant designed to turn your intent into action, wherever you type.
We built Acti to remove the friction between thinking of something and getting it done. Traditional AI tools often require switching apps, copying information, and interrupting your workflow.
Acti brings intelligent assistance and reusable actions directly into your everyday experience.
Our vision is to make agentic technology accessible wherever you work and communicate, transforming the keyboard from a simple input tool into a gateway for getting things done.

faqs.q: What has Acti achieved so far?
faqs.a:
Acti is backed by institutional investors and has received international recognition since launch.
Raised $5.3 million in seed funding, led by BITKRAFT Ventures.
Featured in TechCrunch for our approach to agentic computing.
Ranked #1 Product of the Day, Week, and Month on Product Hunt in July 2026.
Expanded from our original mobile keyboard to Acti Desktop.
These milestones reflect our progress and commitment to building the next generation of agentic experiences.

faqs.q: Which platforms does Acti support?
faqs.a:
Acti is available on Mobile and Desktop.

Mobile (iOS & Android): An agentic keyboard combining everyday typing, voice input, context-aware Acti AI, and reusable Acts.

Desktop (currently macOS): An AI assistant experience that lets you work with selected text, translate, rewrite, retrieve information, and perform supported actions without constantly switching applications.

Windows support is planned for the future. Features may differ across platforms due to operating-system capabilities.

faqs.q: What makes Acti different from traditional keyboards and AI assistants?
faqs.a:
Traditional keyboards help you type. Standalone AI assistants often require you to leave your current application.

Acti bridges the gap between intent and execution.

With context-aware Acti AI and customizable Acts, you can access relevant information, perform supported actions, and automate repeated tasks closer to where you’re already working.

Acti is designed to reduce the steps between what you want to do and getting it done.

faqs.q: What can I do with Acti AI?
faqs.a:
Acti AI provides context-aware assistance directly within your workflow.

On Mobile, Acti AI understands the context of what you’re typing and helps surface relevant information, recommendations, links, and supported actions. Whether you’re looking for a restaurant, a song, or information about the weather, Acti AI helps you find what you need without constantly switching apps.

On Desktop, Acti AI offers a broader assistant experience. Highlight text to translate, rewrite, improve, or explain it, or use Acti AI for general questions and information requests.

The goal is to make intelligent assistance available naturally, wherever you’re working.

faqs.q: What is Act Builder Agent, and how does it work?
faqs.a:
Act Builder Agent is your personal agent for creating custom AI-powered workflows without writing code.

Simply describe what you want to accomplish in natural language, and Act Builder Agent helps turn your idea into a reusable Act.

Whether it’s a simple translation, a personalized grammar checker, or a more complex multi-step workflow, the agent helps handle the creation process.

You can refine your Act through conversation and customize it to suit your needs.

You describe the task. Act Builder Agent builds the workflow.

faqs.q: What are Acts, and do I need to create my own?
faqs.a:
Acts are reusable, agentic workflows designed to help you complete specific tasks more efficiently.

Instead of repeatedly giving the same instructions, you can use an existing Act or create one tailored to your needs.

Acts can range from simple text transformations to more sophisticated workflows using supported tools and APIs.

Creating your own Acts is entirely optional. You can explore existing Acts or use Acti AI directly for everyday requests.

faqs.q: Does Acti support multiple languages and voice input?
faqs.a:
Yes. Acti supports multilingual typing and AI-powered language capabilities, including translation and voice functionality.

Voice Dictation helps turn speech into text, while Voice Translate provides a separate voice-based translation experience.

Language availability and specific functionality may vary by feature and platform.

faqs.q: What apps, services, and APIs can Acti connect to?
faqs.a:
Acti supports connections with external apps, services, and APIs, allowing Acts to go beyond basic text-based tasks.

Through Act Builder Agent, you can describe what you want to accomplish, and the agent can use available tools and supported integrations to help create the workflow.

Supported capabilities depend on the integrations, APIs, and permissions involved.

We’re continuing to expand what Acti can connect to and accomplish.

faqs.q: How does Acti protect my privacy?
faqs.a:
Privacy is fundamental to Acti, especially as a keyboard that handles everyday communication.

Everyday typing: Acti does not record or transmit your ordinary keystrokes to its servers. Standard typing features process surrounding text on your device.

AI features: When you use Acti AI or run an Act, the information needed to fulfill your request may be processed by Acti’s services and relevant AI providers.

Voice & dictation: Voice input is processed to deliver the requested transcription, translation, or AI assistance, subject to Acti’s privacy practices.

Connected services: External accounts require authorization, and access is limited to the permissions and functionality involved.

We do not sell your personal information. For full details, please review our Privacy Policy

faqs.q: How do AI credits work?
faqs.a:
Each AppSumo tier includes a monthly AI credit allowance for supported AI features, including Acts and agentic interactions.

Credit consumption varies depending on the action and processing required.

Your credits reset monthly. Unused credits do not roll over.

faqs.q: What’s next for Acti?
faqs.a:
We’re continuing to evolve Acti beyond its origins as a mobile keyboard, with a focus on making agentic experiences more powerful, intuitive, and accessible.

Our development priorities include:

Improving everyday typing, voice, and overall reliability.

Making Acts easier to discover, create, and execute.

Expanding and refining Acti Desktop.

Building more powerful and personalized agentic workflows.

Developing and prototyping Personal Agents and context-aware, proactive assistance.

Expanding connections with external tools, services, and AI agents.

Our long-term vision is to make Acti a gateway to your personal agentic ecosystem, allowing you to get things done wherever you work or communicate.

Features in development or prototyping are not guaranteed for release or inclusion in every plan.

faqs.q: Does Acti support Bring Your Own Key (BYOK)?
faqs.a:
Acti doesn't currently support BYOK. We're model-agnostic and manage the underlying AI models and providers for you, so there's no need to configure API keys or manage multiple AI services.
We understand that BYOK can be valuable for power users who already have their own AI infrastructure or prefer greater control over usage costs. It's something we're open to exploring based on user feedback.
In the meantime, we'd encourage you to give Acti a try! You can experience how Acti brings AI directly into your everyday typing and workflows without the hassle of setting up or managing API keys.
We'd also love to hear how you'd use BYOK and what you'd like to see from it. Your feedback will help us evaluate future support.

faqs.q: When will Acti be available on Windows?
faqs.a:
We're actively developing Acti for Windows, and development is progressing well!
While we don't have a confirmed release date yet, we're tentatively targeting a launch within the next two months, potentially sooner.
We're excited to bring Acti to Windows and appreciate your patience. Stay tuned for updates!

reviews_summary: Customers appreciate Acti, praising its intelligent assistance and agentic capabilities that enhance their workflow without the need to switch between apps. They love the convenience of having context-aware assistance directly from their keyboard, the ability to create and run reusable Acts for recurring tasks, and the responsive support from the team. There are a couple of minor drawbacks, such as the need for further development in the early beta phase and potential feature inconsistencies. Overall, Acti is a standout tool that’s worth exploring, especially with a 60-day money-back guarantee. Don’t miss out on this innovative desktop experience for Windows!

faqs.q: What is FormWise and what can I build with it?
faqs.a: FormWise is a no-code platform for turning what your business knows into AI products you own. You build Agents that answer and act from your own knowledge, Flows that follow your steps to produce a finished result, and Teams where several Agents work together under a supervisor. Group them into Suites, then share them by link, embed them on your site, or publish them in a branded Portal with customer login and built-in checkout.

faqs.q: What is the difference between a Flow and an Agent?
faqs.a: A Flow follows the steps you design and produces a consistent deliverable every time, such as an email sequence, a checklist, or a content calendar. An Agent handles open-ended conversations and works from your Knowledgebases, instructions, and connected apps. Use a Flow when the process is fixed, and an Agent when the questions vary.

faqs.q: What are SmartForms and CoPilots?
faqs.a: They are the two ways a Flow can run. A SmartForm asks its questions as a guided form. A CoPilot asks them as a guided chat. Both end in the same kind of finished result, so you pick whichever suits your audience.

faqs.q: How do credits work on the lifetime deal?
faqs.a: Each tier includes a one-time pool of credits: 1,000 on Tier 1, 3,500 on Tier 2, 8,500 on Tier 3, and 15,000 on Tier 4. The pool does not refill each month. Credits are used when your Agents and Flows run, based on the model you choose and how much it reads and writes. Building, editing, and publishing do not use credits.

faqs.q: What happens when my credits run out?
faqs.a: You have two options. On Tier 2 and above you can add your own OpenAI, Anthropic, or Gemini API key, and model usage then bills to your provider instead of your credits. On any tier you can turn on on-demand usage with a monthly spending limit you set.

faqs.q: Do I need my own OpenAI or Claude API key?
faqs.a: No. Every tier runs on models from Claude, OpenAI, and Gemini using your included credits, with no key required. Bringing your own key is optional and available on Tier 2 and above, under Settings > Integrations.

faqs.q: Can FormWise tools send data to my CRM or trigger downstream automations?
faqs.a: Yes. FormWise tools (for example, CoPilots) can extract structured data during a session and fire webhooks when objectives are met so the extracted data can be pushed to CRMs, email systems, GoHighLevel workflows, Zapier, or other downstream systems.

faqs.q: Can I sell access to what I build?
faqs.a: Yes, on every tier. Put your Agents and Flows in a branded Portal with customer login, set your own plans and per-user credit allowances, and take payment through built-in checkout powered by Stripe. A revenue dashboard tracks what you earn.

faqs.q: Can I remove FormWise branding?
faqs.a: Whitelabeling is included on Tier 3 and Tier 4. On Tier 1 and Tier 2 it is available as an in-app add-on. It removes the "Powered by FormWise" badge from everything you publish.

faqs.q: Does FormWise have an MCP?
faqs.a: Yes! FormWise has a platform MCP where you can have your Claude or ChatGPT create and manage your Flows, Agents, and Agent Teams directly from where you already work. It can also create and manage your Knowledgebases and even help mange your Portals and Users.

faqs.q: How do I put an Agent or Flow on my website?
faqs.a: When you publish, FormWise gives you a share link and an embed code. Paste the embed code into any page builder that accepts custom HTML, such as WordPress, Webflow, HighLevel, or Kajabi. You can also limit which domains are allowed to embed it.

faqs.q: What integrations does FormWise support?
faqs.a: Agents can connect to more than 1,500 apps using your own accounts with tens of thousands of available actions, so they can read and update the tools you already use. Flows can send their results to any webhook, which covers CRMs, email platforms, Zapier, and thousands of overs. The HighLevel integration is included on Tier 3 and Tier 4.

faqs.q: Can people upload files?
faqs.a: Yes. Users can attach PDFs, CSV, text, and Markdown files, plus images, and the AI reads them during the session. You can also upload documents, add website pages, and paste text into a Knowledgebase so your Agents always work from your material.

faqs.q: How do I start using Hello Aria?
faqs.a: Get started by opening Hello Aria via WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack, the web dashboard (app.helloaria.in) or the iOS/Android app—use the site’s Get Started links to connect.

faqs.q: Is there a Hello Aria mobile app?
faqs.a: Yes. Hello Aria is available on both Android and iOS; the site and FAQ state you can download the mobile apps from Google Play and the Apple App Store.

faqs.q: What's the difference between using the mobile app and using Hello Aria on WhatsApp?
faqs.a: The mobile app offers all WhatsApp features plus a unified dashboard, improved file management, and offline access to your data.

faqs.q: Does my data sync across WhatsApp, web, and the mobile app?
faqs.a: Yes. The FAQ states reminders, todos, notes and Circles sync seamlessly in real time across WhatsApp, web, and the mobile app.

faqs.q: What integrations does Hello Aria support?
faqs.a: Hello Aria supports Google Calendar, Google Drive, Google Meet, Gmail, Microsoft OneDrive, Outlook Calendar and Outlook Mail, per the FAQ and product pages.

faqs.q: Can Hello Aria understand voice notes and images?
faqs.a: Yes. According to the FAQ, voice notes are transcribed into tasks or reminders and images are processed to extract text, dates and action items automatically.

faqs.q: How do Meeting Minutes (MOM) work in Hello Aria?
faqs.a: Record meetings and Aria automatically transcribes, summarizes, and extracts action items with speaker identification (MOM mode described on the FAQ and product pages).

faqs.q: Is my data shared with or sold to third parties?
faqs.a: No. Hello Aria’s privacy policy states they do not sell personal data and describe limited data sharing only as needed to operate the service (service providers, legal requirements, or business transfers).

faqs.q: Can I export or delete my data?
faqs.a: Yes. The FAQ and privacy policy state you can export all your data from the dashboard or request complete data deletion by contacting [email redacted].

faqs.q: How do I connect Hello Aria to Claude (MCP) or other integrations?
faqs.a: Hello Aria’s integration guide shows a short setup: create or sign in to your Hello Aria account (app.helloaria.in or via WhatsApp/Telegram/iOS), then add HelloAria in Claude’s Integrations or use the MCP URL (mcp.helloaria.in/mcp) to authenticate.

faqs.q: Is there an Android app?
faqs.a: Not yet — the Android app is currently in beta testing, not officially launched. If you'd like to try it early, reach out and we'll share the beta APK for direct install. In the meantime you're fully covered on Android: HelloAria works right now through WhatsApp, Telegram, and the web dashboard (app.helloaria.in — opens in any Android browser, no install needed). So nothing's blocking you on Android today; the native app is added convenience that's on the way.

faqs.q: Do I need WhatsApp to use HelloAria? / How do I sign up?
faqs.a: No — WhatsApp is just one of several ways in. You can sign in with "Continue with Apple" or "Continue with Google" and use the iOS app, web dashboard, Telegram, Slack, or email without WhatsApp at all. If you do use WhatsApp: message Aria first, then type "dashboard" in the chat to get your personal login link — that keeps everything on one account. (Signing up fresh on the website while already chatting on WhatsApp creates a second, separate account — so always use the "dashboard" link to reach your dashboard.)

faqs.q: What does "advanced security" include? / Is my data secure?
faqs.a: Your data is protected today by the fundamentals: encryption in transit and at rest, secure sign-in (WhatsApp code, Apple, or Google), and all credentials/API keys held in a dedicated secrets vault — never in plain code. If you use BYOK, your LLM calls run on your own provider key, so that traffic isn't logged on our side. The "advanced security" item on Tier 3 refers to a set of enterprise governance features that are coming soon (think org-level controls and compliance tooling) — it's on the roadmap, not live yet, and your lifetime license locks it in at no extra cost once it ships. We'd rather be upfront about that than imply it's available today.

faqs.q: How does BYOK work, and why Gemini?
faqs.a: https://BYOK (Bring Your Own Key) lets you connect your own AI provider key so Aria's AI usage runs on your account — keeping your ongoing costs low and in your control. For chat, BYOK works with multiple providers: Google Gemini, OpenAI, OpenRouter, Groq, and Anthropic. One important detail: voice transcription and image analysis are powered by Google Gemini only. So: - A Gemini key covers everything — chat, voice notes, and image analysis — and it lifts the monthly voice-note and image-analysis limits on AppSumo Tier 1. - Keys from other providers cover chat only (voice/image stay on your plan's normal limits). Recommendation: connect a Gemini key for the full experience. It's free to create at aistudio.google.com (the free tier has lower rate limits — heavy users can enable billing for higher throughput).

faqs.q: How does ApproveThis handle external approvals?

faqs.q: Does ApproveThis offer a REST API for custom integrations?

faqs.q: How does ApproveThis ensure data security and compliance?
