faqs.q: What features does WP Email Log offer?
faqs.a: WP Email Log provides detailed email logging, 24/7 monitoring of outgoing emails, auto-forwarding of emails, and the ability to resend emails. It also supports viewing email content in both HTML and plain text formats.

faqs.q: How do I install the WP Email Log plugin?
faqs.a: To install WP Email Log, log in to your WordPress Admin dashboard, navigate to the Plugins page, click 'Add New', search for 'Email Log', click 'Install Now' on the 'Email Log' plugin, and then activate it.

faqs.q: How can I view logged emails in WP Email Log?
faqs.a: To view logged emails, go to the 'Email Log' menu in the WordPress dashboard and click on 'View Logs'. This page lists all logged emails, where you can view basic information such as 'Sent at', 'To', and 'Subject'.

faqs.q: Is WP Email Log compatible with WordPress Multisite?
faqs.a: Yes, WP Email Log supports WordPress Multisite. It automatically creates an 'email_log' table for each blog in the network and deletes it when a blog is removed.

faqs.q: How can I search for specific emails in WP Email Log?
faqs.a: WP Email Log allows you to search logged emails using 'Search by Date' and 'Search by Term' filters. You can use these filters individually or together to find specific emails.

faqs.q: How do I delete email logs in WP Email Log?
faqs.a: To delete logged emails, go to the 'View Logs' page, hover over the email you want to delete, and click 'Delete'. For bulk deletion, select multiple emails and use the 'Delete' bulk action.

faqs.q: Does WP Email Log support additional fields in email logs?
faqs.a: Yes, with the 'More Fields' add-on, WP Email Log can log additional email information such as 'From', 'Cc', 'Bcc', 'Reply To', and 'Attachment'.

faqs.q: How does WP Email Log monitor outgoing emails?
faqs.a: WP Email Log's SaaS automatically tests your outgoing emails daily to ensure they are working and being delivered. If any issues are detected, you will be notified immediately.

faqs.q: Can I automatically delete old email logs in WP Email Log?
faqs.a: Yes, with the 'Auto Delete Logs' add-on, WP Email Log can automatically delete email logs after a defined interval.

faqs.q: How does WP Email Log log emails sent from my WordPress site?
faqs.a: WP Email Log uses the 'wp_mail' hook to filter the 'wp_mail' arguments and stores them in a separate database table called 'email_log'.

faqs.q: What is Garmingo Voice?
faqs.a: Garmingo Voice is a private desktop application that provides real-time microphone enhancement, system-wide dictation, and meeting recording with searchable transcripts — described on the product page as "three flows, one app" for voice enhancement, dictation, and meeting transcripts.

faqs.q: Which platforms can I run Garmingo Voice on?
faqs.a: Garmingo Voice is available for macOS and Windows; the product page states macOS & Windows are fully available and refers users to the system requirements table for supported versions.

faqs.q: What are the system requirements for Garmingo Voice?
faqs.a: The product page lists supported OS versions as Windows 10/11 or macOS 11 (Big Sur) and later. It shows minimum vs recommended resources (example values on the page): RAM minimum 500 MB / recommended 8 GB; disk minimum 500 MB / recommended 10 GB; VRAM none / recommended 10 GB.

faqs.q: Does Garmingo Voice work offline or run on-device?
faqs.a: Garmingo Voice is on-device by default and is described as able to run locally so features can work without a network connection. The product page states on-device dictation and transcription continue to work offline for several days before a quick recheck, and there is an optional cloud mode you can opt into for additional speed.

faqs.q: How many languages does Garmingo Voice support?
faqs.a: The product page states Garmingo Voice supports 99+ languages for both dictation and meeting transcripts, with automatic detection of language and accent.

faqs.q: How does Garmingo handle my audio and is my speech used to train models?
faqs.a: According to Garmingo's privacy policy, local processing uses models on your device so audio and transcription data are processed exclusively on your machine and not transmitted. If you use cloud-based AI features, audio is transmitted to the cloud AI provider (identified in the privacy policy as Mistral AI) under GDPR-compliant terms. Garmingo also describes model-training participation as an explicit opt-in program; training on user data is not performed by default and any contributions for training are voluntary and require express consent.

faqs.q: What core features does Garmingo Voice provide?
faqs.a: The product page lists real-time microphone enhancement (noise/echo removal), system-wide push-to-talk dictation with custom vocabulary and formatting, and meeting recordings with speaker labels, timestamps, exportable transcripts and an AI-powered chat/query capability on recordings.

faqs.q: Which apps and workflows does Garmingo Voice work with?
faqs.a: The product page shows Garmingo Voice works across many apps and workflows, listing examples such as Apple Mail, Gmail, Outlook, Slack, Microsoft Teams, Zoom, Discord, VS Code, Notion, Google Docs, Microsoft Word, Figma, Safari, Google Chrome, Telegram, Obsidian, Trello, Linear and others.

faqs.q: Do I need an account or constant internet connection to use Garmingo Voice?
faqs.a: Garmingo's product page explains you sign in once to activate your license; after activation, on-device dictation and transcription keep working offline for several days before a quick recheck. The AI is described as not requiring a constant connection for on-device features.

faqs.q: Where can I get help or check service status and incidents for Garmingo?
faqs.a: Garmingo's documentation hub provides links for help (including contacting support and community channels such as Discord) and points users to the public status page for operational status; the documentation page lists support contact options and links to community resources.

faqs.q: What are the key features of Stackby?
faqs.a: Stackby combines the simplicity of spreadsheets with the power of relational databases, offering features such as 30+ unique column types, multiple data views (Grid, Kanban, Calendar, Gallery, List, Timeline, Forms), API connectors for real-time data integration, workflow automation, and a marketplace of power-ups to enhance functionality.

faqs.q: How can I integrate third-party applications with Stackby?
faqs.a: Stackby provides native integrations with numerous popular business apps. Users can link columns to APIs to pull information, use services, or push information without any coding. Integrations include Slack, YouTube, GitHub, MailChimp, and many more.

faqs.q: What should I do if I encounter issues while using Stackby?
faqs.a: If you face issues such as 'Something went wrong' or 'The page you were looking for was not found,' try clearing your browser or desktop app cache. If the problem persists, use an incognito window, test in another browser, and collect details like browser and OS versions. Contact Stackby support with this information for further assistance.

faqs.q: Can I automate workflows in Stackby?

faqs.q: Is Stackby suitable for small teams managing operations?

It offers solutions such as order management, product catalog & inquiry, inventory management, asset tracker, and vendor management, making it suitable for businesses of all kinds and sizes.

subheader: Find the best productivity strategy for you with a side-by-side comparison of top frameworks

body:
Productivity, Boosted
 is an ebook that compares ten popular productivity frameworks and teaches you how to implement them into your work life with actionable steps.


 
 
 
 
 


When it comes to improving our focus and organization, we don’t have to reinvent the wheel. All we need is to find the right productivity system for our specific job or goals.


In 
Productivity, Boosted
, we 
explore ten tried-and-true productivity frameworks and how to use them
.


Some of these tactics have been around for decades, helping executives and busy entrepreneurs keep focused.
 

Other systems are new, but have quickly risen to fame because of their clear results.


 
 
 
 
 


This guide
 features foundational frameworks—like Getting Things Done by David Allen—as well as frameworks that build upon other strategies
 described through the book.


We’ve also
 included more than twenty power quotes from the experts
 who invented these methodologies.
 

They’ll inspire you, clarify a certain strategy, or simply give you better context for how to implement productivity into your life.


 
 
 
 
 


It’s easy to find productivity methods through a Google search—it’s also easy to get overwhelmed.
 

That’s why this guide 
places the most popular methods side-by-side for easy comparison
.


We’ve 
organized the ebook with simple overviews, step-by-step instructions on each method
, and descriptions that thread common themes we see between certain ideas.


You’ll
 learn methods like Pomodoro, time blocking, The Seinfeld Strategy, Eat That Frog, and more
! 


 
 
 
 
 


What does it take to level up your productivity? For most of us, not as much as we might think.
 

Productivity, Boosted
 is just what the doctor prescribed for mastering the art of doing more in less time.


Side effects include getting a week’s work done in a day, finishing a project early and having nothing to do, and that inevitable facepalm for not implementing your new system sooner.


Download
 Productivity, Boosted
 for free today!

subheader: Manage tasks, chat, and GPS attendance in one gamified project management app with WhatsApp alerts
value_prop: Gamify project management for your team
tldr: Most teams juggle a project tool, a chat app, and an attendance sheet, then still chase people for updates. Syncupp puts all three in one app and rewards your team with points for finishing on time.
highlights: Manage projects, assign tasks, and send reminders straight to WhatsApp and Slack with integrations that fit your workflow
Track GPS attendance, time per task, and team output on one live XP leaderboard

feature_blocks.title: Make finishing on time fun
bullets: **Give coins and XP for logins, completed tasks, and on-time delivery** to build streaks and rankings
**Set custom rewards** your team can redeem for the work they put in
**Filter the live leaderboard by department or time period** to see who’s leading

feature_blocks.title: Plan work your way
bullets: **Switch between kanban, list, and calendar views** whenever a different layout reads faster
**Break down tasks with subtasks, dependencies, priorities, and custom fields** so nothing stays vague
**Chat in channels and DMs**, comment on tasks, and start Google Meet calls synced with Google Calendar

feature_blocks.title: Keep every task moving in your flow
bullets: **See every task across every board in one list**, with attachments, comments, and activity in one place
**Set recurring tasks that auto-assign** on daily, weekly, or monthly schedules
**Send task alerts, daily digests, and leave approvals to WhatsApp** and act on them by replying, or get reminders in Slack
**Connect Zapier, Make, and Pabbly**, or use the Claude MCP integration to pull Syncupp data into your AI workflow

feature_blocks.title: Track attendance on autopilot
bullets: **Check in with one-tap GPS** so field teams stop posting in a WhatsApp group or Slack channel
**Track daily attendance, late marks, half-days, and leave balances** in one view
**Export attendance for payroll** at the end of the month
**Generate client-ready billing reports from auto timesheets** and completed work

faqs.q: Is this really lifetime access?
faqs.a: Yes. You pay once for your tier and keep every feature in it, including future updates to those features.

faqs.q: How does the WhatsApp integration work?
faqs.a:
Verify your WhatsApp number once in Settings → Notification Preferences. Your personal number works; you don’t need a WhatsApp Business account. Syncupp then sends task alerts, deadline reminders, daily summaries and approval requests straight to your WhatsApp.

You can also reply to get work done without opening the app: create or update tasks, approve leave requests and review task approvals, all by chatting with the Syncupp AI assistant.

faqs.q: Can I import from ClickUp, Asana, or Trello?
faqs.a: Yes. Export your tasks from ClickUp, Asana or Trello as a CSV or Excel file and upload it to Syncupp. Titles, descriptions, due dates, priorities, statuses, tags and assignees are mapped automatically. You can bring in teammates the same way with a member sheet, so you don’t have to rebuild everything by hand.

faqs.q: What counts as a seat?
faqs.a: Each team member with a login uses one seat, and that includes you as the owner. Seats are shared across all your workspaces, so someone in two workspaces still counts as one seat. Clients you invite as Viewers don’t use a seat. Pending invites do count until they’re accepted or cancelled. When someone leaves, remove them and their seat is free for a new teammate straight away.

faqs.q: Does the entry tier include WhatsApp and gamification?
faqs.a: Yes. Every tier includes the full WhatsApp integration, the XP and coins engine, GPS attendance, and time tracking. Tiers differ only in users, workspaces, and monthly AI credits.

faqs.q: Does Syncupp work for teams outside India?
faqs.a: Yes. Syncupp works for any team that uses WhatsApp, including remote, hybrid, and field teams, and teams across Europe and Asia use it today.

faqs.q: What is the refund policy?
faqs.a: AppSumo's 60-day refund window applies. Try Syncupp with your team and get a full refund inside 60 days if it is not a fit.

faqs.q: How do AI credits work?
faqs.a: Credits reset every month: 300, 1,000, 2,500 or 5,000 depending on your tier. A normal chat reply uses 1 credit, an info lookup uses 2, and a completed action, like creating or updating a task, uses 3. This works the same on the dashboard, WhatsApp and Slack. If you connect your own API key (BYOK), your Syncupp credits aren’t used at all.

faqs.q: Is it only a Kanban board?
faqs.a: No. Every board has both a board view and a list view. “All Tasks” brings work from every board into one place, so you can filter by board, status, assignee or due date and quickly see what’s overdue.

faqs.q: Can tasks repeat automatically?
faqs.a: Yes. Set any task to repeat daily, weekly or monthly. It’s great for standups, weekly reports, invoices and other routine work, and you don’t need Zapier or any other tool for it.

faqs.q: What happens when a task is overdue?
faqs.a: If the due date passes and the task isn’t done, Syncupp moves it to the Overdue column automatically so nothing slips through. Set a new future due date and it moves back to the column it came from.

faqs.q: Can assignees get reminders before a deadline?
faqs.a: Yes. Choose a reminder from 10 minutes up to 2 weeks before the due date, or pick a custom time. Reminders arrive by email, in the app and on WhatsApp, so people see them even when they’re away from their desk.

faqs.q: How does attendance work?
faqs.a: Teammates punch in and out from the top bar in one click. Syncupp logs their time, location and breaks, so you always know who’s working. Export the attendance sheet anytime for payroll or HR.

faqs.q: Do working days and holidays count?
faqs.a: Yes. Set your workdays, working hours and holiday calendar for each workspace. Leave requests and approvals are built in, and managers can approve leave straight from WhatsApp.

faqs.q: How do coins, streaks and the leaderboard work?
faqs.a: People earn coins for finishing tasks on time and build streaks by staying active every working day. The leaderboard ranks your team by on-time work, and the Hall of Fame keeps all-time records like the longest streak, so good work always gets noticed.

faqs.q: Does it connect to Google Calendar?
faqs.a: Yes. Create meetings with a Google Meet link and they sync to Google Calendar automatically. The Syncupp calendar shows meetings, task deadlines, leaves and holidays in one view, and meeting reminders go out by email, in the app and on WhatsApp.

value_prop: Collect documents from clients easily
tldr: Incorrect documents stall projects, while hunting down files takes time away from work that actually matters. OkaySend helps you collect the right files faster with automated document collection.
highlights: Onboard clients and collect documents with structured intakes without endless email back-and-forth
Collect the information you need faster with secure, no-login client portals

faqs.q: What is a client portal in OkaySend?
faqs.a: A client portal is a secure, branded space where your clients can view requests, upload documents, and submit responses. Each portal is private and unique to a specific client.

faqs.q: How can I add a team member in OkaySend?
faqs.a: To add a new team member, go to Settings > Team, enter the team member's email address, and click 'Send invite' to send the invitation email.

faqs.q: Can I customize the appearance of my client portals?
faqs.a: Yes, you can customize your portal appearance, send white-labeled emails, and host portals on your own business domain for a professional, consistent experience.

faqs.q: How does OkaySend ensure the security of my data and my clients’ documents?
faqs.a: OkaySend encrypts all data in transit and at rest, does not access customer data without explicit approval, and tracks every action in an audit log. Only you and your authorized team members can access submitted documents unless you intentionally share them.

faqs.q: What is a 'Point of Contact' in OkaySend?
faqs.a: In OkaySend, a Point of Contact is the user representing your business to your clients and customers. Their name and title may be included in the emails sent to your clients.

faqs.q: What is a 'Request' in OkaySend?
faqs.a: In OkaySend, a request is like a checklist or a form used to collect documents and other information from your client. You can create a new request to gather the necessary information efficiently.

faqs.q: How do I set permissions and roles for a team member in OkaySend?
faqs.a: Currently, all added members get full editing and viewing access. Specific permissions and roles cannot be set for a team member at this time. However, only the admin/owner of an account can take critical actions like billing settings, adding members, or deleting the account.

faqs.q: What is a success message in OkaySend?
faqs.a: A success message is shown after the client has completed and successfully submitted the request. You may preview and edit this message on the Branding page.

The platform's ability to automate client follow-ups is a standout, making onboarding a breeze. While some users have expressed interest in additional features like conditional logic and a client portal, these are not major concerns. Overall, with a stellar rating of 4.9 and a 60-day money-back guarantee, OkaySend is a fantastic choice for anyone looking to streamline their document collection. Don't hesitate to give it a try!

faqs.q: How do I set up Sheetify CRM in my Google Drive?
faqs.a: Setup is a three-step process described on the product page: copy the Google Sheets template to your Google Drive (File > Create a copy), then run the Sheetify setup from the sheet’s menu and follow the authorization steps (click ‘Sheetify’ > ‘Set Up Sheetify’ and grant the requested authorizations).

faqs.q: Can I customize Sheetify CRM, and which parts are editable?
faqs.a: Yes. The vendor documents explain you can customize date formats, move or add sheets, insert columns, and edit many dropdowns and labels via the Settings sheet (e.g., Source, Type, Sales Status, Inventory Types). Some fields and areas that power automations are locked, and advanced edits (renaming core sheets or changing automation logic) require Google Apps Script knowledge or developer services. (See the customization guide for details.)

faqs.q: Does Sheetify CRM support sending email campaigns from Gmail and are there sending limits?
faqs.a: Sheetify CRM includes built-in email marketing that connects to your Gmail account so you can send personalized bulk campaigns from the spreadsheet. The product notes Google Workspace accounts may send up to 500 emails per day and recommends staying within ~100–250 emails per sender for optimal deliverability (and scaling with multiple accounts as needed), linking to Google’s sending-limit documentation.

faqs.q: Can I connect other Sheetify templates (Bookkeeping, Projects) to the CRM and automate data between them?
faqs.a: Yes. Sheetify provides an add-on called Sheetify Flow that lets you connect multiple Sheetify Google Sheets templates (including CRM, Bookkeeping, Projects). You add a URL to link templates and enable or disable pre-made automations to sync data and reduce double entry between sheets.

faqs.q: Does Sheetify CRM provide phone and messaging integrations (WhatsApp, Google Voice, iMessage)?
faqs.a: Sheetify documents a built-in Apps Script feature that makes phone numbers clickable from the Contacts & Leads sheet and can open WhatsApp, Google Voice or iMessage interfaces. The workflow is: select a contact’s phone cell, choose Sheetify > Call & Message, and pick the channel (e.g., WhatsApp, Call via Google Voice, Send SMS or iMessage); you must be logged into the chosen communications account. The page also documents a ‘Record Interactions’ tool to log calls/messages to the Interactions sheet.

faqs.q: What permissions or authorizations does Sheetify (and the Sheetify Flow add-on) require?
faqs.a: The product requires you to authorize the Sheetify script from your Google account during setup. The Sheetify Flow add-on (Google Workspace Marketplace listing) declares it needs permission to see, edit, create, and delete your Google Sheets files, to display and run third-party web content in sidebars, and to run when you’re not present; the marketplace listing shows the app permissions and links to its privacy policy and support pages.

faqs.q: What is the Template and Dynamic Content feature in Selldone?
faqs.a: The Template and Dynamic Content feature in Selldone allows sellers to create customized pages with dynamic text and image content, which can be assigned to specific products, categories, or 'Included Items' like common accessories. This enables a personalized and interactive shopping experience for customers.

faqs.q: How can I manage product variants effectively in Selldone?
faqs.a: Selldone offers 'Property Sets' to manage product variants efficiently. By defining global variants and creating Property Sets, you can customize variant names and icons for specific product categories, ensuring a consistent and organized structure across your inventory.

faqs.q: How do I set up a multi-vendor marketplace using Selldone?
faqs.a: To set up a multi-vendor marketplace in Selldone, create a new shop, configure your business model to 'Marketplace' in the settings, and add your custom domain. You can also set up payment methods like Stripe or PayPal to receive payments directly from customers.

faqs.q: Can I integrate Twilio SMS with my Selldone shop?
faqs.a: Yes, you can integrate Twilio SMS with your Selldone shop to send SMS notifications for logins and order updates. Ensure compliance with regulations by setting up Twilio properly and testing the SMS flows periodically.

faqs.q: Does Selldone provide developer resources for custom integrations?
faqs.a: Selldone offers comprehensive developer resources, including open API access for backoffice operations, storefront interactions, and integrations with various providers. SDKs for creating custom storefronts and dashboards are also available.

faqs.q: How can I set up Facebook Pixel with full e-commerce events in Selldone?
faqs.a: Selldone allows you to set up Facebook Pixel with full e-commerce events without the need for plugins. Pre-defined events like ViewContent, AddToCart, and Purchase are automatically set up, and you can configure advanced matching and additional event codes as needed.

faqs.q: What advanced e-commerce features does Selldone offer?
faqs.a: Selldone provides advanced features such as location-based product restrictions, dynamic pricing forms for custom configurations, and a request-to-order system for custom projects or high-value services, enhancing the flexibility and scalability of your online store.

faqs.q: How can I improve the user experience on my product pages in Selldone?
faqs.a: Selldone offers customizable variant display modes like Smart Mode and Select Mode to tailor how product variations are presented. Additionally, you can add custom input forms to the checkout page to collect specific information from customers, enhancing the overall shopping experience.

faqs.q: Does Selldone support location-based selling?
faqs.a: Yes, Selldone's location-based selling feature allows you to restrict product availability to specific countries and ZIP/PIN codes. This enables hyper-local targeting, improved inventory management, and compliance with local regulations.

reviews_summary: Customers appreciate Selldone, praising its extensive 1,500+ native features, seamless integration of online and offline sales, and exceptional customer support. There are a few hiccups like the initial setup being a bit overwhelming and a desire for more customization options, but these are just minor challenges. Weighing the raves against the occasional grumbles, Selldone is hitting the mark and is a solid buy for anyone looking to build and scale their online store. faqs.q: How do I create a landing page for my Flowlance product?
faqs.a: Flowlance automatically generates a landing page for each product you create. The checkout page of your product serves as this landing page. You can customize the product description for the landing page separately from the one in your Creator Store.

faqs.q: How can I connect PayPal to my Flowlance store?
faqs.a: To connect PayPal, navigate to Settings > Payments in your Flowlance account and click on 'Connect PayPal'. You'll be redirected to PayPal's website to complete the process. Ensure you have a PayPal Business account, as personal accounts are not compatible with Flowlance.

faqs.q: What should I do if I'm having trouble connecting Stripe or PayPal to Flowlance?
faqs.a: If you encounter issues connecting Stripe or PayPal, ensure you've completed the entire setup and verification process. For PayPal, verify your email, ensure you have a Business account, and add a valid bank account. If problems persist, you can restart the setup by disconnecting and reconnecting the payment method in Flowlance's Settings > Payments section.

faqs.q: How do I connect a custom domain to my Flowlance store?
faqs.a: To connect a custom domain, go to Settings > Custom domain in your Flowlance account, enter your domain name, and follow the provided instructions to add the necessary DNS records with your domain provider. It may take up to 48 hours for the changes to take effect.

faqs.q: Can I add customer reviews to my Flowlance product pages?
faqs.a: Yes, you can manually add customer reviews to any product page. Edit the desired product, navigate to 'Checkout options', scroll to the 'Customer reviews' section, and click on 'Add reviews' to input the review details.

faqs.q: How do I customize the design, colors, and fonts of my Flowlance store?
faqs.a: To customize your store's appearance, go to 'My Store' and click on 'Design' in the top menu. Use the options in the right sidebar to select templates, background colors, and adjust card designs. Changes will be previewed in real-time.

faqs.q: How can I add a custom link or third-party product to my Flowlance store?
faqs.a: To add a custom link or third-party product, go to 'My Store', click on 'Create New Product', and select 'Custom Link'. Enter the link details and customize its design. This feature allows you to include external pages or offers in your Creator Store.

faqs.q: How do I create a private landing page in Flowlance?
faqs.a: To create a private landing page, go to 'My Store', select 'Landing Pages' from the top menu, and click on 'Create New Landing Page'. Choose the product type, fill out the details, and set the visibility to private. This creates a landing page accessible only through a direct link.

faqs.q: How can I change the title, meta description, and favicon of my Flowlance store?
faqs.a: To change these elements, navigate to 'Settings & My Profile' > 'Settings' in your Flowlance account. Scroll to the 'White label' tab, where you can enter a custom store page title, meta description, and upload a custom favicon.

faqs.q: How do I connect Stripe to my Flowlance store?
faqs.a: To connect Stripe, go to 'Settings & My Profile' > 'Settings' > 'Payments' in your Flowlance account and click on 'Connect Stripe'. You'll be redirected to Stripe's website to complete the setup, including entering your email, setting a password, and providing business and bank account details.

reviews_summary: Customers appreciate Flowlance for its beginner-friendly setup, responsive customer support, and the value it offers at just $19. The platform allows users to launch a digital storefront effortlessly, making it ideal for selling a wide range of products and services without any tech headaches. There are no limits on products or sales, and it handles product delivery automatically. While some users may desire more advanced customization options, the platform is designed to simplify the selling process without overthinking. Overall, Flowlance is a strong choice for anyone looking to turn their digital products into consistent income. With a 60-day money-back guarantee, it's definitely worth giving it a try!

faqs.q: Does LeadRocks integrate with any CRM systems?

faqs.q: Is LeadRocks compliant with GDPR regulations?

faqs.q: What is data enrichment in LeadRocks?
faqs.a: Data enrichment in LeadRocks refers to the process of enhancing your existing database by adding additional information about your prospects, such as emails and phone numbers, using LinkedIn profile URLs.

faqs.q: Does LeadRocks offer email verification services?
faqs.a: Yes, LeadRocks provides an Email Verifier feature that allows you to verify emails directly within the dashboard, ensuring your email lists are clean and valid.

faqs.q: What is the LeadRocks Chrome extension used for?
faqs.a: The LeadRocks Chrome extension is designed to extract contact data from LinkedIn profiles or search results, allowing you to obtain emails and phone numbers directly from LinkedIn pages.

faqs.q: How accurate is the contact data provided by LeadRocks?
faqs.a: LeadRocks provides high-quality, continuously updated contact data, ensuring a decent worldwide coverage and high-caliber data accuracy.

faqs.q: Can I use LeadRocks for email outreach campaigns?

faqs.q: Is LeadRocks user-friendly for beginners?

faqs.q: What kind of support does LeadRocks offer?

faqs.q: What is the difference between LeadRocks and LeadRocks Plus Exclusive in the AppSumo deal?
faqs.a: The primary difference lies in the number of credits provided per code. In the LeadRocks deal, one code grants 5,000 search credits, while in the LeadRocks Plus Exclusive deal, one code provides 7,500 search credits. Additionally, with two codes in the Plus Exclusive deal, you receive 15,000 search credits and 10,000 email verification credits.

faqs.q: Does LeadRocks offer API integrations?
faqs.a: Currently, LeadRocks does not offer API integrations for data export. However, you can use the API to verify emails on the Email Verifier tab.

faqs.q: How does LeadRocks differ from Apollo.io?
faqs.a: LeadRocks and Apollo.io are both B2B databases, allowing users to export numerous contacts without using a LinkedIn account or scraping. Each database has its unique features, with LeadRocks offering high credit limits and bulk export capabilities.

faqs.q: Does LeadRocks have data for contacts in Italy?
faqs.a: Yes, LeadRocks has a substantial number of Italian contacts. You can create a free account and use the filtering options on the Prospecting tab to explore the database.

faqs.q: Can I use LeadRocks data for email marketing to my own customers?
faqs.a: Yes, you can use LeadRocks data for email marketing campaigns. You can add the data to a CSV file for your contacts and then review it in the campaign editor.

faqs.q: What is the email verification process in LeadRocks?
faqs.a: LeadRocks offers two types of email verification: a free verification on the Lists tab, which provides statuses of emails in the database, and a more accurate verification on the Email Verifier tab, which uses a built-in third-party tool and requires credits (1 credit = 1 email).

faqs.q: Does LeadRocks have data for contacts in Taiwan?
faqs.a: Yes, LeadRocks has 220,076 contacts from Taiwan.

faqs.q: What are the filtering capabilities in LeadRocks?
faqs.a: LeadRocks provides filtering options such as job title, location, company name, industry, and team size. However, some users have noted limitations in filtering by specific criteria like keywords.

faqs.q: How can I enrich LinkedIn profiles using LeadRocks?
faqs.a: You can use LeadRocks' Chrome extension to export LinkedIn search results into a file and then upload that file to the Enrichment tab to get contact details in bulk.

faqs.q: What are the main features of LeadRocks?
faqs.a: LeadRocks offers a highly reliable B2B contact database, email verification, email outreach automation, data enrichment, and a Chrome extension for LinkedIn.

Weighing the raves against the occasional grumbles, LeadRocks is hitting the mark and is a solid buy for those in need of reliable B2B lead generation. faqs.q: Can I connect it to Claude or ChatGPT?
faqs.a: Yes, and it’s what makes Flow unlike any other tool. Connect Claude, ChatGPT or your favourite AI assistant to Flow’s LinkedIn MCP and run your outreach just by prompting it. You can also create scheduled tasks, routines, skills, and more so that your outreach is running round the clock in the background.

faqs.q: What can I automate with my AI assistant?
faqs.a: Connect Claude or ChatGPT to Flow’s MCP and you can design agents, skills and scheduled automated tasks that run while you sleep, 24/7. Everything from finding qualified leads and running outreach, to managing replies and connecting it all to your entire go-to-market stack.

faqs.q: Does Flow connect to the rest of my GTM stack?
faqs.a: Yes, through Flow’s MCP. Connect your AI assistant and it can connect LinkedIn to every other tool in your stack. Just prompt it. For example: “check who’s accepted our connection requests, add them to the email sequence in Instantly, and create a new deal for each of these inside HubSpot. Oh, and when you’re done, notify the team in Slack.” The shared inbox also acts as a simple CRM, so no leads or follow-ups slip through.

faqs.q: Can I personalise DMs with AI?
faqs.a: Yes, with you in the loop. Every draft comes with full context on the person and your message history with them - and Flow can also read up to 250 of their most recent posts. Curate your own prompts and snippets in-app or run it with Claude and ChatGPT using skills, scheduled tasks, and more.

faqs.q: Do I need LinkedIn Sales Navigator to use this?
faqs.a: No Sales Navigator or third party app required. Describe your ICP in Flow’s AI search bar and Flow mines a database of 300+ million profiles and finds the ones most likely to reply. You can also target on signals like whether someone has changed jobs, posted recently, etc. If you already have Sales Navigator, connecting it unlocks advanced search on top.

faqs.q: Can I import my own leads?
faqs.a: Yes, though with Flow you don’t have to. Other tools make you import leads from somewhere else. Flow finds them for you. If you do want to bring your own, upload a CSV of LinkedIn profile URLs, or connect Flow’s MCP and use your AI assistant and have Claude push leads from Apollo or Clay straight into a Flow campaign.

faqs.q: Will this get my LinkedIn account restricted?
faqs.a: Flow runs a safe, proven campaign on every list you create, visiting profiles, liking posts and sending connection requests the way a real person would, which protects your accounts from getting blocked. Each account sends a maximum of 15 connection requests a day, only between 9am and 6pm your local time, and new accounts ramp up gradually over their first 15 days. LinkedIn allows around 100 a week per account, so Flow stays comfortably inside that. We also can raise limits for you on request.

faqs.q: How many LinkedIn accounts can I connect?
faqs.a: As many as you like (subject to your tier). Connecting and rotating unlimited LinkedIn accounts raises the daily limits LinkedIn sets per account, so you keep scaling your outreach on auto-pilot. They all feed one shared inbox and dashboard, and you can easily filter and sort based on senders and lists you create.

The intuitive interface and seamless integration with AI tools enhance the user experience. Weighing the raves against the occasional grumbles, Flow AI is hitting the mark with a stellar rating from users. With a 60-day money-back guarantee, it's worth giving it a try!

subheader: A must-have tool for every Facebook group owner to automate new group members onboarding
highlights: Send every new member’s answers and email to Google Sheets and 44+ email tools the second they’re approved
Auto-approve new members by your own rules, then welcome each one with a DM, post, or comment

faqs.q: What is Group Collector and how does it work?
faqs.a: Group Collector is a Chrome extension designed to automate the onboarding of new Facebook group members. It collects member responses to group entry questions, including email addresses, and saves them to a Google Sheet. Additionally, it integrates directly with over 35 email marketing platforms, allowing for seamless addition of new members to your email lists without the need for Zapier.

faqs.q: How do I install and set up Group Collector?
faqs.a:
To install and set up Group Collector, follow these steps:
1. Install the Group Collector Chrome Extension from the Chrome Web Store.
2. Enter your license key in the extension.
3. In the Group Collector Dashboard, create a new group, connect a Google Sheet, and integrate your preferred email marketing software.
4. In your Facebook group settings, add three membership questions, ensuring one asks for the member's email.
5. On the Facebook Group Member Requests page, use the 'GC Approve' or 'GC Approve All' buttons to approve members. Their responses will be added to your Google Sheet and email marketing software.

faqs.q: Can Group Collector automatically approve or decline new Facebook group members?
faqs.a: Yes, Group Collector offers an Auto Approve & Decline feature that allows you to automatically approve or decline new members based on specific criteria. These criteria can include whether an email was provided, the number of questions answered, member location, number of mutual friends, and more. This automation helps streamline group management without manual intervention.

faqs.q: Does Group Collector integrate with Beehiiv?
faqs.a: Yes, Group Collector directly integrates with Beehiiv, allowing you to seamlessly add new Facebook group members to your Beehiiv email lists.

faqs.q: Is Group Collector compatible with Pabbly Connect or Albato?
faqs.a: Yes, Group Collector is useful for Facebook group owners and can be used alongside tools like Pabbly Connect or Albato. It helps collect member answers and send the data to Google Sheets and your email marketing software.

faqs.q: Does Group Collector offer an affiliate program?
faqs.a: Yes, Group Collector offers an affiliate program. You can find more information and sign up at their affiliate page.

faqs.q: How can I contact Group Collector support?
faqs.a: You can contact Group Collector support by sending an email to [email protected]. They aim to respond as soon as possible to assist with any inquiries or issues.

reviews_summary: Group Collector is praised for its smooth integration with multiple autoresponders, efficient automation, and helpful customer support. Some users have highlighted the necessity for clearer instructions and the restriction of needing email addresses in membership questions. Nevertheless, with an impressive overall rating of 4.7 and positive feedback from 93 reviews, Group Collector is a valuable investment for Facebook group owners seeking to streamline member onboarding. Additionally, with a 60-day money-back guarantee, it's definitely worth a try.

faqs.q: What features does WarmySender offer for email outreach?
faqs.a: WarmySender provides a comprehensive suite of features for email outreach, including email warmup with a 99.4% inbox placement rate, multi-step sequences with A/B testing and conditional branching, a unified inbox for managing email and LinkedIn replies, smart throttling to protect sender reputation, an analytics dashboard for performance tracking, access to a 200M+ verified B2B lead database, A-Z testing with up to 26 variants, a spam score checker, and a visual sequence builder for campaign design.

faqs.q: How do I set up my first campaign in WarmySender?
faqs.a: To set up your first campaign in WarmySender, follow these steps: 1) Connect your email accounts (Gmail, Outlook, SMTP) and LinkedIn account. 2) Choose your plan (Pro, Enterprise, or Ultimate). 3) Create multi-channel sequences using the visual sequence builder. 4) Set daily sending limits to protect your sender reputation. 5) Launch your campaign and monitor performance through the analytics dashboard.

faqs.q: Is WarmySender compatible with different email providers?
faqs.a: Yes, WarmySender is compatible with various email providers. It supports Gmail, Outlook, and any email provider that supports SMTP and IMAP protocols, including custom business email servers and managed hosting providers.

faqs.q: How does WarmySender's email warmup process work?
faqs.a: WarmySender's email warmup process involves sending emails that trigger multi-turn conversations, up to 5 replies deep, to simulate real engagement. This approach has resulted in a 99.4% inbox placement rate, as measured across 80,000+ warmup emails in Q1 2026.

faqs.q: What should I do if my LinkedIn account disconnects from WarmySender?
faqs.a: If your LinkedIn account disconnects from WarmySender, it's recommended to reconnect your account promptly to ensure uninterrupted campaign execution. Detailed instructions for reconnecting your LinkedIn account can be found in the WarmySender Help Center.

faqs.q: Does WarmySender offer deliverability testing for emails?
faqs.a: Yes, WarmySender offers comprehensive deliverability testing features, including inbox placement testing, spam score analysis, authentication verification (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), and blacklist monitoring. These tools help identify and resolve potential deliverability issues before launching campaigns.

faqs.q: Can I manage multiple email accounts within WarmySender?
faqs.a: Yes, WarmySender allows you to connect and manage unlimited Gmail, Outlook, and SMTP mailboxes from a unified dashboard. It offers features like intelligent rotation, coordinated warmup, and per-mailbox health monitoring to optimize your email outreach.

faqs.q: Does WarmySender provide an API for integrations?
faqs.a: Yes, WarmySender offers a REST API that allows integration with CRMs, automation platforms, and other tools. This enables actions such as pushing prospects from your CRM, exporting reply events to a data warehouse, and building opt-out webhooks.

faqs.q: How can I contact WarmySender support if I encounter issues?
faqs.a: If you encounter issues with WarmySender, you can contact their support team by emailing [email redacted]. They typically respond to support requests within 24 hours during business days (Monday - Friday). For urgent issues, mention 'URGENT' in your email subject line.

reviews_summary: Customers appreciate WarmySender, praising its seamless integration of cold email sequences, the extensive 200M-contact B2B database, and the effective Bounce Shield that boosts deliverability. There are no daily limits on lead extraction, and the warmup process is designed to operate within safe per-account limits automatically, protecting users from potential bans. Weighing the raves against the occasional grumbles, WarmySender is hitting the mark with a stellar 4.8 rating and is a solid buy for anyone looking to enhance their outreach efforts. With a 60-day money-back guarantee, it's definitely worth giving it a try!

faqs.q: How can I integrate my email marketing tool with KingSumo?
faqs.a: To integrate your email marketing tool with KingSumo, you can use a Zapier webhook. First, create a Zap in Zapier and select the appropriate settings. Copy the provided Custom Webhook URL and paste it into the 'Zap URL' field under the Integrations section in your KingSumo account. Then, continue setting up the Zap by selecting your email marketing tool and configuring the desired actions. Once completed, activate the Zap and enable Zapier integration in Section 4 of your giveaway settings.

faqs.q: What are the pricing plans for KingSumo?
faqs.a: KingSumo offers two main pricing plans: a Free plan and a Lifetime Plan. The Free plan includes features like unlimited giveaways, bonus entries, GDPR compliance, embedding on any site, auto-reminder emails, multiple prizes/winners, and customer support. The Lifetime Plan, available for a single payment of $49, includes all Free plan features plus custom branding, Meta Pixel tracking, conversion tracking, translation/localization, custom rules and terms, additional entry fields, removal of sponsored entry, and advanced integrations.

faqs.q: How do I embed a KingSumo giveaway on my website?
faqs.a: To embed a KingSumo giveaway on your website, use the provided embed code. This code allows you to display the giveaway directly on your site, ensuring a seamless experience for your visitors. Simply copy the embed code from your KingSumo account and paste it into the HTML of your website where you want the giveaway to appear.

faqs.q: What integrations does KingSumo support?
faqs.a: KingSumo integrates with various platforms to streamline your workflow. It supports integrations with tools like Zapier, Mailchimp, ConvertKit, Klaviyo, SendFox, and more. These integrations allow you to connect KingSumo with your preferred email marketing services and other applications to automate tasks and manage leads efficiently.

faqs.q: How does KingSumo select winners for giveaways?
faqs.a: KingSumo simplifies the winner selection process with automated tools. The platform uses advanced algorithms to ensure a fair selection by randomly choosing winners from the pool of entrants. This feature saves time and eliminates the hassle of manual selection.

faqs.q: Is KingSumo GDPR compliant?
faqs.a: Yes, KingSumo is GDPR compliant. The platform offers features like GDPR consent checkboxes to ensure compliance with EU data protection regulations. Additionally, KingSumo supports over 20 languages, making it suitable for a global audience.

faqs.q: Can I customize the rules and terms for my KingSumo giveaway?
faqs.a: Yes, KingSumo provides default rules and terms for your giveaways, which you can easily customize to fit your specific requirements. You can add any legal language or contest-specific guidelines by deselecting the 'Use default rules' option and editing the document accordingly.

faqs.q: Does KingSumo offer a money-back guarantee?
faqs.a: Yes, KingSumo offers a 30-day money-back guarantee. Refunds will be provided up to 30 days after the original purchase if KingSumo does not meet expectations. Following any cancellation, you will continue to have access to the service through the end of your current billing period.

faqs.q: How can I obtain the emails of my giveaway’s entrants?
faqs.a: You can obtain the emails of your giveaway’s entrants by exporting the entrant data into a CSV file from your KingSumo account. This feature allows you to manage and utilize the collected email addresses for your marketing campaigns.

faqs.q: Does KingSumo send any emails automatically?
faqs.a: Yes, KingSumo sends automatic emails to entrants, including mid-giveaway and final 24-hour reminders. These emails help keep participants engaged and encourage them to share the giveaway with their friends, increasing your giveaway's reach.

body: None

faqs.q: How big is the database?
faqs.a: 693 million people profiles and 63 million companies, with job titles, seniority, work history, company firmographics and contact details. 366 million people have an email address and 166 million have a phone number.

faqs.q: FAQ 2: Do I need to code?
faqs.a: No. Add https://api.leadocean.io/mcp as a remote MCP server in Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor, sign in with your LeadOcean account, and ask for leads in plain English. There is no key to paste. If you do code, the same data is available over a REST API, and you can export results to CSV.

faqs.q: FAQ 3: How is this different from Apollo or Clay?
faqs.a: LeadOcean is only the data. It is not a CRM or a sequencer, and it won't become one. Apollo bundles data with its own CRM and sequencer and charges credits. Clay orchestrates other data providers and charges credits per lookup. With this deal you get a fixed allowance for life with no credits to buy, and you can fills whatever CRM, sequencer or warehouse you already use.

faqs.q: How do the limits on this deal work?
faqs.a: Tiers 1 to 4 reset search and enrichments every 5 hours. Tier 5 resets enrichments daily and search monthly. Phone reveals reset monthly on every tier: 100, 500, 1,500, 5,000 and 15,000 for Tiers 1 to 5. Unused limits don't roll over. If you hit a limit or go over your tier's rate limit, requests return a 429 with a Retry-After header until the window resets. You are never charged extra.

faqs.q: What counts as a record?
faqs.a: Every person or company returned in a search counts as one search result, so a page of 25 people counts 25. Enriching one person counts as one enrichment. Revealing a phone number counts as one phone reveal. Requests rejected for rate limits are never counted.

faqs.q: Can I upgrade later?
faqs.a: Yes. You can move up to any higher tier from your AppSumo account, and your limits update right away. Tier 5 matches our $497/month Agency plan and is limited in quantity.

faqs.q: Where does the data come from, and is it compliant?
faqs.a: LeadOcean combines 20+ licensed and proprietary sources into one schema. Every response names which dataset answered in the X-Source header, and unknown fields come back empty instead of guessed. Anyone can request removal at leadocean.io/legal/remove and the record is suppressed immediately.

faqs.q: What if it's not for me?
faqs.a: You have 60 days from purchase to get a full refund through AppSumo, for any reason.

faqs.q: Are there usage limits on the lifetime deal?
faqs.a:
Yes, a fair-use pace. Each tier gets a number of search records and enrichments every 5 hours, which refill until you reach a weekly maximum:

Tier 1: 20K searches / 2K enrichments per 5 hours, up to 100K / 10K a week
Tier 2: 50K / 5K per 5 hours, up to 250K / 25K a week
Tier 3: 100K / 10K per 5 hours, up to 500K / 50K a week
Tier 4: 150K / 20K per 5 hours, up to 750K / 100K a week
Tier 5: no weekly cap. 25M searches a month and 1M enrichments a day

If you go past a limit, your API key doesn’t stop. It keeps working at a slower speed until your limit refills. If you also have a paid LeadOcean plan, the limits add together.

faqs.q: What are the key features of Mailmunch?
faqs.a: Mailmunch offers a comprehensive suite of tools including lead generation forms and popups, landing pages, email marketing, marketing automation, cart abandonment solutions, coupons, spinwheels, and Shopify page integrations. These features are designed to help businesses grow their audience and boost sales.

faqs.q: How can I integrate Mailmunch with Mailchimp?
faqs.a: To integrate Mailmunch with Mailchimp, create or edit a Mailmunch form, and in the 'Integrate' step, select Mailchimp as the service provider. Enter your Mailchimp account credentials, choose the Mailchimp list to sync with, and map the form fields accordingly. Once set up, new subscribers will automatically be added to your Mailchimp lists.

faqs.q: How do I set up DKIM records to improve email deliverability in Mailmunch?
faqs.a: Setting up DKIM records involves generating DKIM keys in your Mailmunch account and adding them to your domain's DNS settings. This process authenticates your emails, reducing the likelihood of them being marked as spam. Detailed instructions are available in Mailmunch's Help Center.

faqs.q: Why is my Mailmunch form not showing up on my website?
faqs.a: Mailmunch uses cookies to determine if a visitor has seen your form. If a user has already seen or subscribed to the form, it won't appear again until the cookie expires. To test your forms, use your browser's incognito or private browsing mode, which makes you appear as a new user.

faqs.q: Can I add multiple integrations to a single Mailmunch opt-in form?
faqs.a: Yes, you can add multiple integrations to a single opt-in form in Mailmunch. In the 'Integrate' step of your form, click on 'Add New Integration' and select your preferred email marketing service. Follow the setup process to add the integration. You can manage multiple integrations within the same form.

faqs.q: How do I integrate Mailmunch with Zapier?
faqs.a: To integrate Mailmunch with Zapier, first generate an API key in your Mailmunch account. Then, create a Zap in Zapier using Mailmunch's app, and configure the desired actions. This integration allows you to connect Mailmunch with over 750 apps, automating various tasks.

faqs.q: What types of campaigns can I create with Mailmunch?
faqs.a: Mailmunch offers various campaign types including forms and popups (such as popovers), landing pages, email marketing campaigns, and marketing automation sequences. These tools help in capturing leads and engaging with your audience effectively.

faqs.q: How can I integrate Mailmunch with Constant Contact?
faqs.a: To integrate Mailmunch with Constant Contact, create or edit a Mailmunch form, and in the 'Integrate' step, select Constant Contact as the service provider. Enter your Constant Contact credentials, assign the appropriate list, and map the form fields. Once set up, new subscribers will sync with your Constant Contact account.

faqs.q: How do I use tracking pixels with Mailmunch?
faqs.a: Mailmunch allows you to add tracking pixels to your forms and landing pages to monitor views and subscriptions. In the campaign builder, you can add 'View Pixel' and 'Subscribe Pixel' in the behavior step for forms, or use the HTML block for landing pages to insert tracking pixels.

faqs.q: How can I integrate Mailmunch with ActiveCampaign?
faqs.a: To integrate Mailmunch with ActiveCampaign, create or edit a Mailmunch form, and in the 'Integrate' step, select ActiveCampaign as the service provider. Enter your ActiveCampaign credentials, assign the appropriate list, and map the form fields. Once set up, new subscribers will sync with your ActiveCampaign account.

faqs.q: What types of demos can I create with Dale?
faqs.a: Dale offers several demo types: Single Experience Demos for focused feature highlights, Linear Demos for guided experiences with dynamic paths, and Branched Demos for advanced, multi-path journeys tailored to different audiences.

faqs.q: How can Dale assist in product marketing?
faqs.a: Dale enables product marketers to create interactive demos that showcase new features, enhance campaign landing pages, and repurpose content across various channels, thereby boosting awareness, engagement, and pipeline.

faqs.q: Is coding knowledge required to build demos with Dale?
faqs.a: No, Dale's intuitive editor allows users to capture product screens and flows without any coding, enabling the creation of polished demo experiences without developer assistance.

faqs.q: Can Dale be used for training and onboarding purposes?
faqs.a: Yes, Dale streamlines training and onboarding by providing dynamic, self-serve demo flows that educate new users, customers, or internal teams, reducing support needs and increasing adoption.

faqs.q: Does Dale offer analytics on demo engagement?
faqs.a: Yes, Dale provides engagement insights, allowing users to track viewer behavior, such as which features prospects care about most, to improve product storytelling and optimize demos.

faqs.q: How does Dale support sales enablement?
faqs.a: Dale equips sales teams with trackable, tailored demo experiences that engage prospects, reduce preparation time, and accelerate deal closures by providing ready-to-share, high-converting demo assets.

faqs.q: Can Dale demos be embedded into websites or emails?
faqs.a: Yes, Dale allows users to embed interactive demos into landing pages, blogs, or emails, enabling prospects to explore the product on their own terms without the need for a sales call.

faqs.q: Does Dale offer integrations with other tools?
faqs.a: Yes, Dale integrates with various tools, allowing users to connect with their favorite platforms or build custom integrations to enhance their demo experiences.

faqs.q: How can Dale assist in pre-sales processes?
faqs.a: Dale helps pre-sales teams by providing automated, personalized demo tools that qualify leads, showcase value, and accelerate buying decisions before the first call ends.

reviews_summary: Dale is appreciated for its ability to provide instant, personalized demos and comprehensive analytics for understanding prospect engagement. However, some users have noted that the setup process can be time-consuming, and the pricing may be a bit steep for some. With an overall rating of 5.0 and positive feedback, Dale is a solid buy for those in need of a tool to enhance their sales process. Plus, with a 60-day money-back guarantee, it's worth giving it a try.

faqs.q: What is TexAu Desktop and what does the product do?
faqs.a: TexAu Desktop is an app for Windows and Mac that runs automations on your own computer. You connect your accounts with the TexAu browser extension, pick an automation, add a URL or a CSV of inputs, and run it. It works with LinkedIn, Sales Navigator, Recruiter Lite, X (Twitter), Slack, YouTube, Google and websites. Every run saves its results as a CSV file on your computer.

faqs.q: How many integrations and ready-to-run actions does TexAu provide?
faqs.a: TexAu Desktop works with LinkedIn, Sales Navigator, Recruiter Lite, X (Twitter), Slack, YouTube, Google and websites, plus a few data cleaning tools. Every tier gets the full automation library. Results are saved as CSV files, so you can import them into Google Sheets, your CRM or any tool that takes a CSV.

faqs.q: Does TexAu Desktop provide a public API and how is it authenticated?
faqs.a: No. TexAu Desktop is a desktop app with no public API, so there is nothing to authenticate. Each run saves a CSV file you can import into other tools.

faqs.q: What is add-on Proxy Bandwidth?
faqs.a: Some automations, like Google search, work better through a proxy, so requests don't come from your own IP address. You can use your own proxies, or buy proxy bandwidth from us as a one-time add-on on any tier. One unit is 10 GB for $49, up to 5 units (50 GB). We provide the bandwidth and add it to your account. The add-on is non-refundable.

faqs.q: How many accounts can I connect?
faqs.a: As many as you like. The license doesn't limit connected accounts. Each account runs one automation at a time.

faqs.q: Does the deal include TexAu V3, the cloud app or an API?
faqs.a: No. The deal is for TexAu Desktop only. It doesn't include TexAu V3, the TexAu cloud app, an API or any other TexAu product.

faqs.q: Can my team share one plan?
faqs.a: Yes, with one key per computer. Each teammate activates the app on their own computer with their own key. Tiers 1 and 2 include 1 key, Tier 3 includes 3, Tier 4 includes 5 and Tier 5 includes 10. There are no sub-accounts or shared workspaces.
